jobs.title: Senior SAP Solution Architect  EAM, Logistics & Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the Future of Enterprise Solutions

As Senior SAP Solution Architect – EAM, Logistics & Digital Platforms, you will design and optimize complex SAP landscapes that power Vattenfall’s operations across multiple countries. This role calls for broad, all-round technology skills and the ability to connect business needs with advanced IT solutions—while acting as a trusted advisor and consultant to our internal business teams.

Why this role matters

We are transforming into a data-driven organization to support our mission. Your work will enable smarter decisions, predictive maintenance, and seamless integration across SAP and related platforms. You’ll help us build secure, scalable solutions that keep our operations running smoothly—and guide our business stakeholders in making technology choices that deliver real value.

You’ll work on:

    Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/PM) and Logistics processes (S2C, P2P) on SAP S/4HANA
    ePPM for project and portfolio management
    Document Management Systems (DMS) and Work Clearance Management (WCM)
    Integration strategies for hybrid SAP landscapes (cloud and on-premise)
    Supporting financial processes with a general understanding of CO Controlling

Your responsibilities

    Guide strategic projects with fit-for-purpose architecture
    Act as an internal consultant: advise business stakeholders on SAP strategy, integration, and data architecture
    Ensure IT security compliance and support adoption of IEC 62443, ISO27001 standards
    Develop architecture principles and standards for enterprise-wide solutions
    Be a trusted advisor to enable operating models through technology

Location  

Stockholm

Qualifications

Who are you?

You combine technical depth with business insight and thrive in complex environments. Ideally, you bring:

    Academic degree in IT or related field
    Hands-on experience as SAP Solution Architect in asset-intensive industries (energy, utilities, manufacturing)
    Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, EAM (PM), ePPM, Logistics (S2C, P2P), DMS, WCM
    General understanding of CO Controlling
    Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
    Experience with security frameworks and critical infrastructure requirements
    Fluent in Swedish and English

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Senior Recruiter Marius Gläßge via marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de.

Trade union representatives in Sweden: Anders Bohlin (Unionen), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna) and Marika Westman (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

We welcome your application in English no later than 25th September 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.



At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture. We firmly believe that diversity helps build a more profitable and attractive company, and we strive to be good role models when it comes to diversity. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall.

Working at Vattenfall means working with critical societal infrastructure. Therefore, many of our positions are security-classified, and you may be required to fill a wartime posting. If this position is security-classified, a security clearance will be carried out before employment, in accordance with the Security Protection Act. Any potential wartime posting will be based on the employment contract and the Total Defence Service Act.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Avalanche Studios Group is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team!

This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and state-of-the-art data processing technologies. You will play a key role in our Data Engineering team, ensuring that our data infrastructure is reliable, performant, and successfully tied to delivering better data systems for our games and publishing activities. This role requires a deep understanding of data engineering methodologies/frameworks in a big-data environment ; coupled to a strong collaborative spirit.

What you'll do:

    Develop and implement processes to extract, clean, and transform data from various sources to ensure it is ready for modelling/consumption.
    Collaborate with analytics engineers, data scientists/analysts and product stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide them with reliable data solutions ; capturing a complete ecosystem view of in- and out-of-game user behaviors.
    Architect and implement robust, maintainable, and high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines and data systems ; ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and long-term usability.
    Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schemas, and metadata. Ensure that data definitions are consistent and easily accessible to all stakeholders.
    Monitor data pipelines and systems to ensure high availability and performance alongside our analytics engineer ; implement automated data quality checks, validation processes and alerts ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data.
    Write efficient, maintainable, and scalable code using best practices. Conduct code and SQL reviews and provide feedback to ensure high standards of code quality within the team.
    Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, frameworks and best practices in data engineering / analytics / AI and share knowledge with the team.

Who you are:

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field ; with 8+ years experience in data engineering or a related field.
    Strong proficiency in big-data technologies and languages, such as Python, Spark, Scala, SQL, and Java.Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Talend, DBT… DBT being a big plus).
    Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure… GCP being a big plus) ; and experience with “Infrastructure as Code” process (e.g. Terraform).
    Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail ; coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
    Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry is a plus!

Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.



The Stockholm location

Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.



Our values

At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.



How to apply

To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.



At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

jobs.title: DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area IT

We design and build the digital backbone that moves Vattenfall forward — from modern infrastructure to large-scale digital transformation initiatives. We connect people, processes and technology while enabling automation, innovation and an intuitive user experience. By doing so, we create a smart and connected organisation that is ready for tomorrow's energy transition.

Job Description

Do you enjoy creating secure, scalable cloud environments that enable innovation at enterprise scale?

As a DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks), you will help operate and develop the platforms that support Vattenfall’s data, analytics and AI ambitions. Your expertise in Azure, automation and cloud governance will contribute directly to our purpose: enabling fossil-free living through digital innovation and smarter use of data.

Your role

Within our Digital Platform Operations team, you will work with colleagues across cloud engineering, architecture, operations and data platforms to ensure that our Azure and Databricks environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.

You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.

Your key responsibilities:

    Designing, implementing and operating Azure-based cloud platform solutions
    Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and automation tools
    Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code solutions using ARM, Bicep and scripting technologies
    Automate provisioning, deployment and lifecycle management of cloud resources
    Maintaining and improving self-service platform capabilities based on .NET Core and Angular
    Ensuring platform reliability, availability and operational stability
    Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Azure Databricks and Snowflake environments
    Implementing security controls in alignment with enterprise policies and governance requirements
    Collaborating with architects, developers and operations specialists to deliver secure and scalable cloud services

Azure Databricks Platform Operations & Governance:

    Operating and further developing Vattenfall’s Azure Databricks platform for analytics, data and AI workloads
    Managing identity and access controls through Azure AD integration and RBAC principles
    Supporting secure networking concepts including private endpoints and secure cluster connectivity
    Implementing and maintaining data governance capabilities using Unity Catalog and related Databricks services
    Managing platform resources using Infrastructure as Code approaches such as Terraform and ARM templates
    Establishing compute standards, governance controls and cost optimisation practices
    Enabling integrations with Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Snowflake and other enterprise services
    Supporting onboarding and adoption of platform capabilities across teams
    Contributing to monitoring, logging and security improvements throughout the platform landscape

Platform Improvement & FinOps

    Identifying opportunities to improve performance, cost efficiency and sustainability of cloud services
    Enhancing automation and self-service capabilities for platform users
    Supporting the introduction of new cloud, AI and analytics capabilities
    Helping to create a seamless developer and data practitioner experience across the platform ecosystem

Location

Stockholm, Katowice, Amsterdam and Berlin

Qualifications

Who are you?

You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.

We believe you have

    Several years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role in Azure environments
    Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, preferably within operations, governance or platform engineering
    Strong understanding of Azure services including Networking, Storage, App Services, Virtual Machines and Entra ID (Azure AD)
    Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD practices
    Experience working with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform and PowerShell
    Knowledge of analytics and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark or modern data lake architectures
    Understanding of cloud governance, security and access management principles
    Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies
    Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
    Professional communication skills in English (local language skills are a plus but not mandatory)

It is an advantage if you also have

    Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
    Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation
    Experience supporting enterprise AI or machine learning platforms

Additional Information

Our offer

A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!

At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than, 24th of September 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager

Detection alone is not security. Every day, security teams are forced to make critical decisions on incomplete data. Binalyze changes that. Our platform, AIR, gives investigators the full picture, turning alerts into understanding in minutes, not days. We’re scaling globally and building the category-defining investigation platform the industry has been missing.

Partners are central to how we bring that value to market. We’re looking for a commercially driven Channel Account Manager to grow Binalyze’s VAR and reseller ecosystem, turning signed partners into active sellers and creating repeatable partner-led revenue.

This is a hands-on commercial role, not a partner-programme administration role. You’ll build strong relationships with priority partners, create joint business plans, generate pipeline and help partners identify, progress and ultimately own Binalyze opportunities across their customer bases.

What you’ll do

  • Activate existing signed VAR and reseller partners and grow the partner ecosystem.

  • Build commercial relationships with priority partners and their sales teams.

  • Create and execute joint business plans with clear pipeline and revenue goals.

  • Build mindshare so Binalyze is actively positioned by partner sellers.

  • Identify, qualify and progress opportunities across partner customer bases.

  • Work with Binalyze sellers on strategic joint opportunities where appropriate.

  • Enable partners to identify, develop and close their own Binalyze opportunities over time.

  • Recruit new partners selectively where there are clear capability, coverage or market gaps.

  • Run regular partner pipeline and performance reviews.

  • Measure success through active partners, partner-generated pipeline and partner-generated ARR.

  • Coordinate with Binalyze technical teams to ensure partners receive effective technical enablement.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven channel, partner, alliances or indirect sales experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of activating VAR, reseller or MSSP partners and generating partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue.

  • Experience creating and executing joint business plans, including pipeline, revenue targets and performance reviews.

  • Strong commercial sales skills and the ability to coach partner sellers through qualification, deal progression and close.

  • Confidence working with direct sales teams while maintaining a partner-first approach.

  • The ability to build relationships with sales leaders and front-line sellers.

  • A data-led approach to pipeline, conversion and ARR.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to have

  • Cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, SOC, EDR or related security-technology experience.

  • Experience with MSSPs or security-focused VARs and resellers.

  • Experience helping to build or scale an indirect sales motion in a high-growth SaaS business.

  • Familiarity with CRM and partner-management tools.

What we offer

  • Generous annual leave plus wellbeing days and your birthday off.

  • Private medical insurance, including family cover.

  • Home office setup support.

  • Monthly wellbeing and entertainment allowances.

  • Wellbeing support through Oli.

  • Fully remote and flexible working.

Benefits are tailored by location; we’ll share full details during the hiring process.

We’re committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. If you don’t meet every requirement listed, we’d still encourage you to apply.

If this sounds like the kind of commercial challenge you’d like to spend your time on, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Senior Recruiter
Location: London, Boston, or Stuttgart
Employment Type: Full time
Location Type: Hybrid
Department: Talent

Who We Are:
We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world, moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:
We're scaling fast across research, engineering, and deployment as Cortex, our vision-language-action model, moves into more live robotic cells across the EU and US. We're looking for a Senior Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of roles, working closely with hiring managers to build pipelines, run a rigorous process, and close strong candidates in a market where the best people have options. You'll operate with real autonomy over your reqs and be expected to build process, not just execute one handed to you.

Your Responsibilities:

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Ownership

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of roles, from intake through offer, ensuring a consistent and high-quality candidate experience at every stage

  • Manage offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with hiring managers and leadership, keeping compensation and equity consistent with internal bands

  • Track time-in-stage across your pipelines and proactively unblock stalled candidates rather than waiting for a hiring manager to flag it

Hiring Manager Partnership & Process Design

  • Partner directly with hiring managers to define role requirements, calibrate the interview process, and align on what a strong hire actually looks like for each position

  • Build and refine scorecards, structured interview kits, and screening criteria specific to each function you own

  • Coach and calibrate interviewers on assessment standards, turning subjective impressions into structured, defensible hiring decisions

Pipeline & Sourcing

  • Build and manage a healthy, prioritized pipeline across inbound and outbound channels, balancing sourcing effort against proven high-yield channels

  • Run proactive outbound sourcing for specialist or hard-to-fill roles instead of relying on inbound alone

  • Manage relationships with external agencies and vendors where used, including scoping engagements and monitoring fee exposure

Data & Process

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate and requisition data in Ashby, supporting reliable reporting on pipeline health, conversion rates, and time-to-hire

  • Flag process gaps or bottlenecks early, and contribute directly to the tools and playbooks the Talent function is still building out

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally spanning both technical and non-technical hiring

  • Experience recruiting in a startup or fast-growth environment, comfortable owning a high volume of live reqs with limited support

  • No specific degree requirement; track record matters more than credentials

Skills

  • Strong command of structured interviewing and competency-based assessment, not just informal impression-based screening

  • Proven ability to source and close passive candidates through outbound channels, not just manage what comes in

  • Comfortable partnering directly with hiring managers and pushing back when a process or bar needs to change

  • Fluent in an ATS (Ashby or equivalent), with the discipline to keep data clean and reporting-ready

Additional Skills / Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for robotics, hardware, or deep-tech companies

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies, particularly EU and US

  • German fluency, useful for Stuttgart-based hiring

  • Experience building recruiting processes from scratch rather than only operating within an existing one

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)

  • Flexible working hours

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

jobs.title: Leasing Pricing Specialist
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

 

YOUR MISSION

Make sure UK Leasing always has the best-priced, best-covered deals in the market, so our sales team can draw more leads and convert more of them. This means owning the overall competitiveness of our marketplace, the deals every partner lists on it as well as Leasey's own, not just our own broker's position. You are the pricing engine behind the offer set: you find where we are missing competitive supply, own the ratebooks that power the marketplace, keep pricing accurate day to day, and guide Procurement and the Marketplace commercial team on where to find deals and at what price.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyse funder ratebooks and the Carwow marketplace to identify demand-supply whitespace, and guide the Procurement team on where to focus their supply-finding and at what price points.

  • Own and manage all ratebooks, including building custom ratebooks where a supplier does not provide one, and continually improving the efficiency of that process.

  • Manage ratebook uploads to the Carwow marketplace and third-party aggregators. Own pricing accuracy on a daily basis, removing deals and capping leads where necessary.

  • Act as the in-office pricing expert and advisor to Procurement when they uncover supply opportunities, such as dealer finance deals or commitment batches.

  • Build the models and tooling, using AI where it helps, that make pricing and the wider commercial team faster and more accurate.

  • Own the monitoring of supply and deal competitiveness across the whole Carwow marketplace, tracked by brand, model, category and partner. This covers the overall competitiveness of the deals on our marketplace, not only Leasey's own position.

  • Work with the Marketplace commercial team to make sure we are sourcing the best supply from our broker partners, using the whitespace and competitiveness analysis to steer what we ask partners for.

  • Track competitor pricing and deal scores across the market, and turn the picture into clear guidance and priorities for both Procurement and Marketplace.

 

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong analytical skills. Expert in Excel or Sheets, comfortable with BI tooling (Looker, Power BI) and ideally SQL.

  • Comfortable building models and tooling, and adept at using AI tools such as Claude and Cursor to work faster and more accurately.

  • A good grasp of vehicle leasing economics: how a monthly rental is built from residual value, cost of funds, on-the-road price, VAT and commission, and how ratebooks work. We will support the right person in deepening this.

  • High attention to detail and a bias for accuracy, with the discipline to own a daily operational process where errors are visible to Sales and customers.

  • Commercially minded and confident advising a Procurement team, able to turn analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Understanding of how marketplaces work, including the interplay of demand and supply liquidity (desirable).

  • Experience in vehicle leasing, motor finance, or another data-rich commercial or pricing environment (desirable).

  • Based at, or able to work from, our Winnersh office, partnering with Procurement in person.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Video call with a member of our Talent Team to find out more about your experience and why you want to work at Carwow

  • Step 2: 45 mins video-call with the Hiring Manager

  • Step 3: 60 mins in-person interview with the 3 members of our Carwow Leasey team

  • Step 4: Values Interview

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working - minimum 3 days per week in Winnersh

  • Competitive base salary

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

  • Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till kvinna i Kalmar
jobs.description:
Är du en trygg, omtänksam och engagerad person som vill ha ett meningsfullt arbete där du verkligen gör skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

Vi söker nu en personlig assistent till en kvinna i Kalmar som behöver stöd i sin vardag. Du blir en viktig del av hennes liv och en uppskattad medlem i vårt engagerade team.



Om tjänsten

Som personlig assistent hjälper du kunden att leva sitt liv utifrån sina egna önskemål och behov. Du bidrar till att skapa en trygg, aktiv och meningsfull vardag med fokus på självbestämmande, delaktighet och livskvalitet.

En viktig del av arbetet är att arbeta utifrån kundens genomförandeplan och arbetsbeskrivning, där kundens behov, rutiner och mål tydligt framgår. Det är därför viktigt att du är strukturerad, ansvarstagande och har förmåga att följa överenskomna arbetssätt för att skapa trygghet och kontinuitet för kunden.

Arbetstider

Arbetet är förlagt enligt följande:

✅ Dygnspass med sovande jour

✅ 20-timmarspass med sovande jour

✅ 4-timmarspass i samband med aktiviteter, då kunden har dubbelbemanning



Vi söker dig som

✅ Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och har ett genuint intresse för människor

✅ Har erfarenhet av autism, vilket är meriterande

✅ Inte är allergisk mot pälsdjur, då hästar är en naturlig del av kundens vardag

✅ Kan arbeta utifrån genomförandeplan och arbetsbeskrivning för att säkerställa kvalitet, trygghet och kontinuitet



För att skapa en så bra miljö som möjligt för kunden använder vi inte starkt doftande produkter såsom parfym, body mist eller liknande när vi arbetar i kundens hem eller tillsammans med kunden.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som är trygg i dig själv, har ett gott bemötande och kan skapa en positiv och förtroendefull relation.



För denna tjänst krävs att den sökande, vid begäran, uppvisar ett aktuellt utdrag ur Polismyndighetens belastningsregister. Detta är en del av vår rekryteringsprocess.





Om Storsjöbygdens Personliga Assistans AB

Hos oss är personlig assistans verkligen personlig.

Det som gör oss unika är att alla som arbetar på vårt kontor själva har lång erfarenhet av yrket som personlig assistent. Vi vet hur viktigt det är att känna sig trygg, få stöd när det behövs och ha en arbetsgivare som förstår vardagen i assistansen.

Hos oss får du

⭐ Trygga anställningsvillkor genom kollektivavtal med Fremia och Kommunal samt försäkringar och tjänstepension.

⭐ Flexibilitet med möjlighet att arbeta hos flera kunder om du önskar.

⭐ Förmåner såsom möjlighet till förmånscykel och kompetensutveckling.

⭐ Nära stöd och tillgänglighet från ett engagerat kontor som alltid finns nära till hands.

Sedan 2001 har vi byggt vår verksamhet på våra ledord personlighet, erfarenhet, kunskap och tillgänglighet. Hos oss blir du en del av ett företag som bryr sig om både kunder och medarbetare.





Välkommen med din ansökan!





Företagsinformation

Rekryteringsprocess  

Vi kontaktar löpande de kandidater som är aktuella för en första intervju. Tjänsten tillsätts när vi har funnit rätt person, vilket kan ske innan sista ansökningsdag. Din ansökan behandlas av personal på Storsjöbydens personliga assistans, tillsammans med uppdragsgivaren, samt eventuella anhöriga, god man eller andra berörda. Om tjänsten innebär arbete med en minderårig uppdragsgivare krävs ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Barnperspektiv i rekryteringen

Vi på Storsjöbydens personliga assistans följer noggrant Barnkonventionen, vilket innebär att om du söker en tjänst som innebär arbete med minderåriga, kommer rekryteringsprocessen att omfatta specifika steg för att säkerställa att barnets vilja och behov tas i beaktande. Vid anställning där du arbetar med minderårig uppdragsgivare ingår även en utbildning om barnperspektivet.

Anställningsvillkor

Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna styrka din identitet och bevisa att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige. För att kunna signera ditt anställningsavtal och dina tidrapporter krävs att du har ett BankID.

För att säkerställa att vi håller hög kvalitet i assistansen kommer nyanställda att genomgå en webbaserad introduktionsutbildning (ca 1 timme), helst innan anställningens start men senast inom en månad från anställningens början. jobs.description:
Beskrivelse

Utekontakten i Psykisk helsetjeneste for barn og unge, har ledig 100 % fast stilling som oppsøkende miljøterapeut for tiltredelse snarest.

Arbeidstid etter oppsatt arbeidsplan - turnus. Utekontakten bemannes av to oppsøkende miljøterapeuter.

Tjenestens primære oppgave er å forebygge utfordringer med rus og kriminalitet for aldersgruppen 13-18 år på individ-, gruppe- og systemnivå.

Det brukes et bredt spekter av metoder og virkemidler, hvorav det mest sentrale er oppsøkende miljøterapeutisk arbeid. I tillegg oppfølgingsarbeid av enkeltungdom, aktiviteter og tverrfaglig arbeid. 

Fra 01.01.25 ble det gjort en organisasjonsendring i Barne- og familieenheten, der psykisk helsetjeneste nå er sammensatt av familieterapeuter, ungdomsterapeuter, psykolog og oppsøkende miljøterapeuter. Det er også startet et utviklingsarbeid med en mentorordning for barn og ungdom som er lagt til denne tjenesten. Utekontakten ledes av leder for Psykisk helsetjeneste for barn og unge. 

Øvrige tjenester som helsestasjons- og skolehelsetjenesten, ergoterapi- og fysioterapitjenesten, pedagogisk psykologisk tjeneste (PPT) og spesialpedagogisk fagteam (spesialpedagoger og logopeder) er også en del av Barne- og familieenheten.

Psykisk helsetjeneste er sammensatt av ulike fagprofesjoner, som gir mulighet til faglig utvikling i et kompetent fagmiljø der vi bruker hverandres kompetanse og vurdering til det beste for barnet, ungdommen og familien.

Vi søker deg som ønsker å bidra med din faglige kompetanse, engasjement og lyst til å arbeide innen et givende fagfelt. Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å være med og utvikle vår nye tjeneste, og bidra til å gjøre en forskjell for ungdommen. 


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være
  • Relasjons- og tillitsskapende kontaktetablering.
  • Oppsøkende sosialt arbeid på ulike arenaer og til ulike tider.
  • Gi individuell oppfølging og veiledning til ungdom og nettverket deres.
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid og fagutviklingsarbeid.
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre ulike aktiviteter med ungdom.
  • Bidra konstruktivt i arbeidet med organisatoriske løsninger for tjenesten.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det kreves sosialfaglig bachelor.
  • Erfaring med oppsøkende miljøterapeutisk arbeid i Utekontakten.
  • Erfaring med å arbeide med unge i risiko.
  • Gode norske kommunikasjonsferdigheter både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Sertifikat kl. B..

Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til å møte mennesker med varme og respekt.
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og i team. 
  • Har faglig tyngde, stort engasjement og god arbeidskapasitet.
  • Du ser viktigheten av å skape gode relasjoner, og kan jobbe målrettet og strukturert med ungdommens mål og behov.
  • Er raus i møte med ungdommen, medarbeidere og samarbeidspartnere
  • Er fleksibel og innehar evne til omstilling og endring. 

Personlig egnethet og teamets sammensetning vil bli vektlagt høyt i vurderingen. 


Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale.
  • En meningsfull jobb i et godt arbeidsmiljø med høyt faglig fokus og engasjerte kollegaer.
  • Spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen?

Kontakt gjerne Monica Holand Løknes, leder Psykisk helsetjeneste, tlf.  906 78 387 eller e-post monica.holand.loknes@bodo.kommune.no.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20.


Annet

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema.

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis legges ved søknaden. 

Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju.

Dersom du får tilbud om stillingen må gyldig politiattest leveres til leder/tjenestested, jf. Lov om helsepersonell § 20.

Arbeidsplassene i Bodø kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Fast ansatte i Bodø kommune med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsandel oppfordres til å søke.

Bodø kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste iht. Offentlighetsloven § 25 selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale. Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på 6 måneder.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bodø er den ultimate kombinasjonen av kultur og natur, lokalisert midt mellom storslåtte naturperler i regionen rundt. Vi er uredde, har trua, er gode på samhandling og utvikler nye og smarte løsninger.

Våre medarbeidere får det til å skje. En jobb i kommunen er en jobb med mening, hvor det du gjør betyr noe for innbyggerne – og gjør Bodø til et godt sted å leve.

  • Følge opp gjeldende lovverk, vedtak og veiledere

  • Dokumentering, planarbeid og kartlegging

  • Praktiske oppgaver

Er du en som trives i kontakt med mennesker?

Vi ønsker oss miljøterapeuter som er flinke til å skape tillit og gode relasjoner til ungdommen som bor hos oss. For å lykkes med det, ser vi for oss at du som person er tålmodig og forståelsesfull. Du setter alltid mennesket i sentrum, lytter, ser og bygger videre på de gode øyeblikkene til ungdommen.

De som bor her kommer ofte fra en utfordrende livssituasjon, som gjør at de kan oppfatte noe eller reagere på en uforventet måte. Derfor er det viktig at du som person er fleksibel og trygg. Du må kunne omstille deg på kort tid, og du evner å ta dagligdagse utfordringer på strak arm.

Du har en vennlig innstilling og gode samarbeidsevner. Du må trives med å jobbe tett på og sammen med andre mennesker, da dette er en stor del av jobben.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • 3-årig helse- og sosialfaglig høyskoleutdanning; Barnevernspedagog, vernepleier         eller sosionom. Annen treårig høyskoleutdanning kan være aktuelt.

  • Det er ønskelig med traume og rus-kompetanse.

  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker og institusjons arbeid er en fordel.

  • Førerkort kl. B er et krav

  • Det er et krav om politiattest

  • Behersker godt norsk, skriftlig og muntlig(tilsvarende nivå B1)

  • Håndterer elektroniske IKT-verktøy

  • Menn oppfordres til å søke

Hvorfor burde du jobbe hos oss?

Vi kan tilby en meningsfull og givende jobb, der du ser hva din innsats betyr for ungdommen som du jobber med.

Stendi legger stor vekt på å se, høre og lytte til de ansatte. Det er alltid rom for dine innspill, tanker og tilbakemeldinger. Det er fordi vi mener at alle, uansett stilling eller bakgrunn, har noe å bidra med.

Faglig og personlig utvikling for våre ansatte er høyt prioritert hos oss. Derfor legger vi til rette for kursing og oppfølging.

Hos oss får du gode karrieremuligheter i et stort selskap. Vi er opptatt av å bruke våre egne ressurser, og for den rette personen er veien kort til en stilling med mer ansvar. Du blir en del av et sterkt kollegialt miljø, der vi tar vare på og heier på hverandre

Kontaktperson:

Navn: Jeanette Ovesen, Stian Falck, Benjamin stangnes

Tittel: Avdelingsledere

NB! Vær oppmerksom på linker du mottar i forhold til mulig svindelforsøk, vi ber aldri om verifisering med bank ID i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprosessen.

jobs.title: Graafkraan machinist
jobs.description:
Bouwplaatsmachinist

Werven in Duitsland

Wat ga je doen?

Werk mee aan uitdagende energieprojecten in Duitsland en bedien moderne bouwmachines op werven die bijdragen aan de energietransitie.

Je komt terecht bij een sterk groeiend bouwbedrijf dat investeert in mensen, veiligheid en innovatie. Samen met een ervaren team werk je aan grootschalige infrastructuurprojecten die mee vorm geven aan de energievoorziening van morgen.

Als bouwplaatsmachinist voer je graaf- en hijswerkzaamheden uit op werven in Duitsland.

Je bedient verschillende machines, zorgt voor een veilige uitvoering van de werken en draagt bij aan een kwalitatieve oplevering van elk project.

Je bedient graafmachines, hijskranen, bulldozers en andere bouwmachines.
Je voert grondwerken uit, zoals het graven van sleuven en het verplaatsen van grond.
Je helpt mee aan de aanleg van energie-infrastructuur binnen uitdagende projecten.
Je controleert dagelijks je machine en voert het basisonderhoud uit.
Je werkt volgens de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften en hebt oog voor kwaliteit.
Je stemt je werkzaamheden af met je collega's om de planning vlot te realiseren.
Je werkt volgens een rotatiesysteem van 10 dagen in Duitsland, gevolgd door 4 dagen thuis.

Kan je niet wachten om mee te bouwen aan de energietransitie? Solliciteer vandaag nog – we leren je graag kennen! - Vaardigheden:
Je beschikt over de kennis en ervaring nl. en een vakbekwaamheidscertificaat van de VDAB of een ander erkend opleidingscentrum.
Jij hebt ervaring met : hydraulische banden en of rupsgraafkraan, en een roterende verreiker (Merlo)
Je hebt minimum 4 à 5 jaar ervaring.
Zonder attesten voor de functie bouwplaats machinist is er geen mogelijkheid om op te starten als machinist)
Dus Attesten bouwplaats machinist is een must

Je hebt een certificaat VCA-VOL (of je bent bereid het te behalen).
Je bent betrouwbaar, autonoom en zelfstandig.
Je bent flexibel ingesteld.
Fysieke arbeid schrikt je niet af.

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands; Frans en/of Engels is een pluspunt.
Rijbewijs B is een noodzaak

Je bent bereid om in het buitenland te werken. (is een vereiste)
10 dagen buitenland/ 4 dagen thuis

- Attesten:
Rijbewijs B is een must
Vakbekwaamheid of opleidingsattest bouwplaats machinist (graafkraan, banden en rupskranen) is een must !
VCA -VOL attest of willen behalen voor opstart

- Opleidingsvereisten:
Opleiding bouwplaatsmachinst

- Vakkennis:
Een aantal jaren ervaring als bouwplaatsmachinist, graafwerken zowel met banden en rupskraan : kabels en leidingen

- Talenkennis:
Nederlands : zeer goede kennis en
Frans : goede kennis en of Engels : goede kennis

jobs.title: Simac - Field Network Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor onze klant in de farmaceutische sector in de regio Boxmeer zijn we op zoek naar een Field Network Support Engineer.
In deze rol werk je hands-on aan de netwerk- en datacenterinfrastructuur op meerdere locaties. Je bent vooral verantwoordelijk voor het fysieke netwerk: patching, bekabeling, rack & stack, hardwarewissels en het begeleiden van werkzaamheden op locatie.
Je werkt nauw samen met regionale en globale netwerkteams. De netwerkconfiguratie wordt centraal beheerd; je hebt voornamelijk read-access en voert zelf geen configuratiewijzigingen uit.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Ondersteunen van de netwerk- en datacenterinfrastructuur op 6 locaties: Boxmeer, De Bilt, Stevensbeek, Gennep, OSS en Beugen
  • Rack & stack van switches, servers en andere netwerkapparatuur in Ser- en Lcr-ruimtes
  • Patching en afpatchen van UTP en fiber en zorgen voor een nette, overzichtelijke bekabeling
  • Labelen en documenteren van bekabeling, netwerkapparatuur en wijzigingen
  • Vervangen, verplaatsen en installeren van netwerk- en serverapparatuur
  • Ondersteunen van globale netwerkteams bij iOS-updates en de uitrol van nieuwe netwerkapparatuur
  • Console access voorzien en configuratietemplates aanleveren aan de globale netwerkteams
  • Begeleiden van externe partijen wanneer zij werkzaamheden aan de netwerk- en datacenterinfrastructuur uitvoeren
  • Assisteren bij het troubleshooten van fysieke netwerkproblemen en infrastructuurissues
  • Bijhouden van asset- en infrastructuurdocumentatie volgens de geldende standaarden

Belangrijk om te weten

  • Dit is geen klassieke Network Engineer-rol waarbij je dagelijks netwerkconfiguraties ontwerpt of beheert. De configuratie van de netwerkomgeving wordt centraal vanuit globale teams uitgevoerd.
  • We zoeken daarom vooral iemand met een praktische, hands-on achtergrond in DataCenter- of infrastructuursupport, die zich verder heeft ontwikkeld richting networking. Iemand die energie krijgt van het fysiek installeren, patchen, vervangen en onderhouden van netwerkapparatuur en infrastructuur en die het leuk vindt om ervoor te zorgen dat alles op locatie correct en netjes wordt uitgevoerd.
  • Een kandidaat die vooral als pure Network Engineer werkt en gewend is om zelfstandig complexe netwerkconfiguraties te beheren, zal waarschijnlijk minder goed tot zijn recht komen in deze functie.
  • Je hebt ervaring met hands-on IT-infrastructuur of DataCenter support en bent vanuit die ervaring doorgegroeid richting networking
  • Je hebt een goede basiskennis van switching, routing en enterprise netwerk-infrastructuur
  • Je hebt praktische ervaring met rack & stack, patching en netwerkbekabeling
  • Je kent UTP (Cat5/6/6a/7) en fiber (single-mode/multi-mode) en weet hoe je bekabeling netjes en overzichtelijk afwerkt
  • Ervaring met Cisco is een plus; kennis van Arista is interessant aangezien de omgeving momenteel evolueert van Cisco richting Arista
  • Ervaring met iOS-updates en console access is mooi meegenomen
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor documentatie, labeling en asset management
  • Je kunt zelfstandig op locatie werken en schakelt vlot met regionale, globale en externe teams
  • Eigen vervoer is gewenst om de verschillende locaties te kunnen ondersteunen

jobs.title: Kwaliteitscontroleur (Hightech industrie)
jobs.description:
Kwaliteitscontroleur – Outgoing Goods
Regio Eindhoven | Fulltime

Over het bedrijf

Onze klant is een vooraanstaand hightech productiebedrijf in de regio Eindhoven, gespecialiseerd in de systeemintegratie van mechatronische (sub)systemen en modules voor OEM's van hightech kapitaalgoederen, en daarnaast actief op het gebied van productiemechanisatie. Als systeemleverancier bieden zij de volledige waardeketen: van (co-)ontwerp en onderdelenproductie tot montage, kwaliteitscontrole en testen. Wat hen onderscheidt is de combinatie van diepgaande technische kennis en echt vakmanschap. Ze omarmen nieuwe technologieën en uitdagingen, grijpen de kansen om werkelijk het verschil te maken en streven altijd naar het beste resultaat.

Over de functie

Als kwaliteitscontroleur bij de outgoing goods control speel je een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de productkwaliteit. Dat lukt door een sterke samenwerking tussen de montage en de kwaliteitscontroleurs. Samen zorg je ervoor dat producten altijd voldoen aan de hoogste kwaliteitseisen. Door open communicatie en teamwork los je problemen snel op en verbetert de kwaliteit continu. Je borgt de kwaliteit richting de klanten en zorgt ervoor dat de monteurs zonder verstoringen kunnen doorwerken.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden:

  • Uitvoeren van controles op uitgaande goederen volgens technische tekeningen, inclusief materiaalsoort, maatvoering en reinheid
  • Visuele controle van producten en verpakkingen, en controle op beschadigingen
  • Controleren en archiveren van de bijbehorende documentatie op juistheid en volledigheid

Wat je meebrengt

  • Je bent sterk en besluitvaardig
  • Mbo-niveau 3 werk- en denkniveau
  • Beschikbaar in dagdienst, met bereidheid tot werken in 2-ploegendienst

jobs.title: Vi søker engasjerte og arbeidsomme
jobs.employer: FRETEX MILJØ AS AVD BUTIKK LILLEHAMMER
jobs.description:
Vi trenger engasjerte og arbeidsomme butikkmedarbeidere til vår secondhandbutikk på Lillehammer. 

Butikken selger brukte klær, interiør, bøker, leker, sport og fritid. Butikken har eget gavemottak med sortering.

Butikken ligger godt plassert i Storgata på Lillehammer og har en økende kundestrøm.

Vi trenger en vikar 50% (ca ett års varighet), som kan bli en del av teamet og kan bidra til å utvikle butikken ytterligere.

Vi trenger i tillegg en butikkmedarbeider i midlertidig stilling (ca ett års varighet) med annenhver lørdag og 1-2 ettermiddager i uken.

Vi trenger lagspillere med godt humør som ønsker å skape en attraktiv butikk for dagens kunder og givere. 

 

  Du:

  • er glad i folk og trygg på deg selv 
  • er opptatt av kundeservice og ser og utvikler salgsmuligheter
  • kan bidra til et bærekraftig gavemottak og sortering
  • har kunnskap om og kan presentere brukte varer 
  • er pådriver for aktiv bruk av sosiale medier og eventer i butikk
  • har interesse for, og kunnskap om trender, gjenbruk og miljø
  • har god arbeidskapasitet og liker fysiske arbeidsoppgaver
  • har erfaring fra butikk, og er lærevillig.
  • er ryddig og strukturt
  • er trygg på bruk av PC og mobil som arbeidsverktøy
  • kan jobbe selvstendig
  • behersker norsk skriftlig og muntlig
  • personlig egnethet vektlegges.
  • Førerkort er en fordel.
  • har evne og vilje til å arbeide i samsvar med Frelsesarmeens verdigrunnlag

Vi tilbyr:

  • en grønn arbeidsplass hvor du bidrar til, økt gjenbruk, og Frelsesarmeens sosiale arbeid.
  • et spennende og hektisk arbeidsmiljø
  • faglig utfordring med god variasjon i oppgaver.
  • en jobb med utviklingsmuligheter for rette person
  • lønn etter avtale
  • pensjonsordning

 

Fretex eies av Frelsesarmeen, og vi arbeider utfra et kristent verdigrunnlag. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

 Søknadsfrist: Søknadene blir vurdert fortløpende.

Tiltredelse: Etter avtale

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fretex-gruppen som eies av Frelsesarmeen, er organisert som et konsern. Fretex skal bidra til at mennesker får og beholder arbeid og bidra til et bedre miljø gjennom blant annet gjenbruk. Vår visjon er å gi folk grunn til å tro på framtiden. Våre kjerneverdier er åpenhet, kjærlighet, engasjement og lønnsomhet.

jobs.title: Liker du aktivitet og gaming? Da kan vi bli et bra team!
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD TROMS OG FINNMARK
jobs.description:
Ledig stilling på Finnsnes og noen ganger i Fjordgård:

Jeg er en blid, omsorgsfull og glad gutt på 15 år som har et dreamteam av BPAer. Nå har jeg flyttet på hybel for å gå på videregående og søker flere BPAer. Jeg håper du vil være en del av teamet. Selv om jeg bor på hybel på Finnsnes, vil det være helger og ferier hvor jeg reiser hjem til Fjordgård og da vil jeg trenge assistent der også.

På fritiden liker jeg å være sammen med venner, gaming, fisketurer, bilturer og bueskyting. Jeg har interesse før veteranbiler og er glad i fart og spenning.

Jeg bruker rullestol og er avhengig av mye hjelp i min hverdag. Jeg trenger BPAer som kan hjelpe meg med diverse praktiske ting i hverdagen. Dette innebærer alt fra personlig stell og forflytning, assistanse på aktiviteter og trening, og med husarbeid. Som assistent får du også delta på de mer spennende tingene vi finner på underveis.

Som min BPA er det viktig at du er en varm og omsorgsfull person, men det blir mye gøyere hvis du også har humor og kan tulle litt. Jeg kan nok ha behov for at du er god til å motivere meg til mer aktivitet i hverdagen. En gang i blandt kan vi mellom anna dra på Tromsøbadet eller Polarbadet, og ellers finne på kjekke ting. Vi har bil vi kan bruke som passer med rullestolen min.

Arbeidstid:
- dag, aften og hvilende nattevakt, samt helg. 

Stillinger av forskjellige størrelser ledig: 

  • Skriv i søknaden hvilke arbeidstider du kan jobbe og hvor stor stilling du ser etter, så finner vi ut av hva som passer.
  • Det er også behov for tilkallingsassistenter som kan komme på kort varsel.

Krav til stillingen:
- Sertifikat kl. B
- Plettfri vandel
- gode norskspråklig ferdigheter
- Ikke allergisk mot katter

Ansettelser skjer fortløpende, så ikke vent med å søke.
Høres dette interessant ut? Håper på å høre fra deg!

 


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Senior Innovation Consultant
jobs.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

PNO Innovation UK is looking for an experienced Senior Innovation Consultant / Senior Grant Writer to lead complex Horizon Europe proposals and advise innovative organisations on their funding strategies.

This is a genuinely senior role combining approximately 60% grant writing and 40% innovation consultancy. You will work independently with clients, technical experts and international consortium partners, transforming ambitious scientific and technological concepts into compelling, competitive proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Your mission is to help innovative organisations secure European funding and turn promising ideas into impactful collaborative projects. You will guide clients from initial opportunity assessment and project concept development through to the preparation and submission of high-quality Horizon Europe proposals.

As a trusted advisor, you will combine exceptional writing skills with strategic insight, technical curiosity and strong client leadership.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead complex Horizon Europe proposals from initial strategy and concept development through to final submission.
  • Write and review Excellence, Impact and Implementation sections, ensuring a clear, persuasive and evaluator-focused narrative.
  • Develop project structures, work packages, deliverables, milestones, budgets and implementation plans.
  • Coordinate international consortia, technical contributors and other stakeholders throughout the proposal process.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Advise clients on funding opportunities, programme positioning, call requirements and long-term funding strategies.
  • Translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, compelling and commercially relevant applications.
  • Manage senior client relationships, challenge assumptions and provide confident strategic recommendations.
  • Support business development while mentoring colleagues and reviewing and improving the quality of their work.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience in grant writing, innovation consultancy, European funding or a closely related field.
  • Extensive, hands-on experience with Horizon Europe and/or Horizon 2020 proposals.
  • A strong track record of independently leading competitive proposals from concept to submission.
  • Genuine consulting experience, including ownership of client relationships and complex assignments.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.
  • Strong scientific, technical or innovation literacy and the curiosity to understand unfamiliar technologies quickly.
  • Ability to work credibly across sectors such as life sciences, health, agrifood, bio-based industries, energy, environment and industrial innovation.
  • A highly autonomous, commercially aware and collaborative approach, together with the right to work in the UK.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Join a specialist innovation consultancy with extensive experience in European research and innovation funding.
  • Work on ambitious international projects addressing major scientific, industrial and societal challenges.
  • Take genuine ownership of important clients and complex Horizon Europe assignments.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Collaborate with experienced consultants and innovation experts across PNO Innovation’s European network.
  • Contribute to the continued development of PNO Innovation UK and help shape how we support our clients.
  • Benefit from a competitive salary of £55,000–£65,000, with flexibility above the stated range for an exceptional candidate whose experience and seniority strongly align with the role.

jobs.description: ZDRAVSTVENI TEHNIK (BOLJ ZAHTEVNA DELA), poskusno delo 2 meseca, Določen čas, 12 mesecev oz. 12 mesecev z možnostjo podaljšanja za nedoločen čas, polni delovni čas, 40, IZVAJANJE OSNOVNE ZDRAVSTVENE NEGE BOLNIKA IN ZAHTEVNIH POSTOPKOV ZDRAVSTVENE NEGE, SPREJEM, NAMESTITEV IN ODPUST BOLNIKA, NADZOR NAD IZVEDBO DNEVNE TERAPIJE, SKRB ZA UREJENOST BOLNIKA/STANOVALCA, NJEGOVE OKOLICE ZDRAVSTVENO-VZGOJNO IN VARSTVENO DELO TER USPOSABLJANJE BOLNIKA PRI OPRAVLJANJU DNEVNIH AKTIVNOSTI TER DRUGA DELA PO NAVODILU NADREJENE OSEBE., Če verjamete, da zdravstvena nega ni le poklic, ampak poslanstvo, vas vabimo v našo družbo dobrega počutja. Pri nas ne boste le opravljali dela — soustvarjali boste varno, spoštljivo in srčno okolje za ljudi, ki potrebujejo pomoč, podporo in razumevanje. Vaše delo bo obsegalo: izvajanje zdravstvene nege na negovalnem oddelku, spremljanje zdravstvenega stanja pacientov, sodelovanje v strokovnem in povezanem timu, ustvarjanje občutka varnosti, zaupanja in dostojanstva. Iščemo osebo, ki: ima strokovno znanje in odgovoren pristop do dela, opravljeno pripravništvo, zna prisluhniti človeku in delati s srcem, ceni timsko sodelovanje in medsebojno pomoč, želi svoje znanje razvijati in nadgrajevati. Kaj vas čaka pri nas? Delo z namenom in občutkom, da prispevate nekaj pomembnega, podpora sodelavcev in prijetno delovno okolje, mentorstvo in pomoč pri uvajanju, možnosti dodatnih izobraževanj in strokovne rasti, stabilna zaposlitev in koriščenje bogatih ugodnosti za zaposlene družbe Thermane.,

jobs.title: Sosial dame i Arendal søker fleksible BPA-assistenter
jobs.description:
Jeg er en godt voksen dame som bor i den fine byen Arendal. Jeg er blind, og trenger derfor tilrettelegging for å leve det livet jeg ønsker. Her kommer du som assistent inn i bildet, slik at vi sammen kan lage en god hverdag for meg. Jeg bor i en leilighet for meg selv hvor jeg trenger hjelp til daglige oppgaver. Jeg er sosial og ofte på farta, derfor trenger jeg en assistent som kan bli med rundt. Arbeidstiden vil være både dagtid og kveldstid i ukedagene, og av og til helg. Jeg er på utkikk etter to fleksible tilkallingsvikarer.


Jeg trenger blant annet assistanse til:  

  • Daglige gjøremål og husarbeid 
  • Tilrettelegging ved sosiale aktiviteter 
  • Bistå ved matlaging 
  • Gåturer 


Hvem er du jeg søker etter: 

  • Du er en dame, med humor og godt humør 
  • Fleksibel 
  • Liker å lage mat 
  • Glad i dyr (siden jeg jobber på et kattehus) 
  • Har førerkort og bil  


Hva tilbyr jeg: 

  • En meningsfull og motiverende jobb 
  • God opplæring 
  • Humor 
  • Egen kontaktperson i Prima Assistanse 
  • Kurs og opplæring som trygger deg i rollen som assistent 
  • Lønn etter tariff 

Dersom du synes dette høres interessant ut, så hører jeg gjerne fra deg. Ikke nøl med å sende inn søknad, intervjuer vil gjennomføres fortløpende

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: En søt jente på 12 år ønsker tilkallingsassistenter til sin BPA-ordning 🌟
jobs.description:
Jeg er en sosial, glad jente som sitter i rullestol, og trenger derfor noen til å være mine armer og ben i hverdagen. Jeg bor i et tilrettelagt hjem i Åros (Asker kommune) sammen med mamma, pappa og lillesøster. Jeg er veldig glad i lek, IPad og matlaging.

Jeg ser etter tilkallingsassistener som kan bidra ved sykdom og under ferieavvikling. Vaktene hos meg er på morgen i hverdager før jeg drar på skolen, på ettermiddager/kveld i ukedagene og dag/kveld/natt (våken) i helger.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være følgende:

· Bistand til personlig hygiene, inkl. av/på kledning og toalettbesøk.

· Forflytning

· Bistand til lekser, lek og aktiviteter som svømming og terapiridning.

· Hjelpe meg til å delta i det sosiale med venner

Personlige egenskaper og kompetanse vi setter pris på:

· sosial og glad i lek

· selvstendig og selvgående

· Har erfaring fra å jobbe med mennesker, men det er ikke et krav

· Er presis i forhold til avtaler

· Ønsker å stå i stillingen over tid

· Har forståelse for at arbeidsstedet er hjemmet til meg og min familie

· Ønskelig at du innehar førerkort, men kollektiv transport kan benyttes

· Må ikke være allergisk mot katt/hund/hest

Stendi Assistanse tilbyr:

  • Personlig rådgiver og oppfølging

  • Lønn etter tariff, grunnlønn: 225,40,-/t

  • Kveldstillegg: 60,-/t

  • Helgetillegg: 57,-/t

  • Forsikring

  • Grundig opplæring, relevante kurs og opplæring

  • Bedriftsavtale på SATS

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stendi Assistanse er et av Norges største leverandører av assistanse- og hjemmetjenester til mennesker med hjelpebehov. Vi leverer tjenester på vegne av det offentlige. Gjennom vårt arbeid ønsker vi å gjøre verden litt bedre, ett menneske av gangen. Sammen med våre oppdragsgivere skaper vi en trygg omsorg som ivaretar alle!

Vi har et landsdekkende tjenestetilbud innen brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og hjemmebaserte tjenester.

jobs.title: FP&A & Performance Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen.

Gute Entscheidungen beginnen mit belastbaren Zahlen, klaren KPIs und einem realistischen Blick nach vorn. Als FP&A Manager verbindest du Unternehmensplanung, Projektperformance und Management Reporting zu einer aussagekräftigen Steuerungslogik. Du analysierst nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern machst früh sichtbar, wo Handlungsbedarf und neue Chancen entstehen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die integrierte Fünfjahresplanung der ju:niz-Gruppe und entwickelst sie laufend weiter.
  • Strategische Ziele übersetzt du in belastbare Finanzpläne, Szenarien und relevante Steuerungsgrößen.
  • Ein integriertes Finanzmodell für GuV, Bilanz, Cashflow, Capex, Finanzierung und Liquidität baust du auf und pflegst es eigenständig.
  • Unternehmens- und Projektbewertungen sowie Sensitivitäts- und Szenarioanalysen erstellst du fundiert und adressatengerecht.
  • Mit Strategy arbeitest du eng an strategischen Optionen, Wachstumsinitiativen und Managemententscheidungen.
  • Auf Gruppen- und Portfolioebene entwickelst und überwachst du zentrale KPIs. Projektbezogene POC-Informationen konsolidierst du für das Performance Management und machst wesentliche Werttreiber, Chancen und Risiken frühzeitig sichtbar.
  • Geschäftsführung und Management unterstützt du mit aussagekräftigen Reports, Analysen und Entscheidungsunterlagen für die finanzielle und strategische Steuerung.
  • Planungs- und Bewertungsannahmen stimmst du mit den Fachbereichen ab und professionalisierst unsere FP&A-, Reporting- und Analyseprozesse.
  • Als Business Partner arbeitest du eng mit CFO, Management sowie unseren Projekt- und Investmentteams zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance, Accounting oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.
  • Drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Business Controlling, Transaction Advisory oder einer führenden Unternehmens- beziehungsweise Strategieberatung passen gut zu dieser Rolle.
  • Projektgeschäft, komplexe Business Cases und idealerweise ein Private-Equity-, Scale-up-, Infrastruktur- oder Energieumfeld sind dir vertraut.
  • P&L, Bilanz und Cashflow denkst du integriert; Budgetierung, Management Reporting, KPI-Steuerung und POC-basierte Projektanalysen beherrschst du sicher.
  • Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und überzeugst in Financial Modelling, IRR- und Bewertungslogiken; Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics oder LucaNet ist ein Plus.
  • Du kombinierst analytische Tiefe mit unternehmerischem Denken, klarer Kommunikation und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Deutsch sprichst du fließend und Englisch sicher. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit CFO und Fachbereichen arbeitest du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München.

Warum wir?

  • Eine sichtbare Rolle im Zentrum der Unternehmenssteuerung mit direktem Zugang zu CFO und Management.
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau moderner FP&A- und Performance-Management-Strukturen.
  • Schnelle Lernkurve durch anspruchsvolle Business Cases und investitionsintensive BESS-Projekte.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Eigenverantwortung und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Analysen Konsequenzen haben.
  • Flexible Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßiger Präsenz und engem fachlichen Austausch im Team.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

Dein Ansprechpartner
Moritz Erlbeck
People Growth & Hiring Lead

jobs.title: Project Manager  Handheld  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Our Project Management Office (PMO) is tasked with delivering product development projects on time, with the right scope, right cost and quality. You will be part of the team delivering to Handheld which includes both professional and residential products.  

Working at PMO means belonging to the competence center for Project Management and you will be surrounded by other professional Project Management colleagues, offering a great opportunity to further develop your skills.

Role Description

Within your role as a Project Manager you will lead one or more cross functional product development projects which are delivering innovative, high quality products to meet the expectations of our demanding users.  

Your main tasks will be to; 

    Plan and lead all high level activities throughout the projects from Project initiation to closure, typically one year after launch.
    Report Project status, formulate recommendations and seek decisions from the Steering Committee.
    Work proactively with all relevant stakeholders, make sure the necessary communication flows freely.
    Formulate and manage solutions to Project deviations together with your team.

Your profile

You are analytical and have the ability to boil down complex issues to the essentials. You are organized, thorough and reliable with the ability to regularly shift focus from a detailed to high level view. You are a highly driven problem solver who always looks for solutions with a positive approach. You also have:

    At least 5 years of relevant experience; managing teams, planning, budgeting, financial follow-up, risk management etc
    Previous experience of managing cross functional projects, preferably within product development, with a proven strong track record.
    Strong communication & presentation skills (fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken).
    Ability to successfully manage and deliver complex projects in a multi market/language set-up with multiple stakeholders internally and externally

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Joakim Andersson joakim.p.andersson@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture 

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes: 

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 

Learn more about our culture here.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Temporary Position, approximately 12 Months)
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner (Temporary Position, approximately 12 Months)

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.



Help us attract the talent that shapes the future of mining and metals

Your opportunity

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our team on a temporary assignment of approximately 12 months. In this role, you will play an important part in supporting our leaders and businesses by attracting, assessing, and hiring the talent needed to drive Boliden forward.



Who you will work with

You will be part of our Talent Acquisition team and work closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues, and candidates throughout the recruitment journey. The position can be based in Kiruna, Gällivare, Luleå, Piteå or Skellefteå. Since the role supports our operations in Aitik, you should be prepared to spend time on site in Gällivare, approximately 2-3 days per week or every other week, depending on business needs and recruitment activities.



What you will do

    Lead recruitment processes from workforce planning and requirement analysis through to hiring
    Partner with managers and provide guidance throughout the recruitment process
    Deliver a professional, inclusive, and high-quality candidate experience
    Collaborate closely with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across the organization
    Ensure recruitment processes are conducted in a structured, fair, and competency-based way



What you bring

    A university degree in HR or a related field, or equivalent experience
    Experience within recruitment, talent acquisition, or talent sourcing
    Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills
    The ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously while maintaining quality and structure
    Experience working with digital recruitment tools and systems
    Professional working proficiency in both Swedish and English, as the role involves close collaboration with managers, candidates, and stakeholders across the business
    B-Driver license



To succeed in this role

You are proactive, well-organized, and able to build trust with people at all levels of the organization. You enjoy working collaboratively while taking ownership of your responsibilities, and you are motivated by helping both candidates and hiring managers achieve successful outcomes.



Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.



Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager, Helena Widenlou via email to Helena.widenlou@boliden.com



For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, Saco 073-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, 070- 541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, 0910-77 40 09.



Last day to apply: 13th of September. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to apply.



As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks may be included in the recruitment process.



If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.
