Moulding Technician Pale Blue Dot Recruitment is advertising this vacancy on behalf of MeHow Medical Ireland. Position Overview MeHow Medical Ireland is seeking a skilled Moulding Technician to join its manufacturing team in Bray, Co. Wicklow. The role is responsible for technical set-up, operation, process control, troubleshooting and support of injection moulding equipment to achieve defined production and quality standards. Key Responsibilities • Set up, operate and control injection moulding machines and related equipment. • Monitor and adjust temperature, pressure, cycle times and other process settings to optimise process stability and output. • Identify process variations and troubleshoot equipment or production issues to minimise downtime. • Conduct equipment inspections and carry out routine and preventive maintenance. • Inspect moulded components for defects, dimensional accuracy and surface quality. • Use calipers, micrometers and gauges to verify product conformity. • Document quality issues, support corrective actions and maintain accurate production and quality records. • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, documented procedures and company quality requirements. • Apply practical knowledge of moulding processes and materials when investigating production or quality issues. • Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. • Support robotic automation and auxiliary manufacturing equipment where required. • Contribute to process stability, equipment performance, product quality and continuous improvement. • Work with production, quality, maintenance and other cross-functional teams. • Follow all health and safety procedures and safely handle production materials and equipment. Required Qualifications & Experience • 2+ years of technical experience supporting injection moulding machinery or similar manufacturing equipment, including machine set-up, process adjustment, troubleshooting and/or maintenance. • Strong practical understanding of injection moulding processes, materials and quality standards. • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. • Strong mechanical aptitude and practical troubleshooting capability. • Experience using calipers, micrometers and gauges. • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving and communication skills. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. • Flexibility to work shifts, including nights and weekends. Preferred • Technical certification in plastics technology, manufacturing or a related industrial discipline. • Experience with Engel, Arburg, Sumitomo Demag or Battenfeld equipment. • Experience with robotic automation and auxiliary equipment. • Exposure to Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma. Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy.  Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

Responsibilities

As a Regional Customer Success Manager for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region.  The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products.  The Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.  

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:

-Cultivate a strong customer partnership through a deep understanding of their business and managing customer health and value realization during network product launch and post-sale

-Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products  

-Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them

Growing the Business:

-Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products

-Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings

-Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data

Technical & Program Readiness:

-Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition  

-Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

-Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products

All About You:

-Skilled at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage

-Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus

-Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability

-Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

-Proficient experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth

-Successful track record of identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties

-Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges

-Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level

-Advanced experience working with both large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners

jobs.title: PA/QA Engineer  Harness & Electrical Assembly | Space Industry
jobs.description:
Job Description

The client is seeking a PA/QA Engineer specializing in Harness & Electrical Assembly to support high-reliability electrical hardware within the space industry. The position focuses on workmanship inspection, electrical harness quality, and Product Assurance/Quality Assurance activities in accordance with ECSS and relevant IPC standards.

The successful candidate will have a strong practical understanding of electrical harness systems, including routing, shielding, integration, assembly, soldering, and crimping. The role carries significant responsibility for workmanship acceptance and quality decisions in a high-reliability space environment.

Key Responsibilities

    Inspect and approve soldered electrical assemblies and connections in accordance with ECSS-Q-ST-70-61.
    Monitor and provide quality support for crimping and electrical harness assembly activities following ECSS-Q-ST-70-26.
    Serve as the inspection authority for soldering, crimping, electrical assemblies, and harness workmanship, including making accept/reject quality decisions.
    Provide guidance and practical support to ECSS-certified operators regarding workmanship and applicable quality requirements.
    Work with Category 3 soldering and Category 2/3 crimping activities and support operators in maintaining required standards.
    Track, support, and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in line with applicable ECSS procedures.
    Coordinate with engineering, production, suppliers, subcontractors, customers, and Product Assurance/Quality Assurance teams.
    Ensure electrical hardware and harness assemblies meet the required reliability, workmanship, and quality standards.
    Contribute to inspection planning, quality assurance, testing, and validation activities where required.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

    Certification for inspection of soldered electrical assemblies according to ECSS-Q-ST-70-61 – Inspector Level, Category 2/3.
    Alternatively, certification in IPC J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, or IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 3, combined with demonstrated inspection authority.
    Ability and willingness to obtain ECSS Inspector Category 2/3 certification where applicable.
    Practical understanding of electrical harness design and routing principles.
    Knowledge of cable routing, shielding, harness integration, and electrical component assembly.
    Basic understanding of electrical systems and schematics is desirable.
    Knowledge of relevant ECSS-Q-ST-20 quality assurance principles.
    Familiarity with ECSS-Q-ST-10 Product Assurance Management.
    Understanding of ECSS-Q-ST-10-09 non-conformance control and NCR management.
    Knowledge of the ECSS-Q-ST-70 series covering materials, mechanical parts, and processes.
    Working knowledge of ECSS-Q-ST-70-26 for crimping.
    Familiarity with IPC-A-610 for electronic assemblies.
    Knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 for cable and wire harness workmanship.
    Experience or knowledge in inspection planning, quality assurance, testing, and validation.

Desired Competencies

    Quality Assurance and Product Assurance
    Harness Design and IPC Cabling Standards
    Electrical/Electronics Assembly Inspection
    Soldering and Crimping Inspection
    Inspection Planning
    Test & Validation
    Electronics Systems
    Communication Technology
    Process & Production Engineering
    Plant Engineering and Piping
    Space Industry / Space Hardware
    APQP Planning and Product Approval

Personal Attributes

    Excellent attention to detail and commitment to high-quality workmanship.
    Practical, hands-on approach to inspection and problem solving.
    Ability to train, guide, and mentor technical personnel.
    High level of integrity when making quality-related decisions.
    Confident and consistent judgement when determining workmanship acceptance or rejection.
    Strong ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

Application Method: Interested candidates can apply by sending their profile to hr@semiconservicenordic.com

jobs.title: Construction Manager
jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Placement: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Construction Manager for our Construction team. In this role you will report to our Head of Site Execution and work within our Project Delivery function. The team is responsible for executing construction activities on site, ensuring safe, high-quality, and on-schedule delivery across multiple work fronts.

As Construction Manager, you will drive day-to-day field execution within your assigned area. You will coordinate contractors, ensure work readiness, and maintain momentum on site while resolving issues and keeping teams aligned with project priorities.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    

Drive daily construction activities to ensure alignment with safety, quality, and schedule targets

    

Maintain short-term lookahead plans (3–6 weeks) to secure readiness of materials, resources, and access

    

Coordinate with EPCM and contractors to track progress, constraints, and execution priorities

    

Validate work readiness, ensuring permits, drawings, materials, and resources are in place

    

Identify and resolve field issues, clashes, and productivity barriers

    

Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards

    

Participate in coordination meetings, site walkdowns, and SIMOPS planning

    

Provide clear updates on progress, risks, and upcoming needs to the Area Construction Manager

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    

Experience in construction execution within large-scale industrial or infrastructure projects, with a strong preference of previous experience in steel mill construction

    

Strong understanding of field coordination, sequencing, and construction practices

    

Experience working with contractors, EPCM, and multiple work fronts on site

    

Ability to manage short-term planning and lookahead scheduling

    

Solid knowledge of safety standards, work readiness processes, and quality requirements

    

Strong communication and coordination skills across teams and stakeholders

    

Ability to solve problems and make decisions in a fast-paced environment

    

A proactive and hands-on approach with strong presence on site

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

Boden Video

jobs.title: Har du lyst til å være med meg på reiser og konserter? Da er kanskje du min nye assistent
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Jeg er en jente på 21 år med en medfødt diagnose, som gjør at jeg bruker rullestol. Det stopper likevel ikke meg! En ting jeg virkelig elsker, er å dra på konserter - men jeg er også en aktiv jente! Jeg trener jevnlig på treningsstudio, og ønsker å oppleve verden. Jeg drar også jevnlig på hockeykamper

Med meg kan du være på jobb, samtidig som du får ta del i hockey-universet, reiser og konserter. Det er det ikke mange som får oppleve!

 

Jeg disponerer egen bil, så det er en stor fordel med førerkortklasse B manuell

 

Nå som jeg er ferdig på skolen har jeg både tid og lyst til å reise og oppleve nye steder i verden. Kanskje du også vil være med meg på denne reisen? Søk da vel!

Arbeidstiden vil som regel være på ettermiddag og kveld, men det kan også være behov på dagtid. Jeg søker både assistenter til fast stilling og tilkalling, så skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mye du ser for deg å jobbe.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Være med på konserter 
  • Være med på hockeykamper
  • Være med på reiser
  • Bistå på sykehusbesøk
  • Enkelt personlig stell

 

Personlige egenskaper:

-         Tålmodig

-         Imøtekommen

-         Initiativrik

-         Fleksibel

-         Det er ikke behov for helsefaglig utdanning. Eventuell opplæring vil bli gitt.

-         Kjemi og personlige egenskaper vektlegges

-         Gyldig politiattest

-         Gode norskkunnskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

 

Hva tilbyr jeg?

-         En motiverende og meningsfull arbeidsdag

-         Inkluderende og avslappet arbeidsforhold

-         Morsom og varierende arbeidsdager

-         God opplæring og oppfølging som trygger deg i rollen som assistent

-         Konkurransedyktig lønn i henhold til tariff

-         Ansettelse vil være i Prima Assistanse, hvor du får egen kontaktperson og assistentkurs.

 

Jeg håper du søker, og jeg ser frem til en prat med deg! Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende. 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

We are currently looking for 5–8 experienced Construction Carpenters to join various construction projects in Stavanger.

As a Construction Carpenter at Adecco, you will have the opportunity to work on different projects and in various working environments. We are therefore looking for candidates who are independent, flexible and able to adapt to the requirements of different projects.

Your responsibilities

  • Interior carpentry work

  • Installation of drywall

  • Construction of partition walls

  • Insulation work

  • Exterior carpentry and façade work

  • General carpentry and construction duties

  • Working according to technical drawings and project requirements

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Construction Carpenter

  • Experience with interior and/or exterior carpentry work

  • English or Norwegian language skills

  • Ability to work independently

  • Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

  • Available to start ASAP

  • Driving licence is not required

  • A D-number is not required – Adecco can assist with obtaining one if necessary

What we offer

  • Attractive salary

  • Guaranteed minimum of 37.5 hours per week

  • Possibility to work additional hours, up to 50 hours per week, depending on the project

  • Possibility of 50% or 100% employment, depending on the available project

  • No fixed rotation system

  • Single-room accommodation

  • Accommodation approximately NOK 6,000–6,500 per month

  • Commuting to work by public transport

  • NOK 1,500 reimbursement for your first ticket to Norway

  • Continuous support from your Adecco consultant

  • Opportunity to work on various projects in the Stavanger area

About you

We are looking for experienced and independent carpenters who take pride in the quality of their work. Responsibility, accuracy and the ability to cooperate with colleagues are important to us.

Experience from Norway is an advantage but is not required.

We also offer

We provide competitive employment conditions, flexibility and professional support throughout your assignment.

  • Flexible and varied projects

  • Opportunity to gain valuable experience in the Norwegian labour market

  • Access to Adecco's benefits programme

  • Salary paid every 14 days

  • Client training when required

  • Continuous follow-up and support from your Adecco consultant

If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter:

Natalia Janeczek
natalia.janeczek@adecco.no
+48 726 008 495

We look forward to receiving your application!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Adecco er et av Norges ledende rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskap. Hvert år hjelper vi hundrevis av mennesker til å finne en ny jobb. På kundelisten har vi attraktive bedrifter som trenger kompetente kandidater til spennende oppdrag. Siden oppstarten av selskapet 1948 (Norsk Kontaktservice) har Adecco ansatt hundretusenvis av mennesker i en rekke forskjellige bransjer i hele Norge.

Med over 35 kontorer fra Hammerfest i nord til Kristiansand i sør kan du føle deg trygg på at vi har god kunnskap om ditt lokale marked.

jobs.title: Asfaltmedarbejder søges
jobs.description:
Hos Plastflex leder vi efter en asfaltmedarbejder på fuldtid til udlægning af plastasfalt og fugemasse. 

Om jobbet 

Som asfaltmedarbejder vil dit ansvar være at sikre belægning og vedligeholdelse af veje, der kræver asfalt. Dette gøres primært gennem reparationsarbejde på eksisterende asfaltflader, herunder revneforsejling, udfyldning af huller og udskiftning af beskadigede områder.

For at skabe et godt og sikkert resultat hver gang, vil du indgå i et team på to personer med en erfaren kollega på området.

Arbejdsstedet er skiftende, men du kommer primært til at arbejde på veje i Jylland, specielt motorveje og i grundejerforeninger. Vi har lager i Horsens, hvorfra arbejdsopgaver udgår.

Arbejdet foregår hovedsageligt om dagen, men natarbejde og skiftende arbejdstider uden for normal arbejdstid kan forekomme, for at øge medarbejderes sikkerhed og minimere forstyrrelser i trafikken. 

Derudover sørges der naturligvis for, at sikkerhed og komfort under forskellige vejrforhold er i top ved hjælp af specialiseret tøj og beskyttelsesudstyr.

Stort kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er også en bonus, hvis du har bestået kurset "Vejen som arbejdsplads”.

Vigtigst er det, at du:

  • Har lyst til arbejde med asfalt uanset erfaring - vi sørger for, at du bliver grundigt oplært 

  • Du er mødestabil, og kan tilpasse dig skiftende arbejdssituationer og arbejdstider

  • Du trives i at arbejde i et team, hvor du ansvarligt kan samarbejde med din kollega om de opgaver, I løser i fællesskab

Ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til vinteren på grund af sæsonbetinget lavsæson, men der er efterfølgende mulighed for fastansættelse.

Du vil blive ansat under Bygge- og Anlægsoverenskomsten på ikke-permanente arbejdspladser.

Øvrige løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive aftalt i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansættelsesproces

Vi vil gerne byde vores nye kollega velkommen snarest muligt, og ansætter derfor løbende. Skriftlig ansøgning med CV og kontaktoplysninger sendes elektronisk til info@plastflex.com.

Har du spørgsmål eller lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte os telefonisk på +45 60 19 34 66 eller skriftligt via info@plastflex.com. 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Lidt om Plastflex ApS

Plastflex ApS blev stiftet i 1993, og vi har siden da udbedret veje over hele Danmark. Vores primære kunder er Vejdirektoratet og kommuner, men vi laver også arbejde for boligforeninger og grundejerforeninger. Udover vores lager i Horsens har vi lager i Glostrup, samt en fabrik i Fjerritslev, hvor vi siden 1994 har produceret plastasfalt og fugemasse. Du kan læse mere om os og vores arbejde på vores hjemmeside.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.title: støtte/kontakt person
jobs.description:
Støttekontaktpersoner søges – børn og unge i fokus

 

 

Vil du gøre en forskel i børns og unges liv – og være en stabil voksen i deres hverdag? Hos Grollman Healthcare oplever vi i øjeblikket stor efterspørgsel og søger derfor flere engagerede støttekontaktpersoner til meningsfulde og længerevarende opgaver fordelt på Sjælland.

 

Om stillingen

  • Ikke fuldtid – opgaverne er timelønnede og varierer i omfang

  • Fra  5  timer pr. uge pr. opgave 

  • Arbejdstid ligger primært i hverdage men kan også forekomme i weekenderne

  • Opgaverne er længerevarende og relationsbaserede

Du bliver en del af forløb med børn og unge, som har blandede udfordringer – fx inden for det sociale, følelsesmæssige eller kognitive område. Derfor er det afgørende, at du er tålmodig, nærværende og kan møde den unge dér, hvor vedkommende er.

Om dig

  • Du er pædagogisk uddannet – eller har solid erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske felt

  • Du har kørekort og bil

  • Du trives i selvstændigt arbejde og tager ansvar for opgaven

  • Du kan se dig selv i et længerevarende forløb og skabe stabile relationer

Sådan arbejder vi

Indsatsen tilrettelægges altid ud fra den unges specifikke behov – både dem, vi definerer i samarbejde med kommunen, og dem, vi identificerer i takt med, at vi lærer den unge bedre at kende. Hos os er der plads til det hele menneske – og vi tror på, at udvikling sker i trygge relationer.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld og fleksibel hverdag

  • Opgaver, hvor du virkelig gør en forskel

  • Faglig sparring og støtte fra et kompetent og dedikeret team

  • Mulighed for flere opgaver, hvis det ønskes

 

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du den helt rette? Så tag fat i os – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Grolman HealthcareRelationer. Tryghed. Udvikling.Krusågade 26, kld.1721 København VTlf. 24424677     www.aflastning.com

jobs.title: Servitør, Scandic Seilet, ekstrahjelp
jobs.description:
VI HAR ROM FOR DEG
Servitør som er opptatt av genuine møter og bærekraftig mat

I våre restauranter finner du dyktige ansatte som lar sin entusiasme for å lage og servere god mat og drikke skinne i gjennom. Vi har troen på at hver medarbeider har et unikt preg som må utnyttes i møtet med våre gjester. På denne måten får vår service et personlig aspekt som igjen fører til genuine og minneverdige besøk.

Hos oss vektlegger vi et balansert forhold mellom jobb og privatliv ettersom dette medfører positivt arbeidsdriv og høy trivsel. Vi vil hjelpe deg med å finne denne balansen slik at du kan fokusere din energi på å skape hyggelig stemning og å veilede gjestene gjennom menyen.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver som servitør i Scandic:

  • Du viser at du er kjent med mat- og drikketilbudet slik at du kan veilede gjestene gjennom menyene på best mulig måte.
  • Du bidrar til avdelingens målsettinger.
  • Du sørger for at vårt positive arbeidsmiljø fortsetter å utvikle seg og å opprettholde et tett samarbeid med dine medarbeidere i alle avdelinger.
  • Arbeide med paydesk.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Du har helst tidligere erfaring fra en servicestilling, men ikke påkrevd
  • Du har god kjennskap til mat og drikke.
  • Du snakker engelsk eller et skandinavisk språk.
  • Over 18 år

Dette er en midlertidig ansettelse på ekstrahjelp.

Stillingen gjelder alle typer vakter, frokost, lunsj, kveld og bankett.

Vi ser fram til å ønske deg velkommen til vårt team på Scandic Seilet – hvor du i oppmuntrende omgivelser kan utvikle deg til den beste versjonen av deg selv.

Vi verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen vår og er interessert i å lære mer om dine behov og eventuelle tilrettelegginger som kan støtte deg i å lykkes i denne rollen. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av funksjonsnivå eller bakgrunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alt starter med deg. Å jobbe på et av våre hoteller betyr å være en del av et team der omtanke, samarbeid og små øyeblikk i hverdagen gjør en forskjell. Du er med på å skape den varme, hjemmekoselig følelsen som kjennetegner Scandic – ved å være til stede, her og nå, og la detaljene telle.

Noen dager går fort, andre er mer forutsigbare – ingen dager er helt like. Men det som alltid består, er lagånden. Dere stiller opp for hverandre, løser ting når de oppstår og er stolte av å levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er høyt. Og når dere gjør det, vil gjestene ikke bare nyte oppholdet – de får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Slik jobber vi i Scandic

Vi er på vårt beste når vi jobber sammen – på tvers av roller, hoteller og team – og fokuserer på det som virkelig gjør en forskjell i hverdagen. Våre verdier veileder oss i hvordan vi møter hverandre og hvordan vi leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du mener at ekte gjestfrihet skapes gjennom samarbeid, jevn kvalitet og små øyeblikk gjort godt, vil du føle deg hjemme hos oss.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Ønsker du en annerledes arbeidsdag med mye morsomt og noen rolige dager? Da er kanskje du min nye assistent!
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Jeg er en gutt på 18 år med en del god lun humor. Jeg har en diagnose som gjør at jeg sitter i rullestol. Når jeg ikke er på skolen, liker jeg å se på sport - spesielt fotball og ishockey. Jeg drar gjerne for å se på dette ved hver mulig anledning. Både på hjemmekamper og noen ganger bortekamper. Du vil kunne være med å bidra til at jeg kan fortsette med å gjøre det jeg liker aller mest!

 

Jeg disponerer egen bil, så det er en stor fordel med førerkortklasse B manuell.


Arbeidstiden vil som oftest være på ettermiddag og kveld. Men også noen ganger på dagtid(helger og ferier). Jeg søker både assistenter til fast stilling og tilkalling, så skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mye du ser for deg å jobbe.


Personlige egenskaper:

  • Tålmodig 
  • Imøtekommende 
  • Initiativrik 
  • Fleksibel
  • Sportsinteresse er en fordel
  • Det er ikke behov for helsefaglig utdanning. Opplæring vil bli gitt.
  • Kjemi og personlige egenskaper vektlegges
  • Gyldig politiattest 
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Enkel forflytning med løft
  • Kjøre til og fra fotballkamper og hockeykamper
  • Være med på hockey og fotballkamper 
  • Være med på sykehus besøk
  • Enkelt personlig stell

 

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En motiverende og meningsfull arbeidsdag
  •  Inkluderende og avslappet arbeidsforhold
  •  Morsom og varierende arbeidsdager
  • God opplæring og oppfølging som trygger deg i rollen som assistent
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn i henhold til tariff
  • Ansettelse vil være i Prima Assistanse, hvor du får egen kontaktperson og assistentkurs.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Pharmacoepidemiology and Health Data Analytics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a full time permanent position as Associate Professor in Pharmacoepidemiology and Health Data Analytics at the Section for Pharmaceutics and Social Pharmacy, Department of Pharmacy, University of Oslo.


About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

The Department of Pharmacy at the University of Oslo is seeking a highly motivated, dynamic and innovative researcher with strong scientific, educational and collaborative skills in pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics and real-world evidence generation. 

The Department has a strong interdisciplinary environment covering key areas of pharmaceutical sciences. Through cutting-edge research, extensive national and international collaborations, and an integrated five-year Master’s programme in Pharmacy, the Department is a leading contributor to pharmaceutical research and education in Norway. We maintain close collaborations with healthcare services, regulatory authorities, public health institutions, and the pharmaceutical and health technology sectors. The successful candidate must be able to teach social pharmacy within the professional pharmacy programme at the Department.

The position will be affiliated with the Pharmacoepidemiology and Drug Safety (PharmaSafe) research group in the Section for Pharmaceutics and Social Pharmacy. The research group has extensive experience in pharmacoepidemiology and real-world evidence generation using nationwide Norwegian health registries and population-based cohorts to study use, effectiveness and safety of medications and vaccines. Combined with access to advanced e-infrastructure, secure analysis platforms and strong national and international collaborations, the research environment offers unique opportunities for high-impact research using linked healthcare data. 
 

The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the Department’s research in pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics and AI-enabled real-world evidence generation with a particular emphasis on the innovative use of large-scale healthcare datasets.

The Department will relocate to the new Life Science Building (Livsvitenskapsbygningen- UiO:Livsvitenskap) in 2026. This move will provide unique opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration with researchers in epidemiology, biostatistics, informatics, machine learning, artificial intelligence and precision medicine. The Department leads the UiO:Real-World Evidence (UiO:RWE) convergence environment, a strategic interdisciplinary initiative in the Life Science building that promotes innovative use of health data and real-world evidence across the University. The successful candidate will become part of this interdisciplinary environment and contribute to its research, educational and collaborative activities.

Teaching and supervision are important part of the position, and the overall workload is typically balanced between research, teaching and academic leadership. 
The Department is a partner in the national research school in epidemiology, EPINOR, through which PhD candidates gain access to specialized courses, networking opportunities, and a broad national research community. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to EPINOR's research and training activities and help strengthen the Department's role within the network.


Your main tasks will be
  • Conduct and lead internationally competitive research within pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics, and the use of machine learning for real-world evidence generation.
  • Develop and apply innovative methods for analysing large-scale healthcare data, including advanced epidemiological, statistical, computational approaches. 
  • Initiate, lead and contribute to externally funded national and international research projects. 
  • Teach and supervise students at bachelor, master, PhD and postdoctoral level at the Department of Pharmacy.  
  • Contribute to the development of courses and educational activities within pharmacoepidemiology and health data science. 
  • Contribute to the Department's strategic initiatives within health data analysis and digital life science, including the UiO:Real-World Evidence (UiO:RWE) convergence environment and the Norwegian Research School in Epidemiology (EPINOR). 
  • Strengthening collaboration with healthcare services, regulatory authorities, public health institutions, industry and national and international research networks. 
  • Participate in academic leadership, including course development, examination duties, and other administrative responsibilities as required.
     

More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications that must be documented in the application::

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in pharmacoepidemiology, epidemiology, health data science, biostatistics or closely related discipline.
  • A master’s degree in pharmacy, medicine, public health or pharmacoepidemiology or an equivalent relevant field. 
  • Documented knowledge of European therapy guidelines and pharmaceutical traditions is required. Strong candidates familiar only with American therapy guidelines and traditions may also be considered but must demonstrate a clear plan and strong motivation to acquire knowledge of Norwegian and European systems upon appointment.
  • A strong and consistent scientific track record, with publications in high-quality international peer-reviewed journals relevant to the position. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific output from the past five years.
  • Demonstrated ability and clear potential to attract external research funding.
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • Teaching in the pharmacy program is conducted primarily in Norwegian. The successful candidate must demonstrate proficiency in English and a Scandinavian language sufficient for teaching, supervision and administrative duties. Candidates who do not document Scandinavian language proficiency at minimum B2 level at the time of appointment must demonstrate clear prior ability to acquire languages and commit to reaching the required level in Norwegian within three years. Applications that do not convincingly demonstrate both ability and commitment to meeting this requirement will not be prioritised.

Desired qualifications:

  • Strong experience in pharmacoepidemiology, including advanced epidemiological methods and work with large healthcare data sources (e.g. registries, EHRs).
  • Expertise in health data analytics, including advanced statistical modelling, machine learning and/or artificial intelligence applied to healthcare data.
  • Experience in regulatory science, pharmacovigilance or real-world evidence generation. 
  • Strong programming skills and experience using statistical software and programming languages commonly applied in health data research, such as R, Python, SAS, SQL or equivalent.
  • Experience with common data models (e.g. OMOP, EPICORE or similar), large-scale healthcare data infrastructures, and reproducible research practices. 
  • Documented experience in initiating, leading and managing research projects and collaborations. 
  • Experience supervising PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers.
  • Participation in interdisciplinary research environments and academic leadership roles.
  • Experience with academic administration or institutional responsibilities.
  • An established international research network and active collaboration profile.
     

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

We are seeking a candidate who demonstrates:

  • High motivation, work capacity and commitment to academic excellence, with the ability to independently drive research, teaching and collaborative activities forward.
  • A clear sense of scientific direction and the ability to develop a sustainable and competitive research profile.
  • Strong collaboration and networking skills, combined with the ability to take scientific and organisational leadership.
  • The ability to contribute to a positive, inclusive, and productive research and teaching environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly to students, colleagues and broader audiences.
  • A constructive and collegial working style, with willingness to contribute to shared responsibilities within the Department.
  • A genuine interest in contributing to education in pharmacy and social pharmacy, including professional training programmes.
     

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • An exciting academic position in one of Europe’s most data-rich health research environments, with access to unique national health registries, advanced e-infrastructure and secure data platforms.
  • Modern facilities in the new Life Science Building.
  • Opportunities for academic leadership and career development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 950 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

University of Oslo is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us.
 


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future, as well as strategies for collaboration and for identifying synergies with the existing group.
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Pharmacy has 130 employees. We have an active research and innovation environment based on independent research in pharmaceutical topics. The Department of Pharmacy is responsible for the popular master's degree program in pharmacy and has 350 competent and committed students.
Pharmaceutical related research and education forms the base of all activities at the Department of Pharmacy. The science of pharmacy lies in the interface between the natural sciences, pharmaceutical technology, health related topics and social sciences. This interdisciplinarity is reflected both in our study programmes and in our research. 
In the planned life science building at the University of Oslo, closer collaboration with health enterprises, local government and the business sector will enhance quality and relevance in research and education of the future labour force. The building will be the heart of the first innovation district in Norway – Oslo Science City. The Department of Pharmacy will move into the new Life Science building in 2026.

jobs.title: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.

- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.

- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil

Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Systematic Entomology
jobs.description:
A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Systematic Entomology is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo

The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing duty work.
The project is supervised by Dr. Hallvard Elven (NHM).

The PhD project will focus on the systematics and ecology of selected groups within the Diptera family Cecidomyiidae, specifically within the large subfamily Cecidomyiinae. Most members of this subfamily are gall formers on vascular plants, whereas some are predators, fungivores, saprophages, or non-galling phytophages. Different species are often ecologically connected, e.g. as predator and prey, or as galler and inquiline, but their relationships are often not fully understood. A significant fraction of the North European species still await description.

The candidate will investigate both ecological and phylogenetic relationships and do a taxonomic revision with species descriptions. The tasks will include field work and lab rearing, bioinformatics using Next Generation Sequencing, and traditional taxonomic studies using morphology. 

The PhD will be associated with the species survey project “Gall Midges Phase II” financed by the Norwegian Biodiversity Information Centre. It will use mainly material collected in Norway.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The fellowship requires admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Appointment to a research fellowship is conditional upon admission to the Faculty’s research training programme. A plan for the research training must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position, and the admission approved within three months. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/  


Qualifications/Requirements 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in systematic biology. 
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. 
English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8 

Desirable qualifications (in ranked order): 
•    Research in biosystematics (e.g., phylogenetics, species delimitation, and taxonomy)
•    Experience with field collection, handling, identification, and curation of insects
•    Experience with DNA-based wet lab work
•    Experience with bioinformatics for biosystematics
•    Experience with microscopy, slide mounting and macro photography
•    Strong interest in insect systematics  

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:
•    The average grade for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better 
•    The average grade for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better 
•    The Master’s thesis must have grade B or better 
See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7 


What are we looking for in you?

•    Honesty and high standards for scientific integrity
•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritize and complete work tasks

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following: 

•    Relevance and quality of the MSc thesis 
•    Relevance and quality of scientific publications (not necessarily expected at this level) 
•    Grades at relevant university-level courses (entomology, taxonomy, phylogenetics, bioinformatics, wet-lab molecular techniques)
•    The fit of the applicant’s career plan, interests, and skills as formulated in the cover letter (see How to apply below).
•    Personal suitability (incl. collaborative skills) and motivation for the position 
•    An interview, including a 15 minute presentation of your MSc thesis (only short-listed candidates)


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development. 
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Onboarding program for new employees
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK).

How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents): 
1.    Cover letter with statement of motivation and research interests
2.    CV summarizing education, positions and academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experience
3.    PDF of MSc thesis (or equivalent) and potential publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluating committee 
4.    Copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records 
5.    Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
6.    Names and contact details of 2-3 references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). The references will be contacted if necessary. Letters of recommendation are therefore not required.

Applicants should deliver the application with the requested attachments through our electronic recruiting system. Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge. Click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Foreign applicants are advised to include an explanation of their University’s grading system. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.
The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.
