jobs.title: Autolakerer til Århus
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få lakken til at skinne igen! 

Er du den, der får et tilfredsstillende sug i maven, når en bil forlader kabinen med en spejlblank finish? Elsker du duften af frisk lak og præcision i hver eneste sprøjtning? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Ansvarsområde er kabinen og du skal være med til at sikre den daglig drift i kabinen.
  • Sikre jævnt flow, korrekt farvematch og en finish, der spiller.
  • Selvom du har et medansvar for kabinen, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens.

Hvem er du?

Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtelakering – enten som udlært autolakerer eller med solid erfaring.
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish – du lakerer ikke bare, du skaber mesterværker.
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver
  • Har B-kørekort – så bilerne ikke kun ser flotte ud, men også kan flyttes.
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens.

Hvad får du?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi ved, hvad dygtige folk er værd!
  • Gode kollegaer, der deler din passion for lakering og håndværk.
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med
  • Mulighed for udvikling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med humor og højt til loftet.
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener.

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige lakmester med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme. 

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen på 30432854

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbetare med ansvar för Pack & Utleverans
jobs.description:
(English text below)

Om jobbet

Söker du ett praktiskt arbete där du får kombinera fysiskt packningsarbete med att schemalägga tillverkningen i fabrikens produktion? Hos Swedish Nutra i Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, söker vi en noggrann medarbetare som vill ta ansvar för att våra produkter etiketteras, packas och färdigställs för leverans i tid.

I denna roll får du förtroende att analysera ordrar och lagersaldon för att schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandningsteamet. Du styr sedan paketerings- och utleveransflödet i produktionshallen- oavsett om det gäller mindre sändningar eller större volymer. Du ansvarar även för god ordning och pallstruktur på produktionsytan.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Linjearbete & Packning: Betjäna vår automatiska etiketteringslinje (påmatning till transportband och avplockning från akkumuleringsbord), packa färdiga varor och färdigställa utleveranser.
    Batch- & Packplanering: Analysera inkommande ordrar och lagersaldon för färdiga produkter. Schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandnings- och fyllningsteamet samt lägga upp det dagliga packschemat.
    Färdigvaror & Pallstruktur: Utföra regelbundna lagerräkningar av färdiga produkter samt ansvara för struktur och ordning på pallytorna i produktionshallen.
    Tätt Teamsamarbete: Arbeta i nära kontakt med tillverkningsteamet för att synka schemat mot leveransdeadlines.
    Spårbarhet & Utrustning: Kontrollera batchnummer och utgångsdatum före utleverans samt logga data via Excel och tavlor. Hantera manuella/elektriska pallyftare och tejpmaskiner.

Arbetstider & Kvalifikationer

    Heltid (40 h/vecka), dagtid. Tillsvidareanställning (provanställning tillämpas). Arbetet är fysiskt.
    Noggrann, strukturerad och lärovillig med stark känsla för precision och ordning.
    Goda/flytande kunskaper i antingen svenska eller engelska är ett krav.
    Meriterande: Erfarenhet av packning, orderhantering, tillverkning eller truckkort (A+B).

Om Swedish Nutra

Swedish Nutra är ett Malmöbaserat familjeföretag som tillverkar flytande kosttillskott för en global marknad. Hos oss möter du ett ungt, drivet och mångkulturellt team där engelska är en helt naturlig del av vardagen. Vi erbjuder en varm och engagerande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare räknas och där det finns goda möjligheter att växa.

Arbetsplats: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö (Mellersta Hamnen)

Ansökan & Viktig information

Intervjuer sker löpande. Skicka CV och personligt brev till: hr@swedishnutra.com

⚠️ VIKTIGT ANGÅENDE DIN ANSÖKAN ⚠️

På grund av hög e-postvolym sorteras alla ansökningar automatiskt. För att ditt mail ska synas måste du använda följande ämnesrad:

Ämnesrad: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Ansökan: [Ditt Förnamn + Efternamn]

(Exempel: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Ansökan: Anna Andersson)

Observera: Vi gör vårt bästa för att återkoppla till alla, men p.g.a. högt tryck kan vi inte besvara varje ansökan individuellt. Har du inte hört något inom två veckor har vi gått vidare med andra kandidater.

Production Specialist – Packaging & Dispatch

About the Job

Looking for a dynamic, hands-on role that pairs packaging line operations with production scheduling and inventory flow? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, we are seeking a detail-oriented team member to take charge of labeling, packing, and dispatching orders on time.

In this role, you will evaluate incoming orders and inventory levels to schedule required batch production runs for our manufacturing team. You will also organize the daily packaging queue and dispatch workflow, handling volume demands ranging from smaller shipments to large multi-pallet orders — while keeping our staging areas organized. Full on-site training is provided!

Key Responsibilities

    Packaging Line Operations: Operate our automated labeling line, pack finished goods, and stage outbound orders.
    Batch & Production Scheduling: Review incoming orders and finished stock to schedule batch runs for the mixing team and set daily packaging priorities to hit shipping deadlines.
    Inventory & Staging: Conduct routine stock counts of finished goods and keep pallet staging zones clean, safe, and structured.
    Daily Coordination: Work closely throughout the day with mixing and bottling teams to align production output with dispatch deadlines.
    Quality & Compliance: Verify lot numbers, expiry dates, and batch records using Excel and tracking boards. Operate manual/electric pallet jacks and taping machinery.

Role Details & Requirements

    Terms: Full-time (40 hrs/week, day shifts). Permanent position (probationary period applies). Physically active role.
    Profile: Detail-oriented, organized, and eager to take on expanding operational responsibility over time.
    Languages: Good command of either English or Swedish is required (fluent in at least one).
    "Good to have" experience: Background in packaging lines, order fulfillment, manufacturing, or holding a forklift license (A+B).

About Swedish Nutra

Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family business producing premium liquid supplements distributed worldwide. You’ll be joining a young, energetic, and multicultural team where English is spoken daily. We offer a warm, collaborative workplace culture where every team member is valued and given room to grow.

Location: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö, Sweden (Mellersta Hamnen)

How to Apply & Important Information

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Send your CV and cover letter to: hr@swedishnutra.com

⚠️ IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ⚠️

Applications are filtered automatically. To ensure your email is processed correctly, you must use the exact subject line format below:

Subject Line: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Application: [Your First & Last Name]

(Example: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦Application: John Doe)

Please note: While we do our best to reach out to everyone, high email volume means we may not be able to reply to every applicant individually. If you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we have moved forward with other candidates.

jobs.title: Data Center Facilities Manager
jobs.description:
**The role**

The Facilities Manager leads a multidisciplinary team of technicians and contractors, oversees maintenance and capital projects, manages vendor performance, and drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, sustainability initiatives, and proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facilities Operations

- Lead the day-to-day operation of all critical facility infrastructure.

- Ensure the availability and reliability of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life safety systems.

- Maintain compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and uptime objectives.

- Oversee 24/7 operational support, including incident response and escalation.

- Ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and Method of Procedures (MOPs) are current and followed.


Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop Critical Facilities Engineers and Technicians.

- Manage shift schedules, staffing, training, and performance evaluations.

- Foster a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

- Coordinate contractor and vendor activities to ensure quality and compliance.


Maintenance & Asset Management

- Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.

- Manage maintenance planning through the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

- Monitor equipment lifecycle performance and develop replacement strategies.

- Ensure maintenance activities minimize operational risk and downtime.


Infrastructure Management

Oversee the operation and maintenance of:

- Electrical distribution systems (MV/LV)

- UPS systems and battery plants

- Standby diesel generators

- Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS)

- Chillers and chilled water systems

- CRAH and CRAC units

- Air Handling Units (AHUs)

- Pumps and hydronic systems

- Heat exchangers

- Building Management System (BMS)

- Fire detection and suppression systems

- Security and access control systems


Health, Safety & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with Finnish occupational safety legislation, EU directives, environmental regulations, and company policies.

- Manage Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and contractor safety programs.

- Lead incident investigations and implement corrective actions.

- Prepare for and support regulatory inspections and internal audits.


Financial & Vendor Management

- Develop and manage the facilities operating budget.

- Review maintenance contracts and service agreements.

- Monitor vendor performance against established KPIs.

- Support procurement of equipment and facility services.


Reporting

- Track and report key operational metrics, including:


- Infrastructure availability

- Preventive maintenance completion

- Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)

- Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)

- Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)

- Energy consumption

- Safety performance


1. Prepare operational reports for senior leadership.


Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related technical discipline.

- Master's degree is an advantage but not required.


Experience

- Minimum 7 years of experience in critical facilities or mission-critical operations.

- At least 3 years of leadership experience managing technical teams.

- Experience in hyperscale data centers, colocation facilities, hospitals, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable.


Technical Knowledge

Strong knowledge of:

- Critical electrical infrastructure

- HVAC and cooling systems

- Chilled water and hydronic systems

- Building Management Systems (BMS)

- Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM)

- Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

- Reliability and maintenance best practices

- Risk assessment and root cause analysis

- Commissioning and integrated systems testing


Preferred Qualifications

- Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

- Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti).

- Hot Work Card (Tulityökortti).

- First Aid (EA1) certification.

- Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Specialist (ATS) or similar critical facilities certification.

- Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is an advantage.

- Fluent English is required; Finnish language skills are beneficial.


Leadership Competencies

- Safety leadership

- Strategic planning

- Team development

- Decision-making under pressure

- Operational excellence

- Vendor and stakeholder management

- Budget management

- Continuous improvement

- Excellent written and verbal communication


**Benefits & Perks:**

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams


**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

Your Tasks

  • Plan, execute, and continuously optimise performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search (Google Ads) and Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) to hit revenue and ROAS targets

  • Act as the primary owner for platform account managers (Google and Meta reps), driving beta access, strategic support, and account audits

  • Actively manage and reallocate monthly performance budgets dynamically across channels to capture demand efficiently

  • Manage product feed architecture using tools like Channable to ensure clean product data mapping across Google Shopping, Meta Catalogs, and TikTok

  • Monitor daily account health, leverage GA4 to analyse user journeys, and partner with internal data and tech leads to maintain robust tracking and attribution integrity

  • Collaborate with the creative team to brief high-converting ad formats, especially UGC and video concepts for TikTok and Meta, and scale winning assets based on creative testing frameworks

Your Profile

  • 2 to 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience in D2C ecommerce, beauty, lifestyle, or skincare experience is a major plus

  • Proven experience in Paid Search (Google Search, Shopping, PMax) alongside Paid Social (Meta Ads Manager and/or TikTok Ads Manager)

  • Comfortable translating raw metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversion rates) into actionable optimisation steps and strategic suggestions

  • A self-starter capable of taking immediate ownership of existing workflows and hitting the ground running in a fast-paced D2C environment

  • Nice to have: hands-on experience with feed management platforms such as Channable and web analytics tools (GA4, GTM)

  • Nice to have: experience with additional channels (Pinterest, Amazon, Affiliate networks) or familiarity with server-side tracking (CAPI) setups

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default

  • Employee Discounts: You'll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Designer.

About the role

We are building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

We do this through a powerful suite of tools that combine ML/AI with heuristics and logic, flexible data integrations, and an overlay of data analytics. We see a high degree of usability as a key differentiator and have been investing in a world-class UI/UX from day one. To help us deliver our vision, we are seeking talented and experienced Senior Product Designers.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for translating highly technical and complex problems into clean and understandable solutions. You will be the voice of user experience and design standards in a cross-functional setting, and responsible for the end-to-end design process for your team. You’ll join a diverse design team and work closely with engineers, marketing and sales to create products that make it easy for our users to make smarter and safer decisions at scale.

*Please not that this role is not open to full remote and is Berlin or London based only

What You'll Do

  • Independently lead all design efforts for a cross functional team within Taktile.

  • Apply design thinking to complex technical problems

  • Continuously learn from user research and be the voice of our customers in product development

  • Conduct competitive analysis of existing products in the marketplace to identify opportunities for improvement

  • Connect business strategies, available technologies, and design solutions to deliver great experiences that impact our users and our business goals

  • Actively validate and iterate to ensure our product concepts are aligned with the business needs and stakeholder expectations

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and ensure that designs are implemented effectively in code

  • Contribute to and work with our Design System

  • Collaborate with other designers to create a coherent user experience across Taktile’s product

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design, ideally with B2B SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical domains.

  • Proven experience leading design for a product area or cross-functional team.

  • Strong systems thinking and ability to design complex workflows and data-heavy interfaces

  • Ability to translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, scalable user experiences.

  • Experience driving discovery and shaping problem definitions with Product and Engineering

  • Excellent communication skills

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Experience designing agentic interfaces and interest in AI-powered products

  • Strong technical understanding that allows you to engage in discussions with the Engineering Team

  • Experience in working in a fast-paced start-up/scale-up environment

  • An interest in fintech and financial services

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us
Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com

 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this

application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art.6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art.6(1)(f)).

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye Kjøkkensjef?

Nordpå søker en kjøkkensjef med ambisjoner, høye krav til kvalitet og evne til å bidra med gode matopplevelser gjennom hele dagen, fra frokost til middag. Vi satser på lokalmat i flere former, og du vil jobbe tett med våre lokale leverandører for videreutvikling av menyer og konsepter. Du er glad i å jobbe med mennesker, yte service og få folk til å føle seg velkommen. Du liker å bruke lokale råvarer, og kjenner godt til tradisjonelle matretter fra området, men du er heller ikke redd for å prøve ut nye konsepter. Du har lett for å samarbeide, og har sans for orden og renhold.Det er en fordel at du er glad i naturen og kan sette pris på å være i et flott fjellområde.

jobs.title: HR & Payroll Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role

As HR & Payroll Administrator, you will be responsible for accurate and timely administration of payroll, employee benefits and HR operational processes across EMEA, including Sweden and the UK. You will play an important role in supporting the smooth delivery of HR administration and ensuring a consistent employee experience across regions.

You will manage transactional HR activities, maintain accurate employee data in global HR systems and support HR Business Partners with employee lifecycle processes. The role requires strong structure, attention to detail, confidentiality and a service-minded approach.

Key responsibilities

    

Coordinate payroll inputs and payroll-related changes for relevant global entities, working closely with external payroll and EOR providers.

    

Administer employee benefits, including pension, healthcare and benefit enrolment, and support communication with employees and benefit providers.

    

Prepare and maintain HR documentation, including employment contracts, offer letters, change letters and employee records.

    

Maintain accurate data in HR systems and support HR reporting, compliance and audit activities.

    

Support onboarding, offboarding, HR intranet updates, training coordination and other HR operational projects.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is organised, accurate and service-minded, with the ability to manage several tasks and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining high quality and attention to detail. You enjoy working in an international environment and collaborate effectively with employees, managers, HR colleagues and external providers.

    

Relevant education within Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

    

3–5+ years of experience in HR administration, payroll administration and/or HR operations, preferably in an international environment.

    

Experience with payroll inputs, benefits administration, HRIS systems, applicant tracking systems and employee lifecycle processes.

    

Strong administrative and data management skills, with excellent attention to detail and good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

    

Clear communication skills, a proactive and service-minded approach, and the ability to handle confidential information with integrity.

What we offer

We offer a broad and varied role within a global HR function, where you will have the opportunity to contribute to efficient processes, high data quality and a positive employee experience. You will be part of a collaborative environment that values structure, accountability and continuous improvement.

Application

If you are motivated by delivering high-quality HR administration in an international setting, we look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as selection may take place on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Mechanical Data Center Operations Technician
jobs.description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**

The Mechanical Operations Technician is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of mechanical systems supporting a mission-critical data center in Lappeenranta, Finland. Working as part of a 24/7 Critical Facilities Operations team, the technician ensures maximum equipment availability while supporting the site's commitments to energy efficiency, sustainability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facilities Operations

- Operate and monitor mechanical infrastructure using the Building Management System (BMS) and routine field inspections.

- Respond to alarms, equipment faults, and operational events in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs).

- Record equipment readings, operating parameters, and shift activities.

- Support planned switching operations and maintenance windows.


Mechanical Maintenance

- Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on mechanical equipment.

- Troubleshoot mechanical failures and carry out repairs or coordinate vendor support.

- Assist with commissioning, recommissioning, and integrated systems testing.

- Maintain accurate maintenance records using the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).


Mechanical Systems

Operate and maintain systems including:

- Chilled water systems

- CRAH and CRAC units

- Chillers

- Air Handling Units (AHUs)

- Pumps and hydronic distribution systems

- Heat exchangers

- HVAC systems

- District cooling and heat recovery systems (where applicable)

- Water treatment systems

- Mechanical valves and piping

- Expansion vessels and pressure systems


Health, Safety & Compliance

- Work in accordance with Finnish occupational safety legislation and EU health and safety requirements.

- Follow Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and risk assessment procedures.

- Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

- Participate in emergency response activities and incident investigations.

- Promote a strong safety culture and environmentally responsible work practices.


Qualifications

Education

- Vocational Qualification (Ammatillinen perustutkinto) or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Building Services Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, or a related technical discipline.

- Equivalent technical or military experience may also be considered.


Experience

- 2–5 years of experience maintaining mechanical systems in data centers, industrial facilities, manufacturing, hospitals, power generation, or other critical environments.

- Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and CMMS software is preferred.


Technical Skills

Knowledge of:

- HVAC and cooling systems

- Chilled water and hydronic systems

- Pumps, motors, and heat exchangers

- Mechanical fault diagnosis

- Building Management Systems (BMS)

- Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

- Mechanical drawings and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)

- Energy-efficient building systems


Preferred Qualifications

- Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti)

- Hot Work Card (Tulityökortti)

- First Aid Certificate (EA1 or equivalent)

- Refrigerant handling qualification (where applicable)

- Fluent English (written and spoken)

- Finnish language skills are beneficial but not essential


**Benefits & Perks:**

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams


**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: FinOps Data Analyst & Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Behind every optimisation decision is data. As a FinOps Data Analyst & Consultant at Cortex Reply, you'll transform millions of billing line items into forecasts, dashboards, and insights that executives can act on - across cloud, AI, SaaS, and on-prem environments. 

This is an analytical consulting role at the intersection of data science, financial modelling, and business intelligence. You'll build cost models, design KPI frameworks, and deliver the transparency that makes technology spend predictable and optimisable. 

Your tasks

Data Analysis & Cost Investigation 

  • Analyse commitment usage, reservation coverage, and cost trends across cloud, AI/ML, SaaS, and on-prem 

  • Derive optimisation recommendations incorporating rightsizing, discounts, and usage anomalies 

Forecasting & Predictive Modelling 

  • Perform spend forecasts and variance analyses to prevent budget surprises 

  • Validate cloud-native forecasting tools and contribute to internal ML-based forecast models 

Reporting, Visualisation & KPIs 

  • Design dashboards and reports for technical and executive audiences 

  • Define FinOps KPIs and integrate them into live reporting systems aligned with business goals 

Automation & Scaling 

  • Automate reporting, alerting, and data pipelines (PowerAutomate, Python, SQL) 

  • Streamline workflows and scale analytics capabilities across clients 

Cost Allocation & Transparency 

  • Drive tagging strategies, taxonomy design, and showback/chargeback models 

  • Combine technical and business metrics for full-picture cost transparency 

Thought Leadership 

  • Develop FinOps blueprints and playbooks 

  • Contribute trainings, talks, and publications 

  • Expand offerings into FinOps for AI, FinOps for SaaS, or sustainability tracking 

Client Advisory & Consulting 

  • Engage directly with client stakeholders to understand business context, translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations, and present results in workshops and steering committees 

  • Support proposal development, scoping of new engagements, and client relationship management as a trusted advisor on data-driven cost decisions 

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation 

  • Professional development through challenging projects and training opportunities 

  • A diverse, international team with a strong knowledge-sharing culture 

  • Opportunities for thought leadership: conferences, publications, certifications 

  • A collaborative, supportive team environment 


  • Degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, IT Management, or related field 

  • Proficiency in English and German (min. B2 each) 

  • Residence in Germany with work eligibility 

  • Willingness to travel occasionally 

  • Strong analytical skills with focus on financial data interpretation 

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 

  • Understanding of agile frameworks and consulting/project management experience 

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Experience with SQL, Python, or R for data analysis and automation 

  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Apptio BI / TBM Studio, or Tableau) 

  • Excel & PowerQuery proficiency 

  • Understanding of cloud billing data structures (AWS CUR, Azure Cost Export, GCP BigQuery billing) 

  • Proactive, self-organised mindset 

Nice to Have 

  • Cloud certifications or FinOps Practitioner certification 

  • Familiarity with cloud cost management tools (e.g. Cloudability, Flexera, Kubecost, Infracost) 

  • Exposure to ML frameworks or cloud-native forecasting tools 

  • Experience with SaaS management, on-prem licence optimisation, or AI cost management 

  • Interest in community building, public speaking, or content creation

jobs.title: Taloussihteeri
jobs.description:
Hangon kaupungin sivistystoimi hakee taloussihteeriä vakinaiseen virkasuhteeseen 1.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan jo aiemmin.

Hangon sivistystoimen kansliassa taloussihteerinä työskentelet monipuolisten taloushallinnon tehtävien parissa ja saat laajan näkemyksen koko sivistystoimen taloudesta. Hangon kaupungin sivistystoimi vastaa varhaiskasvatuksen, perusopetuksen, lukiokoulutuksen sekä nuoriso- ja liikuntatoimen palveluista. Taloussihteeri työskentelee sivistystoimen yhteisessä hallinnossa ja tukee toimialan taloushallintoa tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri yksiköiden kanssa.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja jolla on ystävällinen, joustava sekä palveluhenkinen työote.

Taloussihteerin tehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:
- osallistuminen talousarvion valmisteluun ja tilinpäätöstyöhön
- laskutus (mm. asiakaslaskutus, kotikuntakorvausten laskutus sekä varhaiskasvatuksen asiakasmaksujen laskutus)
- varhaiskasvatuksen ja iltapäivätoiminnan maksupäätösten valmistelu
- ostolaskujen tarkastaminen ja hyväksyminen
- valtionavustusten, valtionosuuksien ja muiden myönnettyjen avustusten seuranta
- talouteen liittyvä raportointi ja tilastointi.

Taloussihteerin päivittäisessä työssä käytetään muun muassa seuraavia ohjelmia: Pro Economica Premium: ostolaskujen käsittely, kirjanpidon seuranta ja laskutus, Opiferus: taloussuunnittelu, CGI Vesa: varhaiskasvatuksen tietojärjestelmä ja Dynasty: esim. asioiden kirjaaminen ja diariointi. Taloussihteeri toimii Vesa-järjestelmän sekä varhaiskasvatuksen valtakunnallisen tietovarannon Vardan pääkäyttäjänä. Aiempi kokemus näiden järjestelmien käytöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on merkonomin, tradenomin tai vastaava tutkinto sekä erinomaiset taidot toisessa kotimaisessa kielessä ja hyvät taidot toisessa kotimaisessa kielessä.

Aiempi kokemus taloushallinnon tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Virka täytetään sopimuksen mukaan, ja siinä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Lisätietoja: sivistystoimen johtaja Karl-Erik Gustafsson, 040 596 3249, karl-erik.gustafsson@hanko.fi

Kannustamme ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen kehittämiseen. Tuemme työhyvinvointia tarjoamalla toimivat työterveyshuollon palvelut (Mehiläinen) sekä ePassi-lounas- ja henkilöstöedut.

Yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi rekrytoinneissa kaikki Hangon kaupungin rekrytoinnit tehdään anonyymisti. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytoija tekee haastatteluvalinnat näkemättä hakijan henkilötietoja (esim. nimi, syntymäaika, äidinkieli, sukupuoli tai yhteystiedot).
Näin ollen on tärkeää, että kerrot hakemuslomakkeessa riittävän kattavasti tehtävän kannalta olennaisesta osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi. Anonymiteetin säilyttämiseksi on tärkeää, ettet kirjoita mitään henkilötietoja hakemuslomakkeen vapaisiin tekstikenttiin.

Hakuaika päättyy 14.9.2026 klo 15.00. Hakemukset vastaanotetaan sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi.
Hakemuksen liitteeksi tulee toimittaa tutkintotodistus.

Palkkaus KVTES mukaan.

Lain lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002) 6 §:n 2 momentin mukaisesti palvelukseen tai tehtävään valitun henkilön on ennen palvelussuhteen alkamista esitettävä rikosrekisteriote. Lisäksi hänen on toimitettava lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan yhden (1) kuukauden kuluessa palvelussuhteen alkamisesta, jotta valinta voidaan vahvistaa lainvoimaiseksi.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer – HV Substation Control & Protection
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Power Systems

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Senior Control & Protection Engineer to join a dynamic engineering team working on high-voltage substation projects. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and delivery of control and protection systems while collaborating closely with project teams, suppliers, and customers. You will have the opportunity to further develop your expertise both in the office and on-site across Norway.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage all Control & Protection engineering activities throughout project execution.
  • Develop technical drawings, calculations, and documentation for substation projects.
  • Take ownership of Control & Protection design, including base design, detailed design, and as-built documentation.
  • Coordinate and supervise sub-suppliers to ensure quality and compliance.
  • Ensure designs meet customer requirements, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning, and site activities in collaboration with commissioning engineers.
  • Provide technical support during installation and project execution.
  • Conduct technical evaluations, risk assessments, and engineering recommendations to optimize project performance.
  • Collaborate with factories and suppliers across Europe to support project delivery.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in engineering, project execution, or site work.
  • Strong knowledge of substation Control & Protection engineering and execution.
  • Fluent in both English and Norwegian, written and spoken.
  • Proven ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage:

  • EPLAN, E3, or AutoCAD.
  • SCADA systems, control systems, and programming.
  • IED tools such as PCM600 or similar.
  • Power systems, transmission systems, and renewable energy projects.
  • Commissioning and testing of protection systems, including secondary and primary injection testing.
  • Knowledge of Norwegian regulations and standards for power systems.
Who We Are Looking For

You are a proactive and solution-oriented engineer with excellent communication skills and a strong commitment to quality and safety. You enjoy taking ownership, solving technical challenges, and working in close cooperation with colleagues, customers, and suppliers. You are curious about new technologies and continuously seek opportunities for professional growth.

What We Offer
  • A key role in exciting projects within the power and energy sector.
  • Opportunities to work on both engineering and commissioning activities.
  • Exposure to international suppliers and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Professional development opportunities in technical leadership and project coordination.
  • A collaborative and supportive working environment focused on innovation, quality, and safety.
Apply Today

If you are passionate about Control & Protection engineering and want to contribute to the development of critical energy infrastructure, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application and CV to be considered for this opportunity.

jobs.title: IT Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The IT Operations Specialist ensures the reliability, availability, and security of IT services across the organization’s office and manufacturing environments, supporting business continuity, operational excellence, and production stability.

The role combines operational support, infrastructure administration, and lifecycle management. Working closely with business stakeholders, production teams, and other IT functions, the IT Operations Specialist maintains and improves IT services and helps ensure employees have reliable technology and access to the systems they need to perform their work.

As part of the global IT Operations team, the role supports workplace technology in office and manufacturing areas, identity and access management, endpoint management, and local infrastructure services while contributing to operational projects, site initiatives, and production ramp-up activities.



Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

·      End-User Technical Support: Provide L1 and L2 technical support to internal users. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and workplace technology issues while identifying recurring problems and opportunities for service improvement. Support business continuity and production operations by minimizing service disruptions and ensuring users have reliable tools and systems required to perform their work effectively.

·      Equipment Installation & Configuration: Install, configure, maintain and lifecycle-manage operating systems, applications, endpoint devices, and workplace technology including printers, meeting room equipment, and mobile devices. Support manufacturing-related IT equipment such as shared workstations, scanners, and label printers, ensuring operational reliability.

·      Access Management & Administration: Manage user accounts, permissions, and access rights in accordance with established security and governance requirements. Support onboarding, offboarding, and organizational changes through provisioning and recovery processes.

·      Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate documentation of systems, processes, incidents, and operational procedures. Contribute to knowledge sharing, standardization, and automation.

·      Compliance & Security: Proactively identify, assess, and escalate risks that could impact business operations, manufacturing continuity, or information security, while ensuring adherence to established security practices throughout the organization.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role.

Qualifications & Experience

·      Multiple years of experience working in a technical and service-minded environment

·      Experience supporting users, devices and IT services in a corporate or enterprise environment

·      Experience with ITSM processes and tools (e.g., ServiceNow, JSM)

·      Hands-on experience working in M365

·      Technologies and services.

·      Experience participating in IT projects, technology deployments, or operational improvement initiatives is considered an advantage.

Specific Skills

·      Strong knowledge of Windows, MacOS, iOS, and Android

·      Good knowledge of M365, Entra ID, endpoint management

·      Experience or interest in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell) to improve operational efficiency, standardization, and service quality

·      Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

·      Understanding of IT security principles and compliance requirements

·      Understanding of manufacturing, industrial, or operational environments is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Myyjä, S-market Kaarina, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KAARINA

S-market Kaarina etsii tiimiinsä MYYJÄÄ!
Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.8.2027 asti ja osa-aikainen 20 tuntia viikossa. Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Myyjän työ ässässä on monipuolista ja nopeatempoista. Myyjän keskeisimpiin työtehtäviin kuuluu laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen luominen sekä työskentely kassalla ja päivittäistavaraosastolla. Osastolla työskentelyyn sisältyy asiakaspalvelun lisäksi muun muassa hyllytys, robotilausten keräily sekä esillepanojen ja myymälän siisteyden ylläpito. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Työtä tehdään vaihtelevissa vuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työaika sijoittuu kello 5.50-22.10 välille.

Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?

Olet etsimämme tyyppi, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja nautit työskentelystä myymäläympäristössä. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa, ja kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän tiimiin, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

💚 Ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %.

💚 Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa.

💚 Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin S-marketeissa sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet.


Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 31.8. mennessä!Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Santeri Jokinen. Santerin tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 8.30-16.30 numerosta 010 764 3017.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Based in Stockholm with a hybrid working model, you will join a growing Nordic Support team and build knowledge that can open doors to future career opportunities across Benifex. Four positions are available as part of the team’s continued growth.

Responsibilities

    

Handle incoming support cases through scheduled phoneand email shifts.

    

Support employees with questions relating to benefits, wellbeing allowances, declined receipts, unused purchases and other platform matters.

    

Investigate cases proactively using the customer portal, case management tools and internal knowledge sources.

    

Provide clear, helpful and professional communication, finding answers independently wherever possible.

    

Work in line with customer service agreements and agreed response times, including responding to cases within 48 hours.

    

Document cases accurately and take ownership of each matter through to resolution or appropriate escalation.

    

Collaborate with colleagues and relevant internal teams to resolve more complex questions.

    

Build strong knowledge of Benifex’s products and processes to support your continued development within the organisation.

What we are looking for

    

Some previous work experience within service, retail, hospitality, customer contact, support, administration or a comparable environment.

    

Fluent Swedish and good professional English, both written and spoken.

    

Strong communication skills, social awareness and a genuine focus on providing a helpful customer experience.

    

A proactive approach to problem solving, with the ability to use available information to move cases towards resolution.

    

Good general digital confidence and the ability to learn new systems and navigate several tools and information sources.

    

A calm and considered approach when an answer is not immediately available.

    

A reliable, punctual and structured working style.

    

A collaborative mindset and openness to giving and receiving feedback.

    

The initiative and critical thinking needed to investigate independently, while knowing when to ask for help and providing clear context when doing so.

    

Comfort working within scheduled support coverage between 08:00 and 17:00.

Bonus points for:

    

Experience in customer support, a contact centre or another high-volume service environment.

    

Experience using CRM, case management or customer portal systems.

    

Technical curiosity and an interest in digital tools, systems or basic technology concepts.

    

Experience working with service levels, response-time commitments or clearly defined processes.

    

An interest in building a long-term career within Benifex across areas such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Configuration or Content.

We want to make the application process as simple and fair as possible. That’s why we don’t ask for a cover letter for this role. Instead, you’ll find a few short questions in the application form. Your answers will help us understand your experience and skills in a more direct and relevant way.

Our interview process ✌

Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.

📞 Initial interview with the Talent team. ⏳ Interview with the hiring manager. 🤩 Final interview with a senior team member/director.

We look forward to receiving and reading your application!

jobs.title: Ohjaaja/ tukihenkilö
jobs.description:
Työtehtävä sisältää sosiaalipalveluiden asiakastyötä, jossa työntekijä tukee ja ohjaa alaikäistä asiakasta hänen yksilöllisten tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Asiakas on autismikirjon nuori, jolla voi esiintyä haastavaa käyttäytymistä sekä ajoittain aggressiivista käyttäytymistä itseään tai muita kohtaan.

Työ edellyttää työntekijältä erityisesti rauhallisuutta, kärsivällisyyttä, rohkeutta ja hyvää tilannetajua. Työntekijän tulee osata toimia haastavissa tilanteissa turvallisesti, ennaltaehkäistä tilanteiden kärjistymistä sekä rauhoittaa asiakasta ammattimaisesti ja hänen tarpeensa huomioiden.

Työhön kuuluu asiakkaan arjen tukeminen, turvallisuuden ylläpitäminen, toimintakyvyn edistäminen, ohjaaminen sekä asiakkaan kanssa toimiminen hänen yksilöllisen suunnitelmansa mukaisesti. Työntekijältä edellytetään hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, vastuullista työotetta, kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä valmiutta kohdata haastavia tilanteita rauhallisesti ja turvallisesti.

Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, jolla on kokemusta autismikirjon henkilöiden kanssa työskentelystä, haastavasta käyttäytymisestä tai muista vaativista sosiaalipalveluiden asiakastilanteista. Aikaisempi kokemus on eduksi, mutta tärkeää on myös aito halu oppia, hyvä paineensietokyky ja kyky säilyttää rauhallinen ja ammatillinen toimintatapa haastavissakin tilanteissa.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Looking for your next challenge as a Cloud Architect in the automotive or global tech industry?

ALTEN in Sweden is seeking a Cloud Architect with expertise in large-scale AWS environments and familiarity with Chinese cloud providers (e.g., Tencent, Alibaba). In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and oversee cloud architectures, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical best practices. This position offers a unique opportunity to bridge cloud solutions between global and Chinese ecosystems, with a focus on cultural and technical integration.

About the role

As a Cloud Architect, you will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high-performance cloud solutions. Your expertise in AWS and familiarity with Chinese cloud providers will be critical in guiding teams to implement architectures that meet both technical and cultural requirements. You will work closely with stakeholders to ensure cloud strategies align with business objectives, particularly in contexts involving Chinese markets or collaborations.

Your main responsibilities

    Design and oversee cloud architectures for large-scale systems, primarily in AWS
    Collaborate with teams to ensure proper execution of cloud solutions
    Provide technical guidance on integrating Chinese cloud providers (e.g., Tencent, Alibaba) into global architectures
    Ensure architectures meet scalability, security, and performance standards
    Act as a bridge between technical teams and stakeholders, particularly in contexts involving Chinese cultural and business practices

Your profile

We are looking for a Cloud Architect with a strong background in cloud infrastructure and cross-cultural collaboration.

    Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
    Proven experience as a Cloud Architect, with a focus on AWS
    Familiarity with Chinese cloud providers (e.g., Tencent, Alibaba)
    Experience in the automotive industry is a merit

About ALTEN

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja / mekaanikko Ouluun (palkka alkaen 3000€/kk)
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut mekaanikko, joka arvostaa siistejä työolosuhteita, hyviä työkaluja ja sitä, että töitä tehdään ammattitaidolla?

Etsimme asiakkaallemme kokenutta ajoneuvomekaanikkoa / ajoneuvoasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Ouluun.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi tunnettua valtakunnallista autoalan toimijaa, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa ja halutaan rakentaa pitkäaikaisia työsuhteita. Tarjolla on monipuolinen työnkuva, nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä osaava tiimi ympärillesi.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto-, korjaus- ja vianetsintätöistä.

Työ sopii erityisesti sinulle, joka nautit siitä, että saat käyttää omaa osaamistasi ja ratkaista erilaisia teknisiä haasteita. Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta et yksin – ympärilläsi on ammattitaitoinen tiimi, jonka kanssa asioita voidaan tarvittaessa pohtia yhdessä.


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta mekaanikon / ajoneuvoasentajan tehtävistä

* Vankkaa kokemusta autojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

* Hyvää teknistä osaamista ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

* Valmiutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

* Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

* B-ajokorttia

* Suomen kielen taitoa

Etsimme ennen kaikkea ammattitaitoista tekijää, joka tuntee auton tekniikan ja pystyy tarttumaan erilaisiin työtehtäviin itsenäisesti.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen

* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

* Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja siistit työtilat

* Ammattitaitoisen ja mukavan työyhteisön

* Tunnetun ja vakaan työnantajan

* Monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi

* Mahdollisuuden aloittaa mahdollisimman pian

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian.


KUULOSTAAKO OMALTA PAIKALTA?

Jos olet kokenut mekaanikko ja etsit pitkäaikaista työpaikkaa, jossa ammattitaitoasi arvostetaan, haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi jo tänään. Käsittelemme hakemuksia heti niiden saapuessa ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomaathan, että pelkästään sähköpostiin tai WhatsAppiin lähetettyjä hakemuksia ei huomioida.



Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Heidi Korhonen, 045 8521 969, heidi.korhonen@goodstaff.fi [heidi.korhonen@goodstaff.fi]


MIKSI TÖIHIN GOOD STAFFIN KAUTTA?

Good Staff Henkilöstöpalvelut yhdistää osaavat työntekijät ja tekijää vailla olevat työt – inhimillisesti ja reilusti. Olemme moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys, jossa työntekijä on aidosti keskiössä. Meillä saat joustavia työmahdollisuuksia, reilun palkan ja oman yhteyshenkilön, joka tukee sinua koko työsuhteen ajan.

Good Staffin kautta saat mahdollisuuden työllistyä monipuolisiin kohteisiin, kartuttaa osaamistasi ja löytää juuri sinulle sopivan työn – olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut ammattilainen.

jobs.title: Försäljingsförhandlare
jobs.description:
Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är ett inhemskt vitamin försäljningshus. Vi säljer hälsoprodukter som möjliggör en hälsosammare och bättre livsstil. Vi rekryterar nu nya heltids arbetare till vårt försäljningsteam.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är en del av HL-Family Oy. HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hyvinvointitukku.fi/rekrytointi/.

Senior Engineering Manager | Voice
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Voice for Meetings builds DeepL's real time AI voice technology for professional collaboration. The team works on in call transcription, translation, and voice intelligence, delivered live across the meeting platforms people already use every day.

The engineering problems are genuinely hard. Everything happens in real time, latency is measured in milliseconds, and quality is immediately visible to the person on the call. The team sits close to our applied science colleagues, so engineering and research work side by side rather than at arm's length.

This is also one of the most consequential products at DeepL right now. Voice for Meetings sits on the critical path for the next phase of the company's growth, which means the work is visible, the decisions matter, and the team has real influence over where the product goes. You will lead a small, senior team and work day to day alongside a Principal Product Manager and the team's most senior technical lead.

Your responsibilities

As Senior Engineering Manager for Voice for Meetings, you will lead the engineering team building DeepL's real time AI voice products. This is a hands on leadership role. You will be accountable for what the team builds and how well it works, and you will be close enough to the code to have a real opinion about it.

  • Lead, develop, and grow a small team of senior engineers, owning hiring, performance, and career development.

  • Drive end to end delivery of real time voice features from architecture through to production, holding a high bar for quality and pace at the same time.

  • Own the technical direction for your team's systems. Stay close enough to the detail to challenge senior engineers credibly and to get into the code yourself when it helps.

  • Work in a tight loop with your Principal Product Manager and senior technical lead, shaping what gets built rather than receiving a finished plan.

  • Operate confidently at the boundary with applied science. Understand how inference, preprocessing, and training data drift affect the product, and translate between model realities and delivery commitments.

  • Make and communicate clear technical trade offs under real constraints, including latency budgets, model quality, and timelines.

  • Spot risks and gaps beyond your own remit and fix them properly, leaving the teams around you better off rather than just unblocking yourself.

  • Build a high agency, low bureaucracy culture where engineers are trusted to make decisions and take genuine ownership of outcomes.

Qualities we look for

We care much more about how you think and what you have built than whether your background matches ours exactly.

  • You have managed engineers directly and owned a team's delivery, performance, and development. You have hired people, grown them, and handled the difficult conversations as well as the good ones.

  • You are a builder. You are comfortable in the trenches, you have real technical skills, and you have no interest in managing from a distance. If your hands on skills are a little rusty, that is fine, as long as you want to stay close to the work.

  • You have led teams building product that users touch. Real time systems, streaming, distributed systems at scale, or similar. What matters is that technical depth was the substance of the work rather than a detail in the background.

  • You have enough credibility to earn the confidence of senior engineers. You can reason about architecture, spot the failure modes, and add judgment to a technical decision rather than only facilitating it.

  • You have a pragmatic working understanding of how ML systems behave in production. Inference, preprocessing, data drift, and what breaks when a model meets real users. You do not need to be an ML specialist.

  • You think independently and act without waiting to be asked, and you draw those same instincts out of the people around you.

  • You have strong product and commercial instinct. You frame engineering trade offs in terms of user and business outcomes.

  • You are comfortable when the direction is still forming and priorities compete.

Nice to have

  • Experience with voice, speech, or audio technology, including ASR, TTS, or real time audio pipelines. A strong plus rather than a requirement, and we are genuinely open to engineering leaders from other technically demanding domains.

  • You have grown into a senior remit inside one organisation rather than moving on each time the title was available.

  • Experience building in a startup or a small product organisation, including something ambitious that did not work out.

  • Experience integrating with third party platform APIs where you do not control the other side.

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural change or technical pivot.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.
