If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 34 week of 2026

jobs.title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (SD) is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

117,600 Min - 205,900 Max EUR (Germany)

jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

* Tatkräftig: Sie arbeiten selbstständig, lösungsorientiert und strukturiert und treiben Projekte verlässlich voran.
* Herzlich: Sie begegnen Menschen in Ihrem beruflichen Umfeld respektvoll und wertschätzend und schaffen eine vertrauensvolle Basis für die Zusammenarbeit.

We are looking for a talented Marketing Leader to lead our Neurovascular marketing and market development strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH).

jobs.title: Inglise keele huviringi juhendaja/õpetaja
jobs.description:
Inglise keele õpetaja huviringi lastele

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Valgas, Otepääl kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-8 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-8 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kell 15 pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites. Sõlmime töövõtulepingu.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web Infrastructure team builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients, including client architecture, performance, reliability, and shared design systems.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team through the evolution from Notion Clients. You’ll set strategy, develop senior engineers and managers, and partner across Notion to make the product faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll build and manage a diverse and inclusive team of engineers and managers working on core parts of Notion's architecture. You'll create a healthy environment in your team that embodies Notion's values.

 - You'll recruit, coach, and develop engineers. You'll ensure engineers are regularly receiving feedback and making progress on personal and professional goals.

 - You'll facilitate planning—the prioritization, sequencing, and staffing of work—for your team.

 - You'll be responsible for maintaining a high-quality bar for everything your team ships.

 - You'll own execution in your team to develop a steady cadence of delivering value to your users.

 - You'll work with others to shape how Notion's engineering organization works. You'll help develop our technical practices, recruiting and onboarding strategy, planning and prioritization process, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have managed senior engineering teams and managers, and have experience in scaling teams.

 - You have built, or are committed to building, diverse and inclusive teams.

 - You create team environments that are at once collaborative, empowering, supportive, and challenging—ones where engineers do their best work.

 - You have a sufficiently deep background in product and technology that you can ask the right questions of your team, balance product, tech, and people concerns, and make hard tradeoffs.

 - You think rigorously. You're prepared to tackle the toughest technical problems, understand trade-offs, and enable teams to make decisions and progress.

 - You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.

 - You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have managed engineering teams at startups before, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.

 - You have experience rolling out engineering and management practices and processes—e.g., code review, performance reviews, and levels and ladders—where they didn't exist before.

 - You've managed teams that are across multiple offices.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 - $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Control Systems Engineer to lead and support the development and sustaining of SIMATIC SPPA-T3000 and PCS 7 control system for our medium gas turbines. As a part of our team, you will develop and maintain control system software applications for our medium gas turbines to ensure our products meet the requirements set in the market. The position requires close collaboration and working alongside other departments and designers to integrate control system into the overall design of MGT products.

How You Will Make an Impact

    Be a part of a highly skilled development team responsible for the development and maintenance of control system software applications for the MGT products.
    Be responsible for the engineering work and technical solutions in the assigned development projects, working closely with the project team and project manager to ensure that the design meets specified requirements aligned with the technical road map.
    Design and configure T3000 and PCS 7 control systems, including control logic, hardware setup, server and computer networks, safety systems, trip chains, and HMI/OS displays, while adhering to configuration management, version control, and rigorous testing to ensure system integrity.
    Integrate field instrumentation and subsystems; manage communications via common industrial protocols (e.g., ProfNet, Profibus, Modbus TCP, and OPC).
    Apply industry standards and best practices for safety, quality, and cybersecurity.
    Consistently acquire new skills and knowledge while sharing them by mentoring and assisting others over time. Contribute to enhancing our processes and methods to improve team performance and project outcomes within the team’s responsibilities.

What You Will Bring

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in control engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience working with automation and control technologies, with an interest in new technologies and the use of existing technologies in new contexts.
    Proficient English skills, allowing you to express yourself fluently and communicate effectively at a professional level.
    Excellent interpersonal skills combined with experience working with colleagues and customers in international settings.

Experience in the following areas is advantageous:

    SPPA-T3000 and/or PCS 7
    Modeling and simulation in MATLAB or a related tool
    Functional Safety (SIL)
    Cybersecurity
    System networking and VMware

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Kokenut automekaanikko
jobs.description:
**Haemme Herttoniemeen kokenutta automekaanikkoa**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea vahvaa käytännön ammattilaista, joka hallitsee itsenäisen vianhaun, diagnostiikan ja vaativammat korjaustyöt. Tehtävän sisältöä ja vastuuta voidaan rakentaa valittavan henkilön vahvuuksien mukaan.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti eri automerkkien huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

**Arvostamme** erityisesti kykyä ratkaista haastavampia vikoja itsenäisesti sekä varmaa otetta sähkö-, diagnostiikka-ja mekaanisiin korjauksiin.

**Palkkaus** on kilpailukykyinen ja aidosti neuvoteltavissa osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vastuun perusteella. Emme etsi halvinta tekijää vaan oikeaa ammattilaista.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- vahvaa kokemusta automekaanikon työstä

- itsenäistä työotetta

- osaamista vianhaussa ja diagnostiikassa

- kykyä hoitaa vaativampiakin korjauksia alusta loppuun

- huolellista ja ammattimaista työnjälkeä

- Suomen kielen riittävää osaamista työskentelyyn ja kommunikointiin


**Tarjoamme:**

- vakituisen työn toimivassa autokorjaamossa Herttoniemessä

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan tehtävänkuvaan ja vastuuseen

- kilpailukykyisen ja joustavasti neuvoteltavan palkkauksen

- mahdollisuuden ottaa halutessaan enemmän teknistä vastuuta korjaamon toiminnasta


**Myös yrittäjä- tai toiminimipohjaisesta yhteistyöstä** voidaan keskustella, jos se sopii sinulle paremmin kuin tavallinen työsuhde.

Jos olet kokenut asentaja ja etsit paikkaa, jossa osaamistasi arvostetaan ja jossa tehtävä voidaan rakentaa myös omien vahvuuksiesi ympärille, ota yhteyttä matalalla kynnyksellä.

Platform Engineer  Integration Competence Centre (ICC)
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer – Kafka & Integration Platform

Telge Consulting is looking for two experienced Platform Engineers specializing in integration and messaging platforms for assignments within a large enterprise environment.

You will work with business-critical integration platforms used by multiple development teams. The role combines platform engineering, DevOps, automation and operational responsibility, with a strong focus on Apache Kafka, Kubernetes and HiveMQ.

About the role

As a Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building, operating and continuously improving scalable and secure integration platforms. You will work according to a "you build it – you run it" approach and take end-to-end responsibility for platform stability, automation, security and performance.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Design, deploy and maintain Apache Kafka environments on Kubernetes using Strimzi or similar technologies
    Operate and administer Kafka clusters and enterprise HiveMQ MQTT brokers
    Manage Kafka Connect, topics, partitions, schemas, retention and cluster resources
    Plan and perform platform upgrades, patching and lifecycle management
    Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery and cross-region replication
    Implement Kafka security including ACLs, SASL, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS and RBAC
    Develop and maintain Kafka Connectors for integration between legacy and cloud-based systems
    Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
    Work with Infrastructure as Code and automated deployment using technologies such as Terraform and Helm
    Monitor platform health and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk and related observability tools
    Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot complex production issues
    Provide Tier 3 support for issues related to Kafka, messaging, networking and platform performance
    Support Java/Spring Boot development teams with Kafka Producer/Consumer configuration and integration patterns
    Develop self-service solutions and automation for development teams
    Work closely with security, architecture and development teams

Required qualifications

We are looking for candidates with:

    4–6 years of professional experience working with Apache Kafka
    Experience with Kafka platform administration, Kafka Connect and KRaft
    Experience with Strimzi or similar Kafka operators on Kubernetes
    4–6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot
    Strong experience with Kubernetes, preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
    Experience with CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins
    Experience with ArgoCD
    Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform
    Experience with Helm
    Experience with Linux
    Experience with PostgreSQL
    Experience with observability technologies such as Grafana, Prometheus and Splunk
    Experience with Fluent Bit and/or OpenTelemetry
    Professional working proficiency in English

Experience with HiveMQ or other enterprise MQTT platforms is highly desirable.

Additional qualifications

It is advantageous if you have experience with:

    API Management platforms
    Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
    KEDA
    Envoy Gateway or similar proxy/ingress technologies
    Cloud cost optimization
    Integration platforms in large enterprise environments

Personal qualities

You are a structured and solution-oriented engineer who is comfortable taking operational responsibility for business-critical platforms. You enjoy solving complex technical problems and collaborating with developers, architects, security specialists and other stakeholders.

You have a humble and collaborative approach and are comfortable working in an international environment.

Employment

Employer: Telge Consulting AB

Employment type: Full-time

Positions available: 2

Language: English

Start date: By agreement

Telge Consulting AB is a Swedish consulting company providing experienced specialists within IT, technology and infrastructure. For this position, you will be employed by Telge Consulting AB and work in a large enterprise integration environment in Sweden.

Applications should include a CV describing relevant experience with Kafka, Kubernetes, Java/Spring Boot and integration platforms.

jobs.title: Tilkaldevikar til Fonden KærBo
jobs.description:
Tilkaldevikar til Fonden KærBo

Fonden KærBo søger engagerede og fagligt stærke tilkaldevikarer, som har lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores beboere i et socialpsykiatrisk botilbud.

Vi søger dig, der har en pædagogisk, social- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund – eksempelvis som pædagog, socialrådgiver, social- og sundhedsassistent, social- og sundhedshjælper eller anden relevant uddannelse inden for det pædagogiske eller socialfaglige område.

Vi søger både dig, der ønsker at være tilkaldevikar løbende, og dig, der ønsker mulighed for at tage vagter efter behov.

Om jobbet

Som tilkaldevikar på KærBo bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen omkring vores beboere. Du vil indgå i det daglige pædagogiske arbejde og være med til at skabe tryghed, struktur, trivsel og udvikling for den enkelte beboer.

Vi arbejder ud fra en mentaliserende og rehabiliterende tilgang, hvor vi har fokus på at forstå beboernes perspektiver, følelser og behov og samtidig understøtte deres mulighed for at leve et så selvstændigt liv som muligt.

Vi har plads til 10 beboere efter §107 og §108 samt 9 pladser i vores træningsboliger, som ligger i nærheden af KærBo. Personalet yder daglig støtte begge steder, og som tilkaldevikar kan du derfor komme til at arbejde både i hovedhuset og i træningsboligerne.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med socialpsykiatri og/eller kendskab til den mentaliserende tilgang. Har du NADA-uddannelse, er dette ligeledes en fordel, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et meningsfuldt og alsidigt arbejde, hvor du gør en forskel for mennesker

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglighed, udvikling og trivsel

  • Engagerede og kompetente kolleger

  • Mulighed for at få erfaring inden for socialpsykiatrien

  • Fleksibilitet i forhold til vagter og mulighed for at blive en fast del af vores vikarkorps

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor den enkelte beboer er i centrum

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har en relevant uddannelse som eksempelvis pædagog, socialrådgiver, social- og sundhedsassistent, social- og sundhedshjælper eller anden relevant pædagogisk/socialfaglig baggrund

  • Har interesse for arbejdet med mennesker med psykiske udfordringer

  • Gerne har erfaring fra socialpsykiatrien, botilbud eller lignende

  • Kan arbejde ud fra en anerkendende og mentaliserende tilgang

  • Er rolig, nærværende og tydelig i din kommunikation

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå konstruktivt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og har mulighed for at tage vagter efter behov

  • Har lyst til at bidrage positivt til både beboernes hverdag og arbejdsfællesskabet

Det vigtigste for os er ikke nødvendigvis din specifikke uddannelse, men din faglighed, menneskelige tilgang og lyst til at arbejde med vores beboere.

Arbejdstid

Som tilkaldevikar vil vagterne primært være fordelt på dag- og aftenvagter samt weekender.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst med SL.

Forud for ansættelsen vil der blive indhentet straffeattest, og ansættelsen vil være betinget af, at denne er tilfredsstillende.

Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerleder Anders Lund på telefon 23 46 90 51 eller på mail kaerbo@kaerbolig.dk.

Ansøgning

Vi modtager gerne din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag løbende.

Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, hvor meget du forventer at kunne arbejde, og hvilke typer vagter du primært er interesseret i.

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig
jobs.description:
Vil du tage teknisk ansvar for vores Shopify-platforme og samtidig selv være hands-on i udviklingen?

Så skal du læse med her!

Vi søger en erfaren Shopify Plus udvikler til rollen som Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig, hvor du både bliver hands-on i koden og får et centralt teknisk ansvar. Du kommer til at løse komplekse problemer, bygge solide og skalerbare løsninger og få stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi videreudvikler vores e-commerce-platforme, tekniske standarder og løsninger på tværs af vores forretning.

Om GrejFreak.dk

GrejFreak.dk er Danmarks førende onlineforhandler af outdoor-, jagt- og militærudstyr. Vi leverer grej til både friluftsfolk, professionelle og helt almindelige danskere, der sætter pris på godt udstyr. Salget sker primært gennem GrejFreak.dk, men vi driver også andre webshops i Danmark og på internationale markeder.

Vi er en ambitiøs vækstvirksomhed med fokus på innovation, samarbejde og høj faglighed. Her er der plads til gode idéer, og vi lægger vægt på, at de hurtigt kan omsættes til handling.

Vores e-commerce-forretning er i vækst, og vi har mange spændende digitale initiativer foran os. Derfor ønsker vi at styrke vores interne tekniske kompetencer med en erfaren Shopify-specialist.

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Bidrage til den tekniske opbygning af nye shops, markeder og digitale koncepter, herunder GrejFreak.dk, GearFreak.de, ReadyBox.dk samt nye webshops til vores private label brands.

  • Arbejde med integrationer mellem Shopify og øvrige forretnings- og marketingplatforme.

  • Sikre en struktureret udviklingsproces med versionsstyring, test, kvalitetssikring og dokumentation.

  • Udvikle interne værktøjer, automatiseringer og AI-understøttede løsninger, der kan effektivisere arbejdsgange og gøre hverdagen lettere for kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

  • Fejlfinde og optimere eksisterende løsninger.

  • Vurdere tekniske løsningsmuligheder og rådgive om, hvornår noget bør udvikles, løses med standardfunktionalitet eller via tredjepartsløsninger.

  • Samarbejde med og kvalitetssikre leverancer fra eksterne udviklingspartnere.

  • Bidrage til fælles tekniske standarder og en robust, vedligeholdelsesvenlig platform.

Du bliver samtidig teknisk platformansvarlig og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe fælles tekniske standarder på tværs af vores webshops.

Det indebærer blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Sikre fælles tekniske standarder og en struktureret udviklingsproces.

  • Bidrage til en stabil, skalerbar og vedligeholdelsesvenlig Shopify-platform.

  • Dokumentere væsentlige tekniske løsninger og ændringer.

  • Vurdere tekniske risici og sikre robuste løsninger på tværs af vores webshops.

  • Sikre, at platformen og den tekniske viden er godt forankret internt.

Teknisk sparringspartner

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens øvrige teams og omsætte forretningsbehov til gode tekniske løsninger.

Vi forventer, at du kan rådgive om den bedste tekniske tilgang, udfordre unødigt komplekse løsninger og tænke i kvalitet, genbrugelighed og langsigtet vedligeholdelse.

Du skal med andre ord ikke blot implementere krav, men aktivt bidrage med teknisk sparring og foreslå den bedste vej frem.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid professionel erfaring med Shopify Plus og udvikling af skræddersyede Shopify-løsninger.

  • Har stærke kompetencer i Shopify Liquid samt HTML, CSS og JavaScript.

  • Har erfaring med theme development, custom komponenter og moderne udviklingsværktøjer.

  • Har arbejdet med API’er, integrationer og tekniske løsninger på tværs af systemer.

  • Har god forståelse for performance, tracking og de tekniske krav til en moderne e-commerce-platform.

  • Arbejder struktureret med kode, versionsstyring, test og dokumentation.

  • Kan fejlfinde systematisk og tage ansvar for løsninger fra idé til drift.

  • Har blik for, hvornår en løsning bør bygges, tilpasses eller løses med eksisterende funktionalitet.

  • Kan formidle tekniske problemstillinger klart til kolleger uden teknisk baggrund.

  • Tør udfordre løsninger fagligt og foreslå bedre eller mere enkle alternativer.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og trives samtidig med tæt samarbejde på tværs af virksomheden.

Erfaring med TypeScript, internationale Shopify-setups, A/B-testing og relevante e-commerce- eller marketingintegrationer er en fordel.

Det vigtigste er, at du er en erfaren Shopify-udvikler, som kan tage et reelt teknisk ejerskab og bidrage aktivt til den videre udvikling af vores platforme.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central teknisk rolle i en ambitiøs e-commerce-virksomhed i vækst.

  • Stor indflydelse på den tekniske udvikling af vores Shopify-platforme.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde hands-on med udvikling og sætte et tydeligt teknisk aftryk.

  • En varieret hverdag med både videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger og opbygning af nye digitale initiativer.

  • Mulighed for at præge tekniske standarder, arkitektur og udviklingsprocesser.

  • Tæt samarbejde med e-commerce, marketing og øvrige relevante funktioner.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger.

  • Attraktive medarbejderfordele, herunder rabat på vores sortiment og sociale arrangementer.

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi har ikke brug for en lang, klassisk ansøgning. Send os dit CV og fortæl kort om dig selv og din erfaring til HR@grejfreak.dk med emnefeltet “Senior Shopify Developer”

Vi vil gerne høre:

  1. Hvad arbejder du med i dag, og hvad har bragt dig frem til Shopify-udvikling?

  2. Hvilken Shopify-erfaring har du, som du mener er mest relevant for rollen?

  3. Beskriv en teknisk løsning eller udfordring, du har arbejdet med, som du er særligt tilfreds med.

  4. Hvilke typer udviklingsopgaver motiverer dig mest?

  5. Hvordan bruger du AI eller andre udviklingsværktøjer i dit daglige arbejde?

Du er også meget velkommen til at sende links til LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio eller løsninger, du har været med til at udvikle.

Ansøgningsfrist: 14. oktober 2026 - vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Independent B2B Sales Partner – 3D Visualization, Product Configurators and VR
jobs.description:
I am Soyhan Yazgan, a software developer based in Orimattila, Finland. I have six years of software-consulting experience, including 4.5 years working on an Unreal Engine–based digital instrument-cluster project for Ford Motor Company.

I hold a bachelors degree in Software Engineering from Metropolia University of Applied Sciences and a masters degree in Game Business Management from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. My core tools include Unreal Engine, 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and V-Ray.

I am now establishing an independent 3D/VR development studio and looking for a B2B sales partner whose commercial and relationship-building skills complement my technical expertise.

**What we would initially sell**

- Pre-rendered and real-time 3D visualization for architecture, machinery, furniture and vehicles, including still images, animations, interactive walkthroughs, and imagery for websites and print catalogs

- Interactive configurators for vehicles, kitchens, furniture systems, industrial equipment and other modular products

- VR or desktop-based product demonstrations, technical training applications and simulations


Potential customers include industrial manufacturers, training providers, construction and real estate companies, and marketing or design agencies that need a reliable white-label technical partner.

Typical projects run from several weeks to several months, with budgets of approximately €5,000–€30,000 excluding VAT, depending on scope. Engagements may begin as paid pilot projects, develop into recurring production work, or be delivered as larger phased projects.

**Your role**

- Identify and approach suitable B2B prospects

- Reach the appropriate decision-makers and qualify opportunities

- Arrange and lead introductory sales conversations

- Join discovery, proposal and negotiation meetings

- Help position the solution around the customers business problem

- Attend relevant trade fairs or customer meetings when mutually agreed


I will handle technical discovery, demonstrations, estimates, project scoping and delivery. We will agree on pricing boundaries together, and no proposal will be submitted without mutual approval.

**Commercial arrangement**

This is initially a flexible, non-exclusive independent partnership; not salaried employment. There is currently no guaranteed retainer or minimum number of hours.

Proposed commission model:

- 20% of collected project revenue, excluding VAT and agreed third-party expenses, for clients you source and actively help close


Commission would be paid proportionally as customer payments are received. Lead ownership, existing contacts, repeat projects, cancellations and post-termination commissions would be defined in a written agreement before outreach begins.

The arrangement is particularly suitable for an independent sales professional or agency that already serves relevant B2B customers and wants to add 3D, Unreal Engine or VR services to its offering.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

- Experience selling custom B2B services or technology projects

- Professional Finnish and English communication skills

- Strong prospecting, relationship-building and negotiation skills

- Contacts in manufacturing, training, construction, real estate or marketing

- The ability to work independently and represent technical services professionally


A particular degree is not required. Relevant results, relationships and business judgement are more important.

**Interested?**

Please send me:

- A short introduction

- Your LinkedIn profile

- The sectors in which you have experience or contacts

- An example of a B2B service or project you have helped sell


Email: soyhan15@gmail.com

I would be happy to arrange an introductory meeting to discuss the offering, target customers and cooperation model.

Soyhan Yazgan

À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métie

jobs.title: Infrastructure & Security Manager | Cibes Lift Group | Gävle
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT infrastructure and security? Do you combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach? Join Cibes Lift Group at our headquarters in Gävle, Sweden, and play a key role in shaping and securing the future IT landscape of a growing global organization. This position is based on-site in Gävle and requires regular presence at our headquarters.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/61b92e02-1bff-4b85-8403-9bc902a906b2.jpg">

Shape the Future of Infrastructure & Security

As Infrastructure & Security Manager, you will lead the development of the infrastructure and security capabilities that support Cibes Lift Group's operations. From production facilities and offices to field technicians serving customers around the world, you will ensure that critical IT services remain secure, reliable, and fit for future growth.

This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with local IT teams, business stakeholders, and colleagues across the group. You will lead a team of specialists while collaborating with managed service providers and strategic partners to drive modernization, standardization, and operational excellence.

Your responsibilities include:

    Leading and evolving the group's Infrastructure & Security function.
    Ensuring secure, stable, and cost-efficient IT operations across a global organization.
    Driving continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability within the domain.
    Managing budgets, investments, and service performance while balancing risk, quality, and cost.
    Defining and implementing global IT policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
    Acting as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and local IT teams.
    Supporting acquisitions and leading IT integration activities for newly acquired companies.
    Contributing to both long-term strategy and hands-on operational initiatives.

Are You the Leader We're Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced IT leader who understands how technology can enable business success. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term strategy with senior stakeholders as you are rolling up your sleeves to solve operational challenges.

To succeed in this role, you likely have:

    A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
    Several years of experience within IT Infrastructure and Security.
    Experience driving modernization, transformation, and operational excellence initiatives.
    Strong knowledge of Information Security principles and best practices.
    Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international or/and decentralized environment.
    Experience leading projects and cross-functional initiatives.
    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
    Fluent in Swedish and English both written and spoken.
    Permanent authorization to work in Sweden.

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    Experience with mergers and acquisitions, including IT integration projects.
    Experience with cloud platforms and modern workplace technologies, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

About you:

You are a business-oriented and collaborative leader who thrives on translating technology into business value. While you are comfortable setting strategic direction, you are equally willing to engage in operational challenges when needed. Your ability to build trust, foster collaboration, and navigate the balance between global standardization and local requirements enables you to successfully drive change in an international environment.

Application

In this recruitment process, Cibes Lift Group is partnering with Jefferson Wells. You will be employed directly by Cibes Lift Group.



Apply by clicking "Ansök nu" in the advertisement. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.

For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact:

Marjo Carlson, recruitment consultant; 070 377 06 64, marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se

Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than September 17, 2026. Selection and interviews are conducted on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Welcome to Cibes Lift Group and the opportunity to make a real impact on the future of Infrastructure & Security.

Cibes Lift Group is one of the world's most innovative manufacturers of space-saving lifts designed for fast and easy installation, also offering a wide range of conventional lift solutions. Thanks to the wide range of lift products and a flexible design concept, the lift solutions of Cibes Lift Group adapt to the requirements of public, commercial, and private settings. Sales, installation, and maintenance services are provided by a global network of subsidiaries and partners. The company group is headquartered in Gävle, Sweden, and has production facilities in Sweden, Poland, China, and USA. In 2026 the Group had approximately 1980 employees and a revenue of 3,6 billion SEK.

jobs.title: Cloud Developer
jobs.description:
The Cloud Platform organization develops and maintains cloud services globally to contribute to the overall connected experience for customers. We build, provide and operate a highly secure run-time ecosystem for functions and applications serving our connected cars, and their users. We aim to optimize functional and organic growth by using standard cloud technologies with high level of synergies and re-use. With car cloud solution, we provide cloud infrastructure, platform core & services to support software development lifecycle (DevOps) by providing tools for fast feedback & built-in quality.

What you´ll do

The mission is to create a great developer experience by providing platform products that support high performance & productivity. You will collaborate with your Product Owner to ensure the right functionality is being developed and estimate the size and complexity of the work to be able to plan upcoming sprints. You will determine and maintain the technical design in our area within the given architectural guidelines.

Tech we use daily:

SW Languages: Java (Spring-boot)

Frameworks: Spring, Istio

IDP: Azure AD, AWS IAM

Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker

Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Oracle

IaC: Terraform, Crossplane

Message broker: Kafka, JMS

Protocols: MQTT, gRPC, REST HTTP

Tools: GitLab, ArgoCD, Github

Test automation: JUnit 5 , Testcontainers

Monitoring: Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty

Architecture: Micro Service Architecture

Development methodology principles: Scrum, Kanban, GitOps

Automation: python, bash

Do you fit the profile?

We believe you have at least 5 years of experience with Java development. You probably have a BSc degree or higher in computer science or equivalent.

In order to thrive in the team, you should not be afraid to work also with the Infrastructure side of Cloud Development, including configuration.

Previous experience in handling car-related information to the cloud, to cars, to mobile apps and to partners, is highly valued. You have experience with AWS, Java, Kafka, Python and Kubernetes.

We also think you have understanding in agile development methodology principles (e.g., Scrum, Lean, Kanban) and have worked in product teams. We see that you are fluent in the English language.

For you to fully enjoy this opportunity, we believe that you have a genuine interest of working and developing in a product area. You embrace teamwork, collaboration and are eager to learn and develop new competences. We also expect you to be on top of technology evolution within software development and provide new ideas to continuously improve the product and our processes.

As a person you are communicative and can easily collaborate. You are supportive to your team and open and flexible. Curious, with a can-do attitude.

Additional info:

We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.
