Course Director UX UI and AI
jobs.description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • Youâre aÂ forward thinkerÂ who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skillsÂ because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ led a design team.

  • YouÂ publish your own thinking on design: articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence.

  • You'veÂ spoken at design conferences, or you're on a first-name basis with people who do.

  • You'veÂ created design systems. Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing.

  • You've worked as anÂ editor, or you've createdÂ online courses.

  • You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning toolsÂ yourself, or you've used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in UX, UI, HCI,Â AI, or a similar field.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field.Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • Colleagues with four to forty years of experience, and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a directionÂ that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

We expect you to be reliable, proactive, efficient, cheerful, and physically fit. The salary will be determined in accordance with the Finnish hospitality industrys collective agreement (MaRa).

We hope you have:

- A valid Hygiene Passport and Alcohol Serving Passport

- Good Finnish language skills; English is considered an advantage

- The ability to independently prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner

- The ability to maintain kitchen cleanliness and handle other daily kitchen duties

- Experience independently managing buffet service

- Professional references


The position begins in late November and continues until early April. The exact starting and ending dates, as well as working hours, can be agreed upon.

The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. If you are moving to Enontekiö from elsewhere, we can assist you in finding accommodation.

Come and work in the spectacular surroundings of Käsivarsi, Finnish Lapland, for the winter season!

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You, the Education Designer,Â establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, and theÂ Course Directors, who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, ourÂ Course Writers and EditorsÂ take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.Â You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments thatÂ turn passive watching into active designing. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments,Â so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

  • Make expert knowledge understandable.Â You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

  • You help produce Master Classes.Â We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously: with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • YouÂ plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leadersÂ in design and thenÂ fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Our courses combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus onÂ one large course creation project per quarter, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • You know the difference betweenÂ timeless human-centered design skills and skills in tools that change. Youâre passionate about the first, because theyâre the most interesting to you and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon. Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling to a more senior role.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals. You give constructive feedback that others can act on, and you take it the same way. When someone shows you how your idea could be better, you're interested rather than defensive.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses. You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ publishedÂ educational material under your own name orÂ spokenÂ at design conferences.

  • You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning: tutors, adaptive paths, automated feedback. Or youâve used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ in UX, UI, AI, or a similar field.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • You haveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role:Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. A workshop facilitator might teach one hundred designers a year. Your design decisions will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â The experts you'd normally cite in a workshop are the people whose material you'll be shaping, whose Master Classes you'll produce, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.   • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • Colleagues with four to forty years of experience, and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, youâre in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then youâll find virtuallyÂ limitless opportunities with us.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a directionÂ that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

jobs.title: First-line IT Support Technician to a Global AI Scaleup!
jobs.description:
Are you a tech-savvy professional looking to work at the heart of Stockholm's most exciting AI scene? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where structure is built as you go and where you get to take on significant responsibility from day one? Then you are exactly who we’re looking for!

About the role

We are seeking a First Line IT Support Technician, for one of Sweden’s fastest-growing tech companies. You will play a key role in ensuring daily operations run smoothly as the company scales globally. Working closely with the IT Manager, you will act as his "extra pair of hands" while he focuses on international expansion and strategic projects. You will be instrumental in onboarding new employees, managing IT infrastructure, and resolving daily technical challenges within a fast-paced startup environment.

The position is full-time (100%) for 6 months, with potential for extension. This is an entirely on-site role.

You are offered

    A dynamic work environment at a groundbreaking AI company and a unique opportunity to contribute to their hyper-growth journey, with potential for long-term career growth beyond the initial 6-month contract.

Work tasks

This role involves providing crucial first-line IT support and managing various aspects of their internal IT infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring technical readiness for employees, supporting company events, and maintaining IT systems to facilitate their rapid expansion.

    Provide first-line IT support and manage ticket resolution.  
    Offer technical and audio-video support for office events and town hall meetings.  
    Reinstall, refurbish and prepare laptops for new users.  
    Procure, unpack and assemble IT hardware.  
    Conduct IT introduction sessions for new hires.  
    Perform data cleanup in internal IT systems.  
    Support all-hands meetings with technical setup, including microphones and screens.

We are looking for

    Proven experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.
    Experience in helpdesk or first-line IT support.
    Previous office experience demonstrating professional maturity.
    Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as this is the corporate language.
    Basic understanding of IT concepts, software development workflows, and SaaS environments.
    AI & Tech curious - beyond the chatbot: You don’t just use AI, you build with it. We are looking for someone with a strong passion for modern software development and automation. You have a proven track record of experimenting with tech in your spare time, whether that’s building an app, setting up autonomous agents, or playing around with Claude and GitHub Copilot to streamline your own workflow. A GitHub profile or a portfolio of hobby projects is highly valued.
    Ability to work full-time on-site at the office in Stockholm.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Supportive: A helpful mindset toward colleagues and users, with proactive communication.
    Stress tolerant: Able to maintain quality under pressure while demonstrating patience and calmness.
    Goal oriented: Focused on delivering results and solving problems.
    Orderly: You keep things orderly even in a high-tempo setting.
    Responsible: You take full ownership of your tasks and have ability to work independently and navigate changing workflows.
    Change oriented: You embrace growth and adapt easily to evolving processes.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: App Developer
jobs.description:
LumenRadio is a high-tech company with the vision of replacing all cables in the world. We have been leading the wireless transformation within the lighting industry since 2008, where our technology is being used every day in the largest TV and Movie productions in Hollywood, at the Coachella festival, and the Eurovision Song Contest. Our patented technologies provide unprecedented reliability for the most business-critical applications and our products are now also being used in building automation solutions.

Your future

We are looking for our next Senior Mobile App Developer to join our product development team within Entertainment Lighting. In this role, you will take on senior responsibilities and be accountable for the continued development and maintenance of our mobile applications for iOS and Android built with Flutter. While your primary focus will be within the Entertainment Lighting team, you will also be expected to manage multiple apps across different teams and projects, balancing the needs of each while keeping the overall architecture consistent and maintainable.

You will improve the existing user experience while exploring new ways for users to interact with our products. You will work closely with hardware and embedded teams to create seamless integrations between our products and mobile applications.

An important part of our approach to product development is having a deep understanding of our customers' challenges and a close understanding of the environment in which our products are used. As a senior developer, we expect you to be driven by a desire to understand the entertainment lighting industry. It's also important that you are comfortable navigating autonomously in vague and unfamiliar environments while being a solid and central team player who can support junior colleagues as well as consultants.

As part of maintaining a close dialogue with our customers and partners, we encourage you to participate in trade shows and engineering meet-ups around the world approximately 2-3 times per year.

About you

For the role to be a good match, we believe that you:

    

Have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Interaction design, Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent

    

Have experience developing Flutter applications for both Android and iOS, as well as some experience with native mobile development.

    

Have an eye for user experience and an interest in creating intuitive interfaces.

    

Are familiar with Figma and have the ability to work in it

    

Are curious about customers, their workflows and the market, and enjoy translating those insights into better products.

    

Have an interest in embedded systems and hardware-related development, ideally with hands-on experience using platforms such as Arduino, ESP32 or similar.

    

Are curious and proactive, enjoy exploring unfamiliar technologies, and continuously seek opportunities to improve our products and development practices.

    

Are fluent in English, written and spoken

It is advantageous if you also have:

    

Experience publishing and maintaining applications in Google Play and App Store.

    

Experience with Bluetooth/BLE or wireless networking (Bluetooth/BLE, Zigbee, WiFi, LoRa, Thread, 6LoWPAN, NB-IoT, 5G etc.)

    

Experience from the entertainment lighting industry

Our tech stack

    

Whatever OS and editor that make you productive

    

Flutter

    

GitLab and GitLab CI

    

Bluetooth (mainly BLE)

Diversity and culture

We are on a mission to replace all cables in the world, and we are looking for you who share our passion for cutting-edge technology! We value diversity and welcome different-minded professionals who are committed to our ambitious goals. We warmly welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds and genders.

If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing nelly.bertilsson@lumenradio.com.

Our Benefits

    

We offer good job security through agreements and insurance, paid parental leave, holiday leave, and attractive pension plans📃

    

Yearly health allowance - For your physical activity and well-being🧘🏽

    

Yearly personal development allowance - For your brain and creativity🧠

    

Free access to the gym in the same building🏋🏽‍♂️

    

Flexible working hours⌚

    

Not to mention our coffee club, lunch run, "Among Us" tournaments, and much more! ☕

More information  This is a full-time position at our Head Office in Gothenburg. In this position, you will report to Erik Abrahamsson, Product Development Manager, Building & Industrial Control Systems, and responsible recruiter is Nelly Bertilsson.  Don't hesitate to reach out to nelly.bertilsson@lumenradio.com if you have any questions.

We kindly ask not to be contacted for external recruitment services for this recruitment process.

Tule kanssamme työskentelemään kiireisimmän ja upeimman juhlasesonkimme, eli pikkujoulusesongin läpi!

Ravintolatyöntekijänä työskentelet monipuolisesti Vaakunan tilaus- ja kokousravintolan tehtävissä, tukien sujuvia asiakastilaisuuksia. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. jobs.title: Genopslag: Pædagog eller social-/sundhedsfaglig medarbejder søges til Snåstrup Vestergård
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye kollega?
Er du pædagog – nyuddannet eller erfaren? 
Eller har du en relevant social- eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og den rette erfaring?
Har du samtidig lyst til et spændende og meningsfuldt arbejde med mennesker med udviklingshæmning, herunder borgere med dom?
Så er det måske lige dig, vi leder efter på Snåstrup Vestergård

Om Jobbet:
På Snåstrup Vestergaard – en del af Center for Specialpædagogik og Psykiatri (CSP) søger vi en socialpædagog eller pædagogisk assistent. 

Vi arbejder vi ud fra en grundlæggende tro på, at borgeren skal være ved roret i eget liv. Vores tilgang er recovery-orienteret rehabiliterende, og vi har et stærkt fokus på at understøtte borgernes håb, drømme og ønsker – både dem, der former hverdagen og dem, der rækker længere ud i livet. Det kræver en høj grad af faglighed, struktur og vedholdenhed, men også masser af nærvær, humor og varme i hverdagen.
Vi har pt plads til 20 borgere, som alle lever med et udviklingshandicap og har brug for denne særligt tilrettelagte pædagogiske indsats, er kriminalitetstruede eller idømte en foranstaltningsdom. Udviklingshandicappet er ofte kombineret med andre udfordringer som psykiatriske diagnoser og misbrugsproblematikker.

Din profil:
Som pædagog på Snåstrup bliver du en central del af et tværfagligt team med pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergoterapeut, sygeplejerske samt pædagogiske assistenter. Sammen med dine kollegaer får du ansvar for at tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere indsatser med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers behov, ressourcer og ønsker for livet.

I praksis betyder det, at du:

  • Støtter borgerne i deres dagligdag, fx omkring måltider, personlig omsorg, struktur og aktiviteter.
  • Planlægger og deltager i aktiviteter i dag- og fritidslivet, fx musik, madlavning, gåture, samt ledsagelse til behandlingstilbud som fx rusmiddelcenteret. 
  • Dokumenterer og evaluerer pædagogiske indsatser i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Arbejder metodisk med afsæt i KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik) og neuropædagogisk tilgang. Desuden er vi i gang med implementering af LA2u, som du vil blive introduceret til. En metode til at inddrage borgerens indefra-perspektiv, forebygge voldsomme episoder og styrke trivsel, særligt tilpasset borgere med udviklingshæmning.
  • Indgår i samarbejdet om at skabe struktur, ro og tryghed, også i situationer, der kan være uforudsigelige eller præget af udadreagerende adfærd.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant socialfaglig eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse. 
  • Er nyuddannet og gerne vil have erfaring hos os eller kan have erfaring fra lignende område – gerne med borgere med udviklingshandicap og udfordrende adfærd - men det er ikke et krav.
  • Møder både borgere og kollegaer med respekt, ordentlighed og en anerkendende tilgang.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og handle konstruktivt i uforudsigelige situationer.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaverne kan være mangeartede: fra praktiske gøremål til komplekse pædagogiske indsatser.
  • Har gyldigt kørekort og kan anvende IT til dokumentation.
  • Bidrager med stabilitet, engagement og et positivt sind - også når det går stærkt.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig:

Vi ønsker at skabe rammer, hvor både borgere og medarbejdere kan udvikle sig. Som ny pædagog på Snåstrup får du derfor:

  • Et grundigt introduktionsforløb med mentor og mulighed for introvagter efter behov.
  • Løbende faglig sparring, supervision og teammøder.
  • Mulighed for deltagelse i årlige temadage med fokus på faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi tager arbejdsmiljøet alvorligt, og hvor der er plads til både faglige ambitioner, humor og fællesskab.

Kort sagt: Et job med faglige udfordringer, personlig udvikling og mulighed for at være en del af et sted, hvor indsatsen virkelig gør en forskel for andre mennesker.

Her kan du se lidt mere om Snåstrup: 

John D Band - SÆRTRANSPORT - official video 2021

Snåstrups Miljøteam maj 2024 - beboernes perspektiv

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.
Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest. Arbejdstiderne er dag og aftenvagter med et overtal af aftenvagter. Weekendarbejde hver anden weekend. 
Ugentligt timetal: Fuldtid.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til: Afdelingsleder Djanik Gade Laursen på 23807568 eller Line Julie Holck på 41876746

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfrist er: søndag d. 6/9
Samtalerne afholdes torsdag d. 10/9

Opstart 1. november eller efter aftale. 
Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Stillinger i Aarhus Kommune søges elektronisk. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os
Centret samler bo- og aktivitetstilbud til borgere med udviklingshæmning, herunder personer med behov for en specialiseret indsats som følge af aldring, psykiatri, hjerneskade, dom, rusmiddelproblematikker eller et omfattende behov for pleje og omsorg. Indsatsen i centeret har fokus på at styrke borgernes forbundethed gennem relationer, almene fællesskaber og deltagelse i samfundslivet. Der arbejdes med at fremme borgerens tro på egne evner og bidrage til en selvforståelse der rækker udover funktionsnedsættelsen. Gennem hverdags- og arbejdsaktiviteter styrkes borgernes indflydelse på eget liv og evne til at mestre det. Centret har samlet fokus på at sikre en sammenhængende helhedsindsats på tværs af døgnet med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer, behov og muligheder.
  
Om Sociale Forhold og BeskæftigelseVi ved, at det gode liv går gennem uddannelse, job og selvforsørgelse for langt de fleste – og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle. Derfor er vi mere end 7000 mennesker, der går på arbejde hver dag for aarhusianere med et handicap, et integrationsbehov, dem, der lever socialt udsatte liv og dem, der har brug for at finde vej til det næste job. Vi arbejder med alt det, der er svært, men også med det vigtigste, der findes: aarhusianernes kernevelfærd. Vi er årligt i kontakt med omkring 100.000 aarhusianere, der får vores støtte til et liv med håb og handlekraft.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.    

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

 

06-09-2026

jobs.title: IT INCIDENT MANAGER
jobs.description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:   Challenges you will work on:  





Some roles prevent disruption before it happens. Others take charge when it does. As Incident Manager at SAS, you will coordinate the response to major IT incidents, helping restore critical services while keeping stakeholders informed and operations moving. You will act as the central point of coordination during major incidents, bringing together technical teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to manage critical situations effectively. In a fast-paced and business-critical environment, you will help minimize disruption, support operational stability, and drive continuous improvement across incident management processes. Success in this role requires a calm, structured, and collaborative approach, with the ability to make informed decisions and communicate clearly under pressure.







Your responsibilities include:




    Lead and coordinate the response to major IT incidents until services are restored and stabilized.  
    Assess business impact and urgency, ensuring the right technical teams and suppliers are engaged quickly.  
    Facilitate incident bridges and coordinate actions, escalations, decisions, and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.  
    Maintain focus on service restoration while supporting investigation, workaround, and recovery activities.  
    Provide timely and audience-appropriate communication to business stakeholders, operational teams, and IT leadership.  
    Escalate incidents to senior leadership, suppliers, and external partners when required.  
    Ensure that incident records, timelines, decisions, and communications are accurately maintained in ServiceNow.  
    Drive effective handover to Problem Management and support Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews.  
    Monitor incident trends, recurring issues, and response performance to identify opportunities for improvement.  
    Develop and maintain incident playbooks, communication templates, readiness exercises, and operational procedures.  
    Contribute to strengthening SAS’ incident response capabilities and service management practices.

    



The Team  

You will be part of the Service Management organization and work closely with Service Desk, IT Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Cybersecurity, and Application teams. The role involves extensive collaboration with Service Owners, Product Owners, business stakeholders, technology suppliers, and operational functions across SAS. Together, you will help ensure that critical services remain available, resilient, and capable of supporting business-critical airline operations. As SAS continues to strengthen its operational service management capabilities, effective incident management plays an increasingly important role in delivering stable and reliable technology services.





     To be successful we believe you have



  


    Experience managing incidents in a large, complex, and business-critical IT environment.  
    Strong understanding of ITIL Incident Management, with working knowledge of Problem Management and Change Management.  
    Experience coordinating multiple technical teams and suppliers during high-pressure situations.  
    Excellent communication skills, including the ability to provide clear updates to both technical teams and senior stakeholders.  
    The ability to make structured decisions with incomplete information and remain calm during operational disruptions.  
    Experience working with ServiceNow or a similar IT Service Management platform.  
    Experience from aviation, transportation, or other 24/7 mission-critical environments is considered an advantage.  
    Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and collaboration skills.  
    A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.  
    ITIL certification, or equivalent practical experience, is considered an advantage.  

        Our Culture at SAS  

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!  







Come and fly with us!





     Additional information



  


    Apply by: 16/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.  
    Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.  
    Location: This position is based in Stockholm or Copenhagen. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.  
    Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.  







If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jarno Putta, Head of Service Management, at jarno.putta@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

jobs.description:
Tomodomo is an independent, Oslo-based Ramen & Udon concept focused on handcrafted Food!

Location: Pilestredet 24, Oslo (5 min walk from Nationaltheatret)

Working Language: English (Norwegian is a plus, but non-Norwegian speakers are fully welcome!)

Positions Available: Both Part-time and Full-time roles

Start Date: September 2026.

Note: Please read the full Application. Thanks!

Hva vi ser etter

Who We Are Looking For:

At Tomodomo, Kitchen Director Justin Klungsøyr and our Team have built a closeknit Family. Above all, we believe that everything starts with enjoying what you do, because when you truly love the process, great food, creativity, and good vibes for our guests and team follow naturally.

At the end of the day, we're looking for candidates who genuinely care about Food and Hospitality. We want a teammate who is excited to learn and grow together with us.

You will thrive with us if you bring:

  • Joy in the Process: You genuinely enjoy being in the kitchen, working with your hands, and bringing good energy to the room.

  • A Passion for Craftsmanship: You're curious about food, cooking techniques, and the history behind authentic handcrafted dishes.

  • A Growth Mindset: You come to work eager to refine your skills day by day, learning side-by-side with Justin and the kitchen crew.

  • A Team-First Spirit: You want to be part of a supportive crew where everyone has each other's back when things get busy.

  • Pride & Reliability: You take pride in doing things right---from prep to plating---and bring a honest, dependable work ethic.

jobs.title: Barcelona Winbacksäljare

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av rörliga elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Ravintolatyöntekijäksi kokouspalvelun tehtäviin Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan

Tule vastaamaan asiakkaidemme sujuvista ja viimeistellyistä tilaus- ja kokoustapahtumista! Haemme Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokous- ja tilausravintolaan kahta ravintolatyöntekijää työskentelemään kokouspalvelun tehtävissä. Tehtävät ovat osa-aikaisia, 20 h/vko ja määräaikaisia vuoden 2026 loppuun, aloitus on joustavasti sovittavissa. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme niin arkena kuin myös juhlapyhinä, joten työvuorot voivat sijoittua koko viikon akselille ja kyseessä on vaihteleva vuorotyö.

Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä ja luomaan elämyksiä, jotka jäävät asiakkaidemme mieleen!

Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu kokouspalveluiden toteuttaminen aina kokoustilojen valmistelusta ja asiakkaiden toiveiden huomioimisesta kahvitarjoiluiden esillelaittoon ja lounastarjoiluun. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan erilaisten tilaisuuksien ja illallisten järjestämiseen kokous- ja tilausravintolassamme. Tarjoilut toteutetaan tilanteen mukaan buffet- tai pöytiintarjoiluna, ja kokonaisuuksiin kuuluu myös juomatarjoilu. Asiakastilaisuudet vaihtelevat pienistä ja tunnelmallisista kokouksista suuriin messuihin, juhliin ja jopa häihin, joten yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen.

Meille kaikkein tärkeintä on aito huomaavaisuus ja asiakkaidemme odotusten ylittäminen. Odotamme sinulta tinkimätöntä palveluasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua työskennellä tiiminä kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita ja onnistumisia. Haluat ottaa vastuuta onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista ja varmistaa vieraidemme viihtyvyyden kokous toisensa jälkeen. Aiempi kokemus ravintola-alalta tai asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi. Tehtävässä edellytetään täysi-ikäisyyttä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän upeassa hotelliympäristössä, jossa pääset luomaan mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ympäristön, jossa laatu, vieraanvaraisuus ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat keskiössä.

💚 Meillä Satakunnan Osuuskaupalla sinulla on mahdollisuus osoittaa kiinnostustasi myös vastuutehtäviin ja uralla kehittymiseen sekä työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja Satakunnan Osuuskaupan kattavat henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä.

💰 Palkka määräytyy MaRaVa-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (13,70–15,04 €/h). Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus myös suoritepalkkioon.

Hakuaika päättyy su 13.9.2026.

Lisätietoja saat ravintolapäällikkö Pia Hirvelältä, pia.hirvela@sok.fi tai p. +358 44 725 1027.

Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Olemme osa valtakunnallista S-ryhmää.

Vi er et center i udvikling og søger derfor nye medarbejdere – og meget gerne en studerende, fleksjobber, efterlønner eller lign. Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling fra 4 til 12 timer ugentligt og flere ved weekend, ferie mm. 

Beskrivelse af jobbet og forventninger:

En stor del af jobbet vil være kontakt med vores medlemmer, instruere brugerne af vores maskiner og koncept, samt rengøring.

Efter grundig kort oplæring af vores koncept, skal du udføre prøve- og instruktørtimer til nye og nuværende medlemmer ved guidning og fysisk instruktion.

Du skal på brugerniveau kunne benytte vores eget IT-system til at oprette nye medlemmer, oprette aftaler mm. Du skal kunne tale og skrive dansk, da du både er i personlig kontakt, telefonisk kontakt og skrivende kontakt med medlemmer og kollegaer.

Du skal være smilende, serviceminded og empatisk og du skal kunne kommunikere med kunder i alle aldre

Du skal fysisk kunne deltage i rengøringsopgaver i centret, da vi sætter stor pris på at vores center altid er pænt og rent, men opgaverne er tilpasset og opdelt.

Du skal kunne træne i vores udstyr og hvis man har lyst, er der mulighed for at kunne undervise i holdtræning.

Du skal selvstændigt kunne arbejde på vagter af 4-6 timers varighed ad gangen hvor man aktivt skal være i centret i hele vagten, gående og stående med afveksling. Vagterne kan ligge i både formiddags- og eftermiddagstimerne, samt i weekender.

Der vil til tider være arrangementer, events og outgoing opgaver.

Vi forventer at du er god til at skabe kontakt til andre mennesker, er ansvarsbevidst, selvkørende, smilende og udadvendt. At du kan få alle vores medlemmer til at føle sig velkommen, hver gang de kommer og træner.

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

I LOOP er vi kendt for vores gode service og nærvær og vores arrangement sammen med vores medlemmer, så du vil blive en del af et godt team, der hjælper hinanden og du vil få en arbejdsplads med skønne sociale medlemmer omkring dig.

Hos os kan du forvente et arbejde med frihed under ansvar, du vil blive grundigt oplært i den daglige drift, og der vil løbende være kurser der oplære dig i korrekt brug af maskinerne mm.

Lyder det som jobbet for dig, så send en mail til Tanja på tjm@loopfitness.dk

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til samtaler, med opstart snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Portfolio Planner
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Portfolio Planner on the behalf of our client.

Background:

Join us as a Portfolio Planner and become the driving force behind operational excellence in portfolio planning. In this role, you will not only take ownership of identifying Portfolio (processes, data and tools) gaps, proposing solutions, and ensuring identified improvements reach full implementation but you will also develop advanced tools and Power BI dashboards. If you thrive on turning complex data into actionable insights and enjoy influencing change through technology and collaboration, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

Key responsibilities:

Portfolio Planning:

    Proactively identify gaps and underperforming processes, analyze bottlenecks, and drive improvements independently (from gap identification through solution design and full implementation readiness) working closely with stakeholders to ensure alignment with organizational objectives
    Maintain and update the integrated portfolio roadmap aligned with business needs and other organisations
    Ensure transparency of data through clear visualization (Portfolio views, programmes views, project views, org workload, KPIs, Decisions, Financial views, etc.)
    Benchmark outside the organization to identify possible improvement opportunities

Governance & Reporting:

    Support governance forums with data-driven insights and recommendations
    Ensure data accuracy of portfolio dashboards, KPIs, and status reports for better-informed strategic and operational decisions

Data Collection & Preparation:

    Gathering data from primary and secondary sources. Ensuring data accuracy and consistency by organizing and preparing it for analysis
    Optimizing data management to fit consumption purposes

Tool Development & Automation:

    Design and develop Power BI dashboards for portfolio reporting and KPIs
    Create automation workflows using Power Automate and VBA scripts to streamline processes
    Integrate new tools into existing infrastructure with minimal disruption

Data Management & Integration:

    Optimize data flows between SAP, PlanView, and other portfolio systems
    Prepare and organize data for consumption and decision-making
    Oversee the implementation process of new systems/tools and integrate them into existing infrastructure with minimal disruption

Knowledge & Skills:

    Procedures, processes and needs: Knowledge of organizational processes, procedures, systems, tools and existing data/information (Waterfall, Agile, PlanView, SAP, Early management, etc.)
    Familiarity with financial planning and budgeting processes
    Deep knowledge of computer science, IT infrastructure, and systems
    Advanced Power Automate skill
    Deep understanding of SAP transactions and dataflows
    Advanced PowerBi development skills
    Able to create VBA scripts to improve Excel files usage

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or related field.
    3–5+ years of experience in portfolio planning, project management, or strategic planning.

Profile:

    Driven and Problem-solving oriented: able to identify gaps, provide solutions and drive the solution implementation proactively, supporting business productivity and growth
    Detailed oriented: Solutions must be robust and fully aligned with stakeholders
    Change management aware

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are Benifex? 💚💜

We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀

Why should you apply? 🌟

    Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
    Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
    Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
    Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
    Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
    Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space

Great benefits

🧠 ITP1 pension.

❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.

📝 Collective agreement.

💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.

🤸 Generous wellness allowance.

✈️ 30 vacation days / year.

💰 Referral bonuses.

🌟 Enhanced parental pay.

🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.

Role Overview 🚀

As a Software Developer in one of our platform-oriented teams, you'll work almost entirely on backend development (90%+), with occasional, light frontend involvement.

The team owns the foundational components and services that the rest of the platform is built on, such as the core frameworks, the user and company data domain, and the APIs and platform services that every other team depends on. Reliability, data integrity and security are central to everything the team delivers.

This role is focused on turning business and architectural needs into well-built, maintainable systems: designing clean APIs, evolving long-lived frameworks safely, and helping share knowledge across our internal developer community.

You'll also help shape our ways of working and technical direction. You'll join a focused team of engineers working alongside a tech lead, a product manager and an engineering manager in Gothenburg.

We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.

Responsibilities 🤘

    Design, build and maintain backend services, APIs and shared frameworks to a high standard.
    Evolve and progressively refactor a large, long-lived codebase safely.
    Treat non-functional qualities such as reliability, backward compatibility, data integrity, security and performance as high priority.
    Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, working with domain experts to keep solutions aligned with the business.
    Participate in code reviews and uphold shared coding standards.
    Write automated integration and component tests.
    Help drive technical decisions, reduce technical debt, and document and share knowledge so critical areas aren't held by one person.

Responsibilities 🤘

    Develop backend services and maintain high coding standards.
    Contribute to frontend changes using JavaScript and TypeScript when needed.
    Collaborate with developers, product owners, UX designers, and other stakeholders.
    Participate in code reviews and uphold team coding standards.
    Implement automated integration and component tests.
    Drive technical strategy, refactor legacy code, and reduce technical debt.
    Engage in pair and mob programming sessions to solve the more complex problems together.

What are we looking for? 🔎

    Strong experience with Java, SQL, and Spring / Spring Boot.
    Solid understanding of Git and CI/CD pipelines.
    API design and development (REST / OpenAPI).
    As this is central to the role, we want someone who cares about clear, well-versioned, dependable interfaces.
    Experienced in evaluating trade-offs between solution design, quality, and timeframes.
    Comfort working in large, established codebases.
    This includes reading unfamiliar code, understanding existing frameworks, and making careful, incremental changes rather than rewriting from scratch.
    Practical experience in Domain-Driven Design, including working with domain experts to build well-aligned, maintainable systems.
    A collaborative way of working. This means enjoying being in the office with the team as required, working through pair and mob programming when it helps, communicating openly, and constructively challenging ideas.

Important, but not essential:

    Microservices experience: Most of our work happens within an established platform and its shared frameworks, so we value the judgement to know when a service boundary is worth drawing more than a long list of microservices built.
    AI-assisted development: We care more about a learning mindset and curiosity for using AI tools to work better than about existing skillset.
    Cloud platforms: We're progressively moving towards GCP, we experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) is preferred.
    Asynchronous messaging, pub/sub and system integration, and data-exchange patterns.
    Observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana) and Hibernate.

jobs.title: Order Management Leader
jobs.description:
What are we looking for?

We are looking for a leader on a strong seniority level, not a specialist profile. A person able to lead topics in complicated organization structure. Ability to work towards solutions rather than the ability to point out what is wrong. A leader having experience in change management, ability to change the way we work today. Ability to work directly with key stakeholders including country organizations, digital and towards other retail areas.

•    Minimum of 9 years of relevant professional experience.  

•    An experienced leader with the ability to understand, navigate, and influence complex processes.  

•    Proven senior leadership capabilities, built on strong expertise within Order Management.  

•    Solid experience leading initiatives, projects, or transformational topics.  

•    Deep understanding of customer fulfillment processes end-to-end.  

•    Strong knowledge of the digital solution landscape supporting customer fulfillment (e.g. order management systems, capabilities, dependencies in the digital landscape).  

•    Skilled in change management, with the ability to lead through ambiguity and uncertainty.  

•    A forward-leaning mindset, with the courage to challenge the status quo and explore new ways of working.  

•    Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.  

•    Experienced in identifying, engaging, and aligning key stakeholders to drive outcomes in a matrix organization.

Please Note: Ingka Co-workers will be prioritized for this role.

The role leads operational Order Management by ensuring the right set up, processes, tools and governance are in place across markets. It supports country teams, secures seamless deviation management, drives performance through data driven decision making, and collaborates closely with group level partners to strengthen operational and omnichannel development while ensuring compliance and scalability.



Your main responsibilities will include:  



•    Lead operational Order Management by securing the correct set up, development needs, reporting and inclusion of all exceptional order set ups within the standard order life cycle.  

•    Provide guidance and operational leadership on Order Management topics to country functions, fostering an inspiring environment and enabling collaboration and sharing of best practices across the country network.

•    Collaborate with key Group level partners, with an end-to-end perspective, in relevant forums and decision bodies, contributing expertise to operational excellence, omnichannel development, business and process forums, sourcing activities, and global and market initiatives.  

•    Follow up and evaluate order management, global range and order allocation initiatives, ensuring compliance with intended processes and systems, and contributing to new supply set ups with a focus on compatibility and adherence to standards.
