jobs.title: Operatør til Stena
jobs.description:
Trives du med rutineprægede opgaver, hvor kvalitet og sund fornuft er i højsædet? Vil du være med på en vækstrejse, hvor teamet går fra 5 til over 20 ansatte, og hvor dit arbejde gør en direkte forskel for miljøet? Så er det nu, du skal slå til!

Om Stena Recycling

Stena Recycling er førende inden for bæredygtige affaldsløsninger. De lever af at give ressourcer nyt liv, og på deres lokation i Roskilde har de stort fokus på batterisortering. De er en arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerheden altid kommer først, og hvor man vægter et godt fællesskab højt. De står over for en spændende udvidelse – særligt i forhold til håndtering af elbilsbatterier – og mangler de rette hænder til at hjælpe dem med at bygge fundamentet for fremtiden.

Særligt for lokationen i Roskilde er, at der udelukkende håndteres to typer affald: Batterier og på sigt elbilsbatterier- en vigtig opgave inden for det grønne område, der kun bliver større med tiden

Om jobbet

Som operatør hos Stena Recycling bliver du en central del af deres sorteringsflow, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre korrekt håndtering og sortering af batterier direkte ved produktionsbåndet. Arbejdet kræver både koncentration og fysisk indsats, da batterierne sorteres manuelt for at sikre, at de værdifulde nikkelmetaller kan udvindes og genbruges.

Sideløbende med sorteringsarbejdet vil du stå for den interne logistik, hvor du betjener mindre gaffeltrucks, stablere og klemmetrucks til at afhente, transportere og placere materialerne de rette steder på pladsen.

Da afdelingen er i vækst, vil hverdagen også byde på diverse ad hoc-opgaver og forfaldent arbejde.

  • Arbejdstider: Vi kører pt. skiftehold med dertilhørende tillæg. Dog er det også muligt at arbejde rent daghold eller rent aftenhold, men ideelt set vil vi gerne have et skiftehold op og stå.

Din profil:

Vi leder efter dig, der møder ind med en positiv indstilling og en god portion sund fornuft. Da vi arbejder med materialer, der skal behandles på en speciel måde, er det vigtigt, at du er kvalitetsbevidst.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Du kan have en baggrund som procesoperatør, produktion, lager eller lignende.

Du taler og forstår dansk.

Du har almindeligt kørekort B.

Du har truckcertifikat

Har du kurset "Varmt arbejde!" er det en fordel

Som person trives du i et arbejdsmiljø med faste rutiner, hvor du sætter en ære i at levere en ensartet høj kvalitet i din sortering. Da sikkerhed er højeste prioritet, forventer vi, at du møder ind med sund fornuft og en ansvarsbevidst indstilling til dit arbejde og dine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder:

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed og en frokostordning.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

Om Randstad:

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Ingénieur procédés analytiques H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

- Partage de connaissances : Former nos équipes aux techniques analytiques les plus avancées et apporter une expertise spécialisée en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique.

- Assurance qualité : Gérer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs de molécules et définir les protocoles de qualification en étroite collaboration avec le service Qualité.

- Interface internationale : Servir de point de contact analytique et technique auprès des laboratoires internationaux d'Air Liquide (notamment Fremont et Dallas) pour des études de corrélation stratégiques.

- Leadership et amélioration continue : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue en faisant preuve d'une force de proposition affirmée, notamment en matière de sécurité, et en assurant un management transversal efficace.

english version :
- Following an internal mobility within the company, we are seeking a Process Engineer Analytics (m/f) for our laboratory.
- Join the laboratory team to play a central role in the analytical excellence of our Electronics business, a rapidly expanding sector. Your key responsibilities will allow you to be at the forefront of innovation and expertise.
- Drive Analytical Innovation: Lead strategic analytical developments and the qualification of new molecules, thereby ensuring the reliability of our products.
- Cutting-Edge Expertise: Lead developments in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography, specifically for organosilicate and organometallic molecules.
- Knowledge Sharing: Train our teams on the most advanced analytical techniques and provide specialized expertise in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography.
- Quality Assurance: Manage the qualification of new molecule suppliers and define qualification protocols in close collaboration with the Quality department.
- International Interface: Act as the analytical and technical point of contact with Air Liquide's international laboratories (notably Fremont and Dallas) for crucial correlation studies.
- Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute to continuous improvement, demonstrating a strong proposal-making capacity, particularly regarding safety, and ensuring effective cross-functional management.

We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?

We are looking for a Chemist that will be titled Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels with a main responsibility in the Fuel Laboratory. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels you will provide expert chemical competence to support Wärtsilä's fuel related technology development, engine testing, customer projects and fuel specification work as well as support on troubleshooting challenges. The role ensures high quality laboratory analysis, development of new analytical methods and expert interpretation of results for conventional, bio based and emerging sustainable fuels. The position supports Wärtsilä's strategic targets related to decarbonisation, fuel flexibility and reliable engine operation.
Requirements for the position:

* M.Sc. in Chemistry or related field

* Strong laboratory experience of instrumental analysis in a chemistry laboratory
* Fluent English communication skills, Swedish and/or Finnish a strong benefit
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* Willingness to perform hands-on laboratory work when required


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:

* A Team player with good collaboration skills in cross-functional teams
* See working in a Chemistry Lab as a dream work were to work & develop long term

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Structured way of working and ability to interpret data, reporting and support technical decisions
* Interest in method development and continuous improvement

Why you and us?

You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.

Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.

You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Salon alueelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Salon alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

jobs.description:
At Alandia, we combine maritime expertise with a strong commitment to our clients. We are looking for an experienced

Claims Executive

to join our growing organisation and provide expert guidance, technical insight and trusted advice to shipowners and brokers. In this full-time role, you will manage and coordinate complex claims matters for a customer base that is primarily, though not exclusively, active within the Nordic region.

The role involves managing a variety of hull and machinery, and loss of hire related lead claims, including machinery breakdowns, salvage operations, collisions, and groundings.

Alandia delivers swift and relevant first-class claims service experience to our customers. Maintaining our customer relationships is essential, alongside the capability to proactively manage claims, provide technical assistance both internally and externally as well as collaborate efficiently within a team to also offer trainings and presentations.

The successful candidate will work in close cooperation with the underwriting and loss prevention departments and will be supported by dedicated and knowledgeable colleagues. Alandia offers an engaging work environment where you can use and enhance your skills within an organization committed to long-term relationships with its customers and an ambitious growth strategy in the marine insurance sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Manage lead hull & machinery and loss of hire claims.

- Appoint and supervise surveyors, lawyers, and other third-party service providers.

- Analyze and review survey reports and other relevant documents.

- Assist and advise assureds on repair options.

- Maintain extensive contact with assureds and brokers.

- Advise assureds and brokers on all aspects of marine hull and loss of hire claims.

- Participate in the department's on-call service and respond to urgent marine claims matters.

- Work collaboratively with our underwriters and loss prevention department and participate in related exercises and seminars.


**Candidate Profile:**

- A background in nautical or marine engineering with seafaring experience is preferred.

- Prior experience in handling marine claims is required.

- Having a practical, solution-oriented approach is key to succeeding in this role.

- Proficiency in English and a Nordic language, both in writing and speaking, is essential.

- A strong motivation to learn and share knowledge.

- Understands the importance of building and maintaining strong professional relationships and has the skills to achieve this.


**Who we are**

At Alandia, our mission is to make a difference by managing risk, protecting value and creating opportunity. As an insurance company with a focus on Marine, Cargo and Boat insurance and with 85 years of experience, Alandia provides claims management and insurance products that support proactive customer behaviour, reduce customer suffering and use of resources.

Headquartered in the Åland islands and with offices in Helsinki, Stockholm and Oslo. Alandia employs approximately 130 professionals.

jobs.title: Lead Estimator
jobs.description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

jobs.title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
jobs.description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

jobs.title: Hinnoittelija/myyjä, Relove, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven lämminhenkistä ja inspiroivaa tiimiä! Etsimme uutta työkaveria vahvistamaan second hand -toimintaamme Helsingin Punavuoren ja Töölön myymälöissä.

Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaan kahvilakulttuurin ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Liikkeemme ovat kokonaisvaltaisia elämyksiä, jossa laatu, estetiikka ja tunnelma kohtaavat.

Hinnoittelijan tehtävässä yhdistyvät second hand -vaatteiden ja asusteiden hinnoittelu sekä myymälätyöskentely. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vahva kiinnostus muotiin, erinomainen tuotetuntemus sekä kyky tunnistaa laadukkaat ja halutut tuotteet.

Hinnoittelijan työssä arvioit asiakkaiden myyntiin tuomia vaatteita ja asusteita sekä määrittelet niille Reloven hinnoitteluperiaatteiden mukaisen myyntihinnan. Arvioinnissa huomioit muun muassa tuotteen brändin, materiaalit, laadun, kunnon, ajankohtaisuuden, sesongin, kysynnän sekä second hand -markkinan hintatason. Tavoitteena on rakentaa asiakkaidemme iloksi laadukas, kiinnostava ja kaupallisesti houkutteleva valikoima.

Hinnoittelun lisäksi työskentelet tarvittaessa myyjänä Relove Fredan ja Töölön myymälässä. Myyjän työhön kuuluu asiakaspalvelua, kassatyöskentelyä, tuotteiden esillepanoa, myymälän visuaalisesta ilmeestä huolehtimista sekä muita myymälän päivittäisiä tehtäviä. Relovessa visuaalisuus ja inspiroiva ostokokemus ovat tärkeä osa konseptiamme, joten pääset myös vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä myymälämme näyttää ja tuntuu.

Vastapainoa vaihtelevalle ja vauhdikkaalle työpäivälle tuovat ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin työyhteisö sekä mahdollisuus työskennellä vastuullisen muodin parissa. Relovessa persoonallisuus saa näkyä ja omaa osaamista sekä näkemyksiä pääsee aidosti hyödyntämään työn arjessa.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on

- vahva osaaminen vaatealasta, brändeistä, materiaaleista sekä niiden hintatasosta
- luontainen intohimo muotiin ja trendien seuraamiseen
- second hand -markkinan tuntemus
- kyky arvioida tuotteiden laatua, kuntoa ja jälleenmyyntiarvoa
- tarkka ja tehokas työskentelyote sekä kyky tehdä itsenäisesti päätöksiä
- positiivinen ja asiakaslähtöinen palveluasenne

Vaatealan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätön. Arvostamme ennen kaikkea käytännön vaateosaamista, second hand -tuntemusta sekä vahvaa kaupallista silmää.

Työsuhteen tiedot

- Työsuhdemuoto: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, osa-aikainen
- Työaika: 30 h / viikko, maanantaista sunnuntaihin 07-21 välisenä aikana
- Palkkaus: Kaupan alan TES, palkkaryhmä B (13,66-15,64€/h)
- Aloitus: mahdollisimman pian
- Työsuhde-edut: ePassi-edut, kattava työterveyshuolto, alennus kahvilatuotteista sekä vaatteiden myyntijaksosta Reloven myymälässä

Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä ja lempeydestä sekä tunnet second hand -maailman omaksesi, hae mukaan joukkoomme! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina, valitut henkilöt solmivat työsuhteet Reloven kanssa.

HUOM! Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla. Suosittelemme sinulle sopivia työpaikkoja työkokemuksesi, koulutustaustasi ja taitojesi perusteella. Barona Careers tekee työnhaustasi helpompaa kuin koskaan!

jobs.title: Byggdrifter
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å ta vare på byggene som betyr mest for innbyggerne i Stavanger?

Som byggdrifter i Stavanger kommune får du en variert arbeidshverdag med ansvar for alt fra historiske bygg i Gamle Stavanger til moderne tekniske anlegg i skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, kulturbygg og administrasjonsbygg.

Hos oss får du bruke fagkompetansen din, løse praktiske og tekniske utfordringer og ta ansvar for at byggene fungerer slik de skal. Du får stor grad av selvstendighet i arbeidshverdagen, samtidig som du blir en del av et stort fagmiljø med kollegaer innen flere tekniske fag.
Stavanger kommune har en av regionens største og mest varierte eiendomsporteføljer. Seksjon Byggdrift har ansvar for drift og oppfølging av over 650 kommunale bygg og rundt 3 000 boliger.

Vi søker nå fire byggdriftere i 100 % faste stillinger til ulike deler av kommunens bygningsportefølje.


Én av stillingene vil ha Rennesøy og Finnøy som sitt primære arbeidsområde. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom du er spesielt interessert i denne stillingen.
Blant byggene vi ønsker å styrke oppfølgingen av er Sølvberget bibliotek og kulturhus. Vi er derfor også interessert i kandidater som motiveres av å jobbe med et stort og publikumsintensivt bygg med varierte tekniske og driftsmessige behov. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom arbeid knyttet til Sølvberget er av særlig interesse.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Drift og oppfølging av kommunale bygg og boliger
  • Oppfølging og kontroll av tekniske anlegg
  • Utførelse av planlagte drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver
  • Internkontroll og oppfølging av lovpålagte oppgaver
  • Registrering, dokumentasjon og rapportering i digitale FDV-systemer
  • Behandling og oppfølging av innmeldte avvik
  • Samarbeid med brukere, leverandører og kollegaer
  • Bidra til systematisk, bærekraftig og forebyggende byggdrift
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev som byggdrifter er ønsket kompetanse og vil bli vektlagt
  • Har du et annet relevant teknisk fagbrev, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg. Erfaring fra byggdrift, tekniske anlegg og systematisk oppfølging av bygg vil bli særlig vektlagt
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig
  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Er serviceinnstilt og trives med kontakt med brukerne av byggene våre
  • Jobber strukturert og er opptatt av kvalitet
  • Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å utvikle deg faglig
  • Ser verdien av god og forebyggende byggdrift
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • En variert arbeidshverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar i egen arbeidshverdag
  • Arbeid med alt fra historiske bygg til moderne tekniske anlegg
  • Et av regionens største fagmiljøer innen byggdrift og teknisk eiendomsforvaltning
  • Et arbeidsmiljø hvor vi deler kunnskap, hjelper hverandre og gjør hverandre gode
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling innen byggdrifterfaget og moderne byggdrift
  • Mulighet til å være med og utvikle hvordan Stavanger kommune drifter byggene sine
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk

Lønn

  • Byggdriftere med fagbrev i byggdrifterfaget lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 561 600–578 000 (751700 – Fagarbeider)
  • Søkere med andre relevante fagbrev lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 528 000–550 000 (751700 – Fagarbeider)

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

jobs.title: Ophthalmologist opportunity in a unique Nordic archipelago
jobs.description:
Ophthalmologist in a Unique Archipelago Environment

Have you considered changing jobs but have not quite found that extra something? Are you looking for a workplace where work-life balance truly goes hand in hand?

We are currently seeking a Specialist in Ophthalmology with a few years of experience to join a unique archipelago environment, where you will have the opportunity to work clinically with a primary focus on outpatient care.

 

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a certified Specialist in Ophthalmology.
  • Has broad experience with both adult and pediatric patients.
  • Is able to work independently in a broad role that includes outpatient consultations, minor surgical procedures, management of diabetes-related eye conditions, and injections.
  • Enjoys working independently and taking significant responsibility, while also having strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with colleagues.

Requirements

  • EU-recognized specialist certification in Ophthalmology.
  • Minimum 3 years of post-specialization experience.
  • Broad independent clinical competence, including pediatric ophthalmology.
  • Experience with routine and advanced ophthalmological diagnostics and procedures.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to learn Swedish.

What the hospital offers:

  • A stimulating workplace with an excellent working environment in a unique archipelago setting.
  • Regular opportunities for professional development.
  • Attractive employment conditions and working hours that promote a healthy work-life balance (38.25 hours per week).

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Social Sciences
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a four-year full-time position as PhD Research Fellow at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), University of Oslo, Norway. 

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective of generating novel knowledge about how to reduce social inequality. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The PhD fellowship is affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 1 «Identifying the barriers to equality in education», aiming to disentangle the causal mechanisms that hinder equality and to understand for whom, how, and why these mechanisms operate over time and across the life course.

The PhD fellow will be part of the interdisciplinary Convergence Environment “NeuroPathways: A Multidisciplinary Convergence Approach to Understanding and Supporting Neurodevelopmental Variability”, funded through the University of Oslo. The project integrates economics, sociology, genetics, psychology, pharmacology, and educational sciences to advance our understanding of neurodevelopmental variability and improve evidence-based and inclusive support strategies across the life course. 

We are looking for a motivated and engaged PhD fellow with strong potential for high-quality research. The position includes 25% career-promoting work, which may consist of teaching, dissemination, and contributions to NeuroPathways interdisciplinary and convergence activities. The career-promoting work will depend on the candidate’s qualifications and CREATE's needs. 


More about the position

Convergence Environments are interdisciplinary research groups that aim to solve grand challenges related to health and the environment. They are funded by UiO's interdisciplinary strategic area UiO:Life Science . 

Neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD and autism are being diagnosed more than ever — but why, and with what consequences? NeuroPathways is an interdisciplinary Convergence Environment that brings together sociology, economics, psychology, genetics, pharmacology, education, and clinical research to address questions about neurodevelopmental variability that cannot be answered within disciplinary silos. The NeuroPathways research environment bridges biomedical and social science perspectives to examine how genetic predispositions and environments — from clinics to classrooms — jointly shape developmental outcomes, using Norway’s exceptional registry and cohort data to study why diagnoses are rising, who receives assessment and support, which interventions work best for whom, and how support systems can become more equitable and inclusive.

This PhD position has an education and society-oriented focus. The PhD fellow will work with large-scale register and cohort data to investigate how social structures interact with individual and family-level risk factors to influence life-course trajectories. Within this framework, the successful candidate will focus on key areas such as examining fairness in support across educational institutions and groups, describing life-course trajectories by taking an intersectional approach incorporating genetics, gender, and socioeconomic background, and identifying specific school characteristics that foster inclusive environments and mitigate the effects of genetic predispositions. This work will integrate descriptive and causal approaches to map outcomes across education, the labor market, and health from childhood through early adulthood.

The PhD fellow will be embedded in the interdisciplinary NeuroPathways Convergence Environment. Professor Astrid Sandsør or Associate Professor Nicolai Borgen, both at the Center for Research on Equality in Education – CREATE, will serve as primary supervisors with overall responsibility for the PhD project. Professor Hedvig Nordeng (Department of Pharmacy) will serve as secondary supervisor. 

The PhD fellow will collaborate closely with researchers across the NeuroPathways Team, including experts in psychology and genetics, education and inequality, pharmacoepidemiology, and clinical psychology. The PhD fellow will work with advanced quantitative methods, contribute to joint publications within NeuroPathways, and participate in interdisciplinary seminars and training activities.

The PhD fellow will take part in the approved PhD program at the Faculty of Educational Sciences and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the PhD fellowship is to qualify the candidate for a research career within or beyond academia. To support a strategic and well-structured PhD trajectory, the PhD fellow will be required to develop a career and competence development plan in dialogue with the supervisory team early in the appointment period. The successful candidate will receive close supervision and is encouraged to develop a strong international research profile through collaboration, conference participation, and research stays abroad.

For more information, please see our web site. 


Qualification requirements

Applicants must satisfy the requirements for admission to the faculty´s PhD program. This normally includes:

  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in Economics, Sociology, Education, Psychology or other relevant fields
  • A Master’s degree (120 ECTS) with a minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS, with a minimum grade B
  • A Bachelor’s degree with a minimum grade C (ECTS grading scale)
  • For 5-year studies, the average grade must be C or better for the first three years, and B or better for the last two years (ECTS grading scale). The Master thesis must have been graded with a minimum grade B
  • Advanced quantitative research skills
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

In the assessment of applications, emphasis will be placed on:

  • The quality of the project description and the research topic’s relevance to NeuroPathways
  • Familiarity with quasi-experimental methods for causal inference 
  • Familiarity with administrative register data or other types of big data
  • Familiarity with R, Stata, Python, or other relevant computing languages
  • Documented research experience or educational background related to neurodevelopmental conditions 

Personal skills 

Personal suitability and motivation for the position will be emphasized and assessed based on the following qualities:

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary research teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to give and receive constructive scientific feedback
  • Structured, reliable, and results-oriented working style
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission
  • Opportunity to work with world-class research data
  • Inclusion in the NeuroPathways Convergence Environment’s professional and social activities and broad network of early career researchers (doctoral and postdoctoral fellows)
  • Dedicated colleagues in a friendly and international research environment, recognized as a Centre of Excellence
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Salary NOK 550 800 - 594 000 per annum depending on qualifications in a position as PhD Research Fellow, (position code 1017). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities

How to apply and what to include in your application

The application must include:

  • Application letter (max. 2 pages) describing motivation for applying, previous research experience, research interests, and how your qualifications match the position
  • A project description, including progress plan (5-7 pages). Please see our guidelines. 
    • Choose a topic relevant to NeuroPathways and motivate your interest
    • Identify a potential research question and suggest a methodological approach and study design to pursue this question
    • Include a tentative progress plan for the PhD, including coursework you would benefit from
  • CV with a complete overview of education, work experience, and other qualifying activities 
  • Publication list, including Master’s thesis and any other academic work (including preprints, talks, or posters)
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only). Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of their grading system
  • Documentation of English proficiency (for information on required documentation, see information on this webpage)
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. 

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language). 

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the project description and the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants may be called in for an interview. 


Formal regulations

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Research Fellowships, Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The appointment may be shortened/given a more limited scope within the framework of the applicable guidelines on account of any previous employment in academic positions.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

CREATE (Centre of Research on Equality in Education) is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway and the Faculty of Educational Sciences. CREATE’s objective is to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education.

jobs.title: Postdoctor position on climate ambition and fairness
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPostdoctoral Research Fellow position 

The Centre for Climate and Energy Transformation (CET), University of Bergen (UiB), is recruiting a postdoctoral research fellow for a period of three years. 

About the Centre for Climate and Energy Transformation (CET)
CET is an interdisciplinary research centre that aims at producing actionable knowledge about how to
achieve deep, rapid and sustainable transformation of society to meet the climate challenge. CET is
based at the UiB Faculty of Social Sciences and works closely with scientists from a variety of disciplines.

CET conducts research on how climate change and transformation are experienced and acted upon by
individuals, communities, policymakers and organizations. More information about CET’s research focus
can be found on the website: https://www.uib.no/en/cet.

The postdoctoral research fellow will have their workplace at CET and is expected to contribute to making
CET a dynamic and productive academic environment.


About the project/work tasks:

The Paris Agreement requires countries, cities and companies to continuously increase the ambition of their climate commitments. Yet there is no widely accepted way to assess whether a climate pledge is both fair and sufficiently ambitious. This postdoctoral research fellow will contribute to Paris Ambition project, funded by the Research Council of Norway, which aims at developing actionable fairness and ambition assessment tools to support decision-makers in implementing global climate goals. This project seeks to develop new conceptual and analytical frameworks to inform international climate negotiations, national climate policy, climate litigation and corporate climate target setting. 

Assessing climate ambition remains a major methodological challenge in climate governance with methodologies applied to different types of actors based on incompatible assumptions. The project considers both the norms that shape climate commitments and the norms used to evaluate their fairness and ambition by governments, civil society, courts and investors. The project draws on the fair share literature – on the allocation of the globally remaining emissions space into national allocations – and legal considerations regarding the role of non-state actors in achieving global and national goals. 

The project is structured around five working packages on:
1) How can international financial support contribute to countries achieving their fair share emissions
allocations?
2) How can fair-share principles inform subnational climate targets?
3) What are the costs of climate damages resulting from countries exceeding their fair-share
emissions allocations?
4) How can countries demonstrate their Highest Possible Ambition, as required under the Paris
Agreement, and what does this imply for non-state actors?
5) What constitutes an ambitious corporate target and how does it contribute to global and national
climate goals?

This project is designed to inform rapid climate action thanks to established collaborations with leading researchers in other research institutions, jurists and societal actors (NGOs working on international climate negotiations, climate litigation and climate policies). 

We are looking for a curious and creative researcher who enjoys developing new methods, working across disciplines and contributing to internationally visible research. The hired postdoc will become part of the Centre for Climate and Energy Transformation, an interdisciplinary research centre based in social science. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to help establish new analytical approaches that could shape future research, policy and practice. Given the interdisciplinary nature of the project, a team will be hired to bring complementary skills, possibly from the fields of integrated assessment modelling, governance, climate policy, climate impact modelling and economics. 

Experience with socio-economic modelling (e.g. integrated assessment models) is particularly relevant to WPs 1, 4 and 5, while expertise in climate impact assessment or the social cost of carbon is particularly valuable to WP3 and 5. Perspectives from climate governance and climate law are particularly relevant to WPs 2 and 5 and contribute to the broader objectives of the project. Applicants to the current position can target any of these parts of the project. 

Each of the WPs is expected to result in submissions to leading journals, with team members taking the lead on different papers. While the project has defined objectives, the successful candidate will have considerable freedom to shape the scientific direction of their work, develop new collaborations and pursue innovative research questions aligned with the overall aims of the project. The successful candidate will be supported in developing an independent research profile and competitive funding applications that support the further development of this research agenda.


Qualifications and personal qualities:

The applicant must:

  • Hold a PhD (or equivalent degree) within disciplines relevant for the project (such as climate policy, data science, economic governance, climate impact modelling, environmental science, geography). Applicants can explain the relevance of their disciplinary background in the application. The applicants must have submitted their doctoral thesis for assessment prior to the application deadline. It is a condition of employment that the PhD has been awarded.
  • Have a documented track record of publications and research development within the thematic area of the position.
  • Be able to work independently and to cooperate with others.
  • Be proficient in both written and oral English (good scientific writing skills will be appreciated).

We are seeking researchers who enjoy working across disciplinary boundaries and developing novel approaches to complex societal challenges.

We particularly encourage applications from:

  • researchers with experience in integrated assessment modelling, socio-economic modelling or
    quantitative climate analysis.
  • researchers with complementary expertise who can develop innovative approaches to assessing
    climate ambition and fairness.

Applicants with other expertise should explain how their experience and ideas can contribute to WP4 and 5 and to the overall objective of the project.

The position and project are hosted by the Centre for Climate and Energy Transformation. 


About the position of postdoctoral research fellow:

The position of postdoctoral research fellow is a fixed-term appointment with the primary objective of qualifying the appointee for work in top academic positions. The fixed-term period for this position is three years. Individuals may not be hired for more than one fixed-term period as a postdoctoral research fellow at the same institution.

The successful candidate will be expected to lead high-quality publications, contribute to the development
of novel assessment methods, and become an internationally recognised researcher in this emerging
field


We can offer:
  • The opportunity to help develop internationally influential methods for assessing climate ambition
    and fairness.
  • Close interaction with international collaborators and societal stakeholders.
  • Significant intellectual freedom to shape your own research direction in relation to the research
    project’s objective.
  • Support for developing an independent publication record and competitive research funding
    applications.
  • Collaboration within an interdisciplinary team spanning modelling, governance and climate policy.
  • Possibility to contribute to the supervision of the Ph.D. student’s project. Teaching can be a possibility, depending on the Department’s future teaching needs.
  • A supporting environment to support career development and grant applications.
  • Gross annual salary as postdoctoral research fellow, code 1352, of NOK 685 900, -. Further
    increase in salary will depend on seniority. A higher salary may be considered for a particularly
    well qualified applicant.
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Good welfare benefits.

Your application must include:
  • A research statement (4-5 pages) where applicants 1) describe how their previous research and
    methodological expertise is relevant to the project’s objectives, including some of its WP and 2)
    suggest one or more original research ideas they would like to pursue within the Paris Ambition
    project.
  • CV, including list of publications and relevant experience in or outside academia.
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons, as well as their relationship with the applicants. Referees will only be contacted for shortlisted candidates.
  • Official confirmation that the doctoral thesis has been submitted.
  • Relevant certificates/references.

The application and appendices with certified translations into English language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge. Applications sent by e-mail will not be evaluated.

The closing date is September 20, 2026.

Potential candidates may be invited for an interview online or at CET.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Yann Robiou du Pont - Project leader: yann.robioudupont@uib.no, https://yannrobioudupont.org/ 

Practical questions about the application process should be directed to Adviser Christine Bresil: christine.bresil@uib.no 

We encourage women to apply. If multiple applicants have approximately equivalent qualifications, the rules pertaining to moderate gender quotas shall apply. The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. UiB therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and age.

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds, or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favourable consideration. We ensure that at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups is invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity.Further information about our employment process can be found here.

jobs.title: Develop the Next Generation of Power Systems
jobs.description:
To strengthen our development department for Electro, Automation and Controls, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer with a strong interest or background in AC power generation and distribution systems.

 

About Bergen Engines

Bergen Engines is a leading developer and manufacturer of medium-speed engines and power solutions for marine and energy applications. Our products deliver reliable power for critical operations worldwide. Our vision is to provide sustainable, efficient, and reliable energy solutions, supporting the transition to lower-emission and future-ready power systems through continuous innovation and engineering excellence.

 

Our Electro, Automation & Control Department consists of highly qualified, self-driven, and motivated professionals. As part of Bergen Engines' Technical Department, we are responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering reliable and functional control and automation systems for engines and associated equipment. We also hold the electrical and power engineering responsibility for the delivery of complete generator set solutions.

In addition, the department performs project-specific engineering and customization for each delivered installation.

 

Role Purpose

As Electrical Engineer at Bergen Engines you will be a part of developing solutions for advanced power generation through power system analysis, simulation, component selection, and grid integration, ensuring technically robust and competitive products that meet evolving Customer and regulatory requirements.

 

Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Modelling and simulation of electrical power generation and transmission systems
  • Perform transient response/stability analysis and relay coordination study
  • Populate parameters for protection relays and AVR
  • Based on fundamental understanding of physical principles, and results from own simulation, drive component selection, sizing and verification (through simulation, and tests when required)
  • Selection of electrical components that results in competitive power generation products, for both standard and bespoke projects. Components (non-exclusive): generators, transformers, switch gear, energy storage, converters, var compensation
  • Grid code compliance for applicable land power generation projects
  • Based on understanding of emerging requirements resulting from transition in global power generation, participate actively in strategic development of competence and product offerings
  • Facilitate contact and knowledge transfer between electrical engineering capabilities worldwide in Bergen Engines group, and engine/control/mechanical expertise in Bergen

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in electrical engineering
  • Fluent in Norwegian and/or English, both written and orally
  • A sound understanding of three-phase AC systems, electrical machines, and fundamental power-system analysis and control principles.
  • Relevant coursework, thesis work, project experience, or professional experience related to electrical power systems.

Preferred Experience and Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of power system protection principles and relay configuration for generators, transformers, feeders, and busbar protection
  • Experience with synchronization, load sharing, and control of generator sets in island mode (microgrid) and grid-connected operation
  • Familiarity with international standards and grid codes (IEC, DNV, IEEE, ENTSO-E, local TSO requirements)
  • Understanding of generator excitation systems (AVR), governor control systems, and power management systems (PMS)
  • Experience with FAT, SAT, commissioning, or troubleshooting of electrical power generation and distribution systems is an advantage
  • Experience from marine, offshore, power generation, renewable energy, or industrial power systems is beneficial
  • Programming experience in MATLAB/Simulink, or similar tools
  • Experience with energy storage systems (BESS), power converters, and microgrid control systems is an advantage

 

Soft Skills:

  • Selfgoing but also a teamplayer
  • Excellent communication skills in interaction with both colleagues and customers
  • Ability to operate under pressure and deliver toward deadlines

 

What We Offer:

  • A key role in a highly specialized engineering environment
  • Opportunity to influence critical product performance and reliability
  • Work with advanced tools and in-house developed methodologies
  • Strong professional development within dynamic analysis and system engineering
  • A collaborative team with high technical competence and ownership
  • To be a part of a dedicated international team with a common goal to develop a greener future
  • Good development opportunities in an international environment
  • Competitive salary according to qualifications and a common bonus system
  • Good work and life balance, through e.g. flexible work hours and holiday schemes
  • Good pension and insurance schemes
  • Discounts with different companies and cottage to rent in Kvamskogen
  • An active welfare club with multiple company sports departments
  • Occupational health service onsite

 

How to apply

If you are motivated by complex engineering challenges and want to contribute to the development of advanced power solutions, we encourage you to apply.

We recognize that no candidate may fulfil all requirements or match the desired seniority level in every aspect. However, if your experience or education is relevant, and you are motivated to develop within the role, we encourage you to submit your application.

 

At Bergen Engines, you will join a skilled and committed team in a company that values quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. We are proud of our strong heritage and are looking for people who want to contribute to our continued growth and success.

Work location will be the engine factory at Hordvikneset, approx. 20 km north of Bergen city center. This position reports to Manager of Electro, Automation & Control—Ole Jørund Bullgård, mobile +47 95753814 or e-mail ole.bullgard@bergenengines.com.

If you find this position suitable, please send us your CV and application via the application link. Final deadline to apply is 13.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.

jobs.title: Myyntipäällikkö, geotekniset tuotteet
jobs.description:
_Haluatko olla mukana kasvattamassa liiketoimintaa, joka auttaa rakentamaan kestävämpää ja turvallisempaa infraa modernien mittaus- ja tutkimusratkaisujen avulla?_

**Haemme nyt**

**Myyntipäällikköä geoteknisten tuotteiden myyntiin**

Ramuddenilla tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja tilapäisiin liikennejärjestelyihin tietöihin, rakennustyömaille, rautateille ja muihin infraprojekteihin – suunnittelusta lupiin, vuokraukseen, myyntiin ja toteutukseen. Lisäksi myymme laajasti tuotteita liikenneturvallisuuteen ja maa- ja pohjarakentamisen mittaus-, paikannus- ja tutkimustarkoituksiin. Turvallisuus, palveluasenne ja jatkuva kehitys ovat toimintamme ytimessä.

**Myyntipäällikkönä** vastaat geoteknisten mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteiden myynnistä, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta. Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät aktiivinen myyntityö, uusasiakashankinta ja tuotealueen kehittäminen. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, muun myyntiorganisaation, toimittajien sekä tuotepäälliköiden kanssa.

Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat esimerkiksi erilaiset infra- ja pohjarakentamisen mittaus-, paikannus- ja tutkimuslaitteet, joita käytetään työmaiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa ja turvallisuuden varmistamisessa. Tehtävän ensisijainen työskentelypaikka sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta valtakunnallisen myynti- ja palveluverkoston tukeminen edellyttää myös matkustamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan kasvavaan liiketoimintaan ja tuomaan uusia ratkaisuja asiakkaidemme käyttöön

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, jotka heijastavat arvostustamme työpanostasi kohtaan

- Dynaamisen ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän ja kasvavan työympäristön, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevien projektien parissa

- Kannustavan ja mukavan työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä fiilis ovat arkea


**Tehtäväsi**

- Vastaat geoteknisten mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteiden myynnistä ja vuokrauksesta sekä huollosta

- Hankit uusia asiakkaita ja kehität pitkäjänteisesti olemassa olevia asiakkuuksia

- Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia ja vastaat ja myyntitavoitteiden saavuttamisesta yhdessä muun myyntiorganisaation kanssa

- Osallistut messuille ja muihin tapahtumiin ja laadit tarjouksia, teet tarjouslaskentaa ja osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin

- Vastaat kauppojen päättämisestä sekä asiakassuhteiden jatkuvasta kehittämisestä

- Seuraat markkinoiden, teknologian ja kilpailijoiden kehitystä ja hyödynnät tietoa liiketoiminnan kasvattamisessa

- Osallistut tuotevalikoiman, hinnoittelun ja saatavuuden kehittämiseen yhteistyössä tuoteryhmävastaavan, toimittajien ja johdon kanssa

- Koulutat ja tuet muuta myyntiorganisaatiota geotuotteiden myynnissä


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Kokemusta teknisten tuotteiden B2B-myynnistä, uusasiakashankinnasta ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä

- Kykyä tunnistaa asiakastarpeita ja rakentaa niiden pohjalta liiketoimintaa

- Ymmärrystä geoteknisistä mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteista tai muista teknisistä ratkaisuista

- Kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta, hinnoittelusta ja sopimusneuvotteluista

- Kykyä analysoida markkina- ja asiakastietoa sekä hyödyntää sitä myynnin kehittämisessä

- Tuloshakuista, oma-aloitteista ja tavoitteellista työotetta

- Hyviä neuvottelu-, viestintä- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Asiakaslähtöisyyttä ja innostusta teknisistä ratkaisuista ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien löytämisestä

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

Vedoucí ekonomického úseku (m/ž)
Mzda: 50000–70000 Kč / měsíc
Místo: Auto Dobrovolný V.M.
Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí a třemi provozovnami – Velké Meziříčí, Jihlava a Znojmo. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAPmotor a zakládáme si na férovém přístupu a stabilním zázemí pro 90 zaměstnanců.
Koho hledáme
Hledáme zkušeného člověka, který převezme odpovědnost za ekonomický úsek a kompletní účetnictví společnosti. Důležitá je samostatnost, schopnost vést menší tým, organizovat práci a mít věci systémově pod kontrolou. Čeká náš velká modernizace systémů ve firmě, takže je pozice vhodná pro energického člověka, který se nebojí výzev, chopí se tohoto projektu a vystaví si finanční oddělení dle svých preferencí.
Při nástupu vás seznámíme s interními procesy a účetním systémem Softapp, kompletní agendu převezmete postupně.
Náplň práce
•    Kompletní vedení účetnictví společnosti v souladu s platnou legislativou, včetně agendy DPH a DPPO.
•    Odpovědnost za měsíční a roční účetní uzávěrky.
•    Vedení, koordinace a metodická podpora účetního týmu o čtyřech lidech.
•    Aktivní zapojení do implementace nového účetního systému a nastavení souvisejících procesů.
•    Příprava podkladů pro auditora a daňového poradce, komunikace s finančním úřadem a dalšími institucemi.
•    Vedení evidence dlouhodobého majetku, odpisů a inventarizací.
•    Tvorba ekonomických přehledů, reportů a analýz pro vedení společnosti.
•    Průběžné nastavování, vyhodnocování a optimalizace účetních a ekonomických procesů; pokročilá práce v Excelu.
•    Občasné služební cesty na další provozovny Auto Dobrovolný v Jihlavě a Znojmě.

Požadavky
•    Praxe na pozici hlavní / samostatné účetní min. 5 let
•    Výborná znalost českých účetních předpisů a daňové legislativy
•    Zkušenost s ročními uzávěrkami a komunikací s auditory výhodou
•    Zkušenost s digitalizací účetních systémů velkou výhodou
•    Znalost práce v účetních systémech (u nás Softapp) a velmi dobrá orientace v MS Excel
•    Schopnost vést tým, nastavovat procesy a dotahovat úkoly v termínech
•    Pečlivost, zodpovědnost a samostatnost
•    Řidičský průkaz
Co nabízíme
•    Flexibilní pracovní dobu
•    Podnikovou jídelnu s příspěvkem na stravu
•    5 sick days ročně
•    Vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce
•    Výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servisní úkony

jobs.title: Ingénieur Devops H/F
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous vous invitons à relever de nouveaux challenges et à évoluer sur des projets d'expertise et d'innovation en prenant part à l'aventure Econocom.  
A travers sa marque Workplace Infra Innovation, l'activité Services en région Grand Est accompagne plus de 40 clients grands comptes et institutions publiques dans tout secteur d'activité dans la transformation de leur système d'information, à travers la mise à disposition de moyens humains et techniques.
Ce qui vous attend :  
Au sein d'un organisme public, vous intégrez une prestation d'assistance technique orientée infrastructure composée d'un chef de projet infrastructures, d'un ingénieur système et réseau, d'un administrateur réseau et sécurité et d'un administrateur de bases de données.  
Vous avez pour mission d'assurer la gestion des applications développées et déployées en environnement Cloud Azure.
Vos responsabilités :  
- Contribuer à la définition des spécifications et à l'évaluation des charges  
- Réaliser l'analyse technique et l'étude détaillée  
- Adapter et paramétrer les progiciels applicatifs  
- Réaliser le prototypage  
- Élaborer les jeux d'essais pour les tests unitaires, d'intégration et de sécurité  
- Effectuer les tests unitaires, d'intégration et de sécurité  
- Identifier, tracer et traiter les dysfonctionnements  
- Mettre en place une démarche d'intégration continue  
- Assister l'équipe infrastructure à la prise en main et à l'administration des conteneurs  
- Réaliser les modules (objets, composants, IHM, API et traitements batch)  
- Utiliser et diffuser les meilleurs pratiques de développement (design pattern, norme de codage, règles de nommage, gestion des sources)  
- Assembler les composants et conteneurs  
- Développer des composants logiciels réutilisables  
- Rédiger les documentations et alimenter la Cartographie du SI  
- Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive  
- Administrer les composants logiciels réutilisables et mettre à jour la nomenclature de ces composants  

L'environnement technique: Cloud Azure, React JS,.NetCore, piplines CI/CD, APIs, microservices, outillage Devops

Ce que nous vous proposons :  
Valeurs  : en plus de nos 3 fondamentaux que sont l'audace, la bonne foi et la réactivité, nous garantissons un management à l'écoute et de proximité, ainsi qu'une ambiance familiale  
Contrat  : en CDI avec un démarrage selon vos disponibilités (nous acceptons les préavis)
Localisation : prestation de client grand compte à Strasbourg

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

- Qualification : un diplôme d'une formation supérieure en informatique est requis (Bac+2 minimum)  
- Expérience : vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins 3 ans en tant qu'ingénieur Devops en environnement Cloud Azure.
- Technical skills : Maitrise de la gestion de piplines CI/CD et du développement d'applications déployées dans Azure. Maitrise de l'Administration et du développement d'une infrastructure Cloud Azure. Maitrise du développement d'APIs et de microservices. Compétences en conception et en mise en œuvre d'infrastructures Cloud. Connaissances des normes de sécurité et de conformité Cloud. Connaissance des modèles de facturation Cloud Provider.
- Soft skills : Vous faites preuve d'un esprit critique, de synthèse et d'analyse. Vous savez vous adapter et vous organiser efficacement. Vous vous démarquez par vos capacités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.

jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Recruiter you’ll help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization. You’ll recruit for new and evolving customer-facing roles—including Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers—that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner with Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You will use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for. You will also help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders, advising on role definition, search strategy, assessment design, and hiring decisions for new and evolving teams.

 - Deliver high-quality hires across the next generation of GTM roles, from sourcing through close, while creating a thoughtful, inclusive, and high-touch candidate experience.

 - Translate Notion’s product love, AI opportunity, and customer motion into accurate candidate narratives that help the right people self-select in.

 - Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

 - Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated success recruiting across GTM searches, with the judgment to learn and represent evolving role profiles accurately.

 - Ability to turn business strategy into clear candidate profiles, search plans, and objective assessment criteria—and to influence senior leaders toward strong decisions.

 - Strong sourcing, market-mapping, and closing instincts across various Sales disciplines.

 - Operational rigor and comfort using data to diagnose pipeline health, measure impact, and improve the candidate and hiring-manager experience.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools: you use them to think better, improve recruiting workflows, and make your work easier for others to build on. 

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Preparerà la documentazione tecnica per le richieste di offerta delle forniture delle apparecchiature, dispositivi e rete piping dell'impianto. Si richiede conoscenza dei pacchetti office ed Acad. E' gradita la conoscenza lingua Inglese.
