jobs.title: Swedish speaking sales agents to Barcelona!
jobs.description:
Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är en av Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer. Och svenska kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

jobs.title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
jobs.description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:

    Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
    Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
    Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
    Free Gym Membership
    Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
    Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:

    Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
    Service-minded with good communications skills
    A fast-learner
    A flexible team player
    Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
    An entertainer at heart
    Excellent customer service skills
    Manage Player expectations and behavior
    Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Portuguese-speaking | Industrial Projects
jobs.description:
About the role

This is a hands-on project role where you will coordinate activities, follow up on purchases and deliveries, communicate with customers and suppliers, and make sure agreed actions progress according to schedule.

The assignment is initially six months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible.

Work tasks

You will work closely with an experienced international project organization and support a Project Manager responsible for several customer projects. The team has recently grown, creating a need for additional project engineering capacity.

A significant part of the role involves projects in Portuguese-speaking markets in South America, which makes fluent Portuguese essential. You will communicate directly with customers and help translate their needs into concrete actions within the project organization.

The projects are related primarily to large industrial engines, engine components and associated technical services. You do not need to be an engine specialist when you join, but you should be comfortable working with technical equipment and industrial projects.

The role combines project coordination, customer communication, procurement and technical understanding. Success requires an organised and proactive approach: when something needs to happen, you take ownership of following it through.

Your responsibilities may include:
- Coordinating international customer and delivery projects
- Communicating with Portuguese-speaking customers in South America
- Following project schedules, open actions and deliveries
- Ensuring agreed tasks progress and proactively following up with stakeholders
- Creating and following purchase orders and procurement activities
- Working with ERP systems, particularly SAP
- Coordinating suppliers and external service providers
- Supporting sourcing and procurement of services such as machining, lifting and specialist field services
- Investigating delivery issues and other project deviations
- Collaborating with Project Managers, procurement, logistics, technical experts, suppliers and customers
- Supporting customer meetings and project-related travel to South America

We are looking for

For this position, you must have:
- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering
- Professional fluency in Portuguese
- Professional working proficiency in English
- Previous experience in project work where you have independently coordinated activities, followed schedules and ensured actions are completed
- Experience working with purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries or similar ERP-based processes
- Ability to understand technical equipment and communicate effectively in an industrial environment
- Willingness and ability to travel to South America when required
- Experience with SAP
- A valid driving licence

You do not need to speak Finnish.

We consider it a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Marine, maritime or shipbuilding industry
- Engine technology or powertrain systems
- Industrial machinery or equipment
- Technical service or maintenance projects
- Procurement and supplier coordination
- Automation
- Customer-facing technical project roles

Your previous job title could for example be Project Engineer, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Delivery Engineer, Service Engineer, Technical Project Engineer or Procurement Engineer. More important than the title is that you understand how technical projects work and are comfortable taking responsibility for keeping them on track.

As a person, we believe you are
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership
- Organised and able to manage several ongoing topics simultaneously
- Confident communicating directly with customers
- Persistent in following up and getting things completed
- Comfortable working across different countries, cultures and functions
- Practical and solution-oriented when plans change

Practical information
- Salary: based on your background and experience about 3500 - 4500 € / month
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- Working hours: Full-time
- Location: Flexible within Finland. The role can be performed largely remotely, although occasional presence in Turku is required.
- Travel: The position includes occasional international business travel, primarly to South America.
- Languages: Portuguese and English
- Employment: Fixed-term employment through Academic Work, working as a consultant in our client organisation

About the client

Our client is a globally operating technology company providing advanced solutions and services for demanding marine and industrial environments. Its international project organisation works with customers around the world on large-scale technical equipment, lifecycle services and complex delivery projects.

You will join an experienced international organisation where you will work with technically interesting projects and gain exposure to global customers, suppliers and engineering professionals.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Den ideelle kandidat har gå-på-mod og lyst til at lære nye opgaver. Du kan håndtere forskellige typer montagearbejde med fokus på at levere et kvalitetsprodukt – uanset om der er tale om finmotorisk eller mere groft arbejde. Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på, er det et ekstra plus.

Du har ikke nødvendigvis en relevant uddannelse, men din praktiske erfaring gør, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt – også med opgaver, der til tider kan være rutineprægede og monotone.

Du trives med at være en del af et mindre team, hvor teamwork er i højsædet. Du har øje for detaljen og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde. Samtidig er du fleksibel og omstillingsparat i forhold til arbejdsopgaver og møder hverdagen med en positiv tilgang.

Kort sagt søger vi en medarbejder med sans for kvalitet og effektivitet – krydret med en god portion humor.

Det får du

Dit primære område vil være at udføre montageopgaver og bidrage til at sikre den løbende drift på tværs af produktionen. Du vil fungere som en alsidig medarbejder, der er klar til at tage fat, hvor der er behov, og som gerne går det ekstra skridt for sine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder gode kolleger med en bred vifte af kompetencer samt flextid mandag til fredag inden for tidsrummet kl. 06.30–16.00.

Hos Energy Cool bliver du en del af en brugerdreven, innovativ og visionær virksomhed. Vi har en stærk kultur præget af åbenhed, ærlighed og sammenhold – og der er plads til forskellighed.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag med mulighed for faglig udvikling og plads til professionelle ambitioner.

Om Energy Cool

Virksomheden med de grønne visioner.

Vi producerer energibesparende køleløsninger til server- og teknikrum. Vores løsninger hjælper kunder med at reducere deres energiforbrug og samtidig mindske deres miljøpåvirkning.

Vi udvikler løsninger med fokus på energieffektivitet, driftssikkerhed og de eksisterende og fremtidige krav til miljø og støjbegrænsning. Det gør vi i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi arbejder konstant på at udvikle endnu bedre løsninger – fra enkeltkomponenter og delsystemer til komplette løsninger. På den måde udfordrer vi eksisterende teknologier og sætter nye standarder for energioptimering.

Interesseret?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til vores værkfører Nikki Hedemand på nh@energy-cool.com.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

jobs.title: Bell Captain
jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Opened in 2008, Four Seasons Hotel Macao has become a coveted destination for both business and leisure travelers who seek exceptional and personalized services. Its numerous awards and satisfied customers attest to its excellence. In October 2020, Four Seasons Hotel Macao introduced The Grand Suites, an all-suite tower that took the concept of luxury and bespoke services to new heights. With the addition of 289 suites, the Hotel's room count increased to a combined total of 649 keys, making it the largest property within the Four Seasons group. Situated at the heart of the Cotai Strip, the hotel provides an elegant oasis with elite entertainment, high-end shopping, world-class dining, and the indulgent pampering that defines Four Seasons.

Applicants must hold a Macao ID due to work permit restrictions.

About The Role

The Bell Captain is responsible for assisting guest with their arrival and departure experience; makes necessary deliveries to and pick up from guest rooms, transports guests and hotel packages, faxes, envelopes and parcels. Extends guidance and training to bell persons, working closely with other departments in the hotel to ensure a superior guest experience.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinate daily activities of bellman including completion of Bellman Daily Checklist, organization of bag storage area, porterage, group arrival/departure information, cart maintenance, and weekly standards testing
  • Greet guests upon arrival and departure with a friendly and professional demeanor
  • Provide information about the hotel facilities, local attractions, and services
  • Conduct periodic inventory checks on luggage tags, luggage stored and miscellaneous
  • Coordinate with other departments to fulfill guest requests and needs
  • Handle guest inquiries and complaints promptly and professionally
  • Assist with transportation arrangements, including Taxi, Shuttle and Limousine services

What You Bring

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in Cantonese, Mandarin and English
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Committed to achieving high levels of service excellence and guest contentment.
  • 1-2 years luxury hotel experience as Bell Attendant or Bell Captain
  • Knowledge of the local area and attractions is a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities
  • Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide
  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
  • Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours

  • 48 Hours weekly
  • Work on shift

jobs.title: Teknisk sparringspartner til viceværterne og kunderne
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din tekniske ekspertise i ejendomsdrift til at levere professionel rådgivning til et selvkørende hold af viceværter i hele Jylland?

Vores viceværter er hamrende dygtige til at passe vores kunders ejendomme og i takt med at vi vokser, er vi klar til at lægge et teknisk lag mere på.

Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Ikke som leder, men som teknisk sparringspartner, der forstår viceværternes dagligdag og som kan oversætte tekniske dokumenter til håndterbare procedurer.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Vi har brug for din ekspertise til at løse tekniske opgaver og hjælpe viceværterne med spørgsmål i hverdagen. Det kan blandt andet handle om:

-    Indstilling af ventilationsanlæg

-    Fejlsøgning og justering af gulvvarmeanlæg

-    Udarbejdelse af DKV-planer

-    Gennemgang og opstart af nye ejendomme

-    Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører

-    Håndtering af forsikringssager

Du er på forkant med de tekniske aspekter, der sikrer god drift af vores kunders ejendomme. Du bliver samtidig højre hånd for vores team af viceværter, så de altid har en teknisk sparringspartner lige ved hånden.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

Da rollen er ny, er vi klar på at tilpasse den ud fra din faglighed og dine erfaringer. Fortæl os hvordan du ser, at rolle kan passe til dig og hvad du bringer i spil af teknisk viden.

 

HVORFOR ER DET NETOP DIG, VI LEDER EFTER?

Fordi du glæder dig til en hverdag, hvor du finder løsninger sammen med kolleger, kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Fordi du trives i en virksomhed, hvor vi gør os umage og hjælper hinden med at skabe endnu bedre løsninger.

For at kunne varetage rollen er det et krav, at du har en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

-    Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift eller facility management

-    Skaber overblik og følger op på igangværende sager

-    Skaber tillid blandt kolleger og kunder ved at være serviceminded og troværdig

-    Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

 

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

 

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå på de ejendomme, vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi søger en medarbejder til opstart seneste d. 1/10, men gerne allerede i løbet af september.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

 

VIL DU MED?

Drop bare ansøgningen. Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Koulupsykologi, Perhekeskus, Kaarina
jobs.description:
Työskentelet koulupsykologina Kaarinan opiskeluhuollossa S:t Karins svenska skolanissa ja Piispanlähteen koululla (1.-6. luokat) sekä näiden koulujen esiopetusyksiköissä. Tuot psykologista asiantuntijuutta esiopetuksen ja oppilaitoksen käyttöön ja olet mukana tukemassa lasten oppimista, kasvua, kehitystä ja hyvinvointia. Arjessasi yhdistyvät yksilötyö, yhteisöllinen työ ja monialainen yhteistyö koulun henkilöstön sekä opiskeluhuollon muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työssäsi psykologin asiantuntemusta arvostetaan ja se nähdään kouluyhteisössä tärkeänä. Tukenasi ovat johtava koulupsykologi sekä alueen kokenut psykologitiimi, jotka ovat aina tarvittaessa saatavilla.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:
-oppilaan yksilökohtainen tuki ja ohjaus asiakastyössä oppimiseen, kasvuun, kehitykseen ja hyvinvointiin liittyen
-osallistuminen monialaisen asiantuntijaryhmän työskentelyyn
-yhteisöllinen työ oppilaitoksella
-oppimisvaikeuksien kartoitus.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn, jossa voit suunnitella työpäiväsi joustavasti liukuvaa työaikaa ja osittaista etätyötä hyödyntäen. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään, mahdollisuuden perustellusti yksilötyönohjaukseen sekä halutessasi kokeneen psykologin mentoriksi. Tuemme osaamisesi kehittymistä ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kouluttautua esimerkiksi Terapiat etulinjaan -koulutuksiin. Työhyvinvointisi ja ammatillinen kasvu ovat meille tärkeitä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta sujuvaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä hyviä verkosto- ja tiimityötaitoja. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus lasten, nuorten ja perheiden kanssa tehdystä työstä. Huomioimme myös opintojen loppuvaiheessa olevat hakijat.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen psykologin laillistus.

Hae mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin ja oppimisen tueksi Kaarinaan - odotamme hakemustasi!

jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Santa Claus
jobs.description:
Job description – Santa Claus / Seasonal Freelance Performer

We are looking for authentic, warm-hearted and professional Santa Claus performers to join us for the winter season in Rovaniemi, Finnish Lapland.

This is not an ordinary job where you simply put on a costume and repeat the same performance all day. As a Santa, you will meet people from all over the world and become part of some of their most memorable moments.

Your main responsibility is to create genuine, warm and unforgettable encounters as Santa Claus. Depending on the assignment, your work may include private Santa visits, meetings with families and children, visits to hotels and accommodation properties, Christmas programmes and other Santa-related experiences in the Rovaniemi area.

No two encounters are exactly the same. You may meet excited children, shy children, adults who are experiencing Lapland for the first time, families celebrating a special occasion or guests who simply want to meet the real Santa from the Arctic Circle. Because of this, the ability to read different situations, listen to people and react naturally is an essential part of the work.

We are not looking for someone who simply performs a memorised script.

We are looking for people who understand that even a short meeting can become a lifelong memory.

What we are looking for

You may be a good fit for this role if you:

- Meet people genuinely, respectfully and warmly.

- Enjoy working with people of different ages, backgrounds and cultures.

- Know how to listen and make people feel comfortable.

- Can read changing situations and adapt your approach naturally.

- Are able to create a believable and authentic Santa Claus character.

- Have a natural sense of humour and are comfortable interacting spontaneously with guests.

- Are reliable, punctual and able to work independently.

- Are willing to continuously learn and develop your skills.

- Understand that teamwork and communication are important parts of creating a high-quality guest experience.

- Take pride in your appearance, behaviour and professionalism.

- Want to help create unforgettable moments rather than simply complete a task.


Previous experience as Santa Claus, an actor, performer, tour guide, host or in customer service is beneficial, but the right personality, attitude and willingness to learn are equally important.

The work is highly international, and good spoken English is required. Other language skills are considered an advantage.

The work

The work is seasonal and assignments may vary in duration, location and content. Working hours are flexible and depend on bookings and customer demand. The busiest period is during the Christmas and winter season.

The work requires the ability to move independently between different assignments in the Rovaniemi area. A driving licence and access to transportation may therefore be an advantage, depending on the assignments.

You will receive guidance and support for the role, but we also expect you to take responsibility for your own professionalism and preparation.

Important: freelance and assignment-based work

This position is not a traditional employment relationship.

The selected Santa Claus performers work independently and invoice for the assignments they complete. The work can therefore be carried out, for example, as:

- a freelancer or self-employed person

- a light entrepreneur using an invoicing service

- through your own business


**Compensation is agreed in advance for each assignment. There is no fixed monthly salary, and earnings depend on the number and type of assignments completed.**

More detailed information about the assignments, compensation and practical arrangements will be discussed with suitable applicants.

What matters most to us

We value who you are more than what your CV looks like.

We are looking for people who bring authenticity, reliability, professionalism and a genuine desire to create meaningful encounters.

You do not need to be a finished product.

You need to be someone who wants to learn, develop and become even better.

If you recognise yourself in this description, we would love to hear from you.

**If you think you might be the right person, let's talk.**

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricated tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department: The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the transport and immersion of the elements.

To float, move and immerse the Tunnel Elements, temporary installations are required. A team of mechanics, riggers and electricians installs and tests these systems. The Commissioning Engineer analyzes technical input to optimize performance and plan ahead, working closely with technical staff and operations.

Main tasks and responsibilities: The Site Engineer Automation ensures operational readiness of the temporary systems in the tunnel elements and continuously improves them based on operational feedback to optimize installation efficiency.

  • Creates and follows a testing protocol for all installations.

  • Leads the commissioning of the standard and special tunnel elements.

  • Adapts system changes according to new insights.

  • Provides correct reports and documentation to the site engineers.

  • Is responsible for adjusting control systems, and coordinates changes.

Qualifications:

  • Is fascinated by technology and wants to understand how things work.

  • Is an analytical thinker and a fast learner, able to comprehend, design and improve systems.

  • Has strong communication skills, necessary for project development with internal clients and contractors.

  • Is a problem solver

  • Speaks English.

Conditions: FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. FLC staff are expected to set their own targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions—irrespective of their position in the company. FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to the Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension, health insurance, and lunch arrangements will be available.

Workplace: Rødbyhavn, Denmark

Application: We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.title: Residential Technician
jobs.description:
Celebrate Life, the Southworth Way

The Company: Welcome to Southworth. We own and operate a growing portfolio of premier private communities, each offering inspired environments and locations. Our dedication to hospitality and endless activities for the entire family ensures our members experience a world at play like never before.

With a solid reputation for stability, integrity, and innovation, Southworth's clubs and communities provide exceptional locations where our members can truly live life at ease. Our dedicated team members play a crucial role in elevating the experience for our members, residents, guests, and fellow team members. We encourage all our team members to be and belong by providing a wide array of benefits, engagement programs, unique perks, discounts, and, of course, a lot of fun!

The Benefits: We are proud of our âfamily companyâ roots and understand everyone has a unique set of needs: we want to support you as best we can so you can live your best life with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive options for medical, physical, and mental health and wellness, life insurance, 401k matching, paid time off, and more.

Grow with us! The sky is the limit for talented, driven individuals. With our ever-expanding portfolio, we offer opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. We look forward to growing together.

Be YOU with us! At Southworth, we are working to redefine the country club. We seek talent from a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and cultures to ensure an innovative edge. Here, diversity is a driver of our success.

About The Abaco Club: The Abaco Club is a paradise for the soul. It is an unassuming haven crafted in the pursuit of connection, happiness and belonging. Here, members unwind in barefoot luxury in island-inspired homes, golfers take on the #1 golf course in The Bahamas, and generations come together on 2 miles of uninterrupted white sands on one of the most pristine beaches on Earth.

Working at The Abaco Club means being part of a vibrant community that values your knowledge and offers opportunities for professional growth and development. Here, you can turn your passion for hospitality into a rewarding career while enjoying the stunning scenery of this beautiful place. Become a part of our team and help us show what makes the Abaco Club truly extraordinary.

jobs.title: Research & AI Coordinator – Fuengirola ☀️
jobs.description:
Heltid | Hybrid | Costa del Sol

Vill du arbeta med rekrytering, research och AI och samtidigt bygga din karriär på Costa del Sol?

Sway Sourcing är ett snabbväxande svenskt rekryterings- och konsultbolag med vårt interna team baserat i Fuengirola och verksamhet i både Sverige och Spanien. Vi arbetar med rekrytering och konsultlösningar med huvudsakligt fokus på den svenska marknaden.

Nu växer vi vidare och söker en Research & AI Coordinator som vill bli en del av vårt team och vara med och utveckla både våra arbetssätt och vår verksamhet. 🚀

Det här är en bred roll för dig som är nyfiken, digital, strukturerad och driven och som gillar att hitta information, identifiera möjligheter och testa smartare sätt att arbeta.

Om rollen 🔎

Du kommer att arbeta nära våra rekryterare och ledning och få en viktig roll i hur vi fortsätter utveckla Sway.

En stor del av arbetet handlar om research och sourcing – att identifiera kandidater, företag och möjligheter på arbetsmarknaden samt ta fram relevanta underlag som hjälper teamet framåt.

Samtidigt kommer du att arbeta praktiskt med AI och moderna digitala verktyg. Vi vill hela tiden hitta smartare sätt att arbeta och du blir en del av att testa, utveckla och implementera nya lösningar i vår vardag.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

    

Researcha och identifiera kandidater, företag och möjligheter på arbetsmarknaden

    

Arbeta med sourcing och utveckla vårt stora kandidatnätverk

    

Ta fram kvalificerade underlag till våra rekryterare och affär

    

Arbeta med LinkedIn och andra digitala kanaler

    

Använda AI och moderna digitala verktyg för research och effektivisering

    

Testa och implementera nya AI-baserade arbetssätt och processer

    

Stötta våra rekryterare och vår affärsutveckling

    

Bidra inom sociala medier, digitalt innehåll och marknadsföring

    

Vara delaktig i utvecklingen av Sways hemsida och digitala närvaro

    

Delta i interna utvecklingsprojekt och hjälpa oss hitta ännu smartare sätt att arbeta

Rollen är ny och kommer att utvecklas tillsammans med dig. För rätt person finns därför stora möjligheter att påverka både rollen, våra arbetssätt och din egen utveckling inom Sway.

Vem söker vi? 🙋

För oss är personlighet, driv och potential viktigare än en specifik utbildning eller tidigare jobbtitel.

Vi tror att du:

    

Är nyfiken och tycker om att hitta information och lösa problem

    

Är driven, initiativtagande och gillar att få saker att hända

    

Arbetar strukturerat och kan ta eget ansvar

    

Har god digital förståelse och lätt för att lära dig nya system och verktyg

    

Är genuint intresserad av AI och hur ny teknik kan användas praktiskt

    

Har ett kommersiellt tänk och är bra på att identifiera möjligheter

    

Uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska, både i tal och skrift

    

Har goda kunskaper i engelska

    

Trivs i ett mindre team med stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar

Erfarenhet av rekrytering, sourcing, research, AI-verktyg, LinkedIn, digital marknadsföring, sociala medier eller affärsutveckling är meriterande, men inget krav.

Det viktigaste för oss är att hitta rätt person med rätt driv, nyfikenhet och potential.

Varför Sway? ☀️

Vi tycker att ett bra jobb ska gå att kombinera med ett bra liv.

Hos Sway blir du en del av ett engagerat team där du får stort eget ansvar, frihet och möjlighet att påverka. Vi arbetar hybrid, tror på frihet under ansvar och gillar korta beslutsvägar.

Har någon i teamet en bra idé ska det inte behöva ta sex månader innan vi testar den.

Och arbetsmiljön är svår att klaga på.

Vårt kontor ligger i Fuengirola på Costa del Sol, med havsutsikt och stranden runt hörnet. Här har du nära till restauranger, caféer, träning och livet längs strandpromenaden. 🌊

Hos oss får du bland annat

    

Hybridarbete och frihet under ansvar

    

Friskvård och gemensamma aktiviteter

    

Kontor med havsutsikt och närhet till stranden

    

En internationell arbetsmiljö med verksamhet i Sverige och Spanien

    

Möjlighet att arbeta praktiskt med AI och modern teknik

    

Stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla din roll

    

Möjlighet att växa tillsammans med ett snabbväxande bolag

    

Fast lön med möjlighet till prestationsbaserad bonus

Kort sagt: ett professionellt arbete med framför allt den svenska marknaden, men med möjligheten att bygga både karriär och liv på Costa del Sol.

Om tjänsten 📍

Placering: Fuengirola, Spanien Omfattning: Heltid Arbetssätt: Hybrid Start: Enligt överenskommelse Ersättning: Fast lön + möjlighet till prestationsbaserad bonus

Ansökan

Låter det som något för dig?

Skicka in ditt CV och en kort presentation av dig själv. Vi genomför urval och intervjuer löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Välkommen till Sway Sourcing! 🚀

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

jobs.title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
jobs.description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

This position involves assisting customers with ear piercings, providing product recommendations, and ensuring the studio maintains Rowanâs high standards of cleanliness and safety. jobs.title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

jobs.description:
Job Description â Quantity Surveyor (QS Engineer)Position

Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

jobs.title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

8. przeprowadzanie wywiadów środowiskowych na rzecz innych jednostek organizacyjnych, ośrodków pomocy społecznej lub powiatowych centrów pomocy rodzinie,
9. przygotowywanie dokumentacji do wniosku o pomoc pieniężną dla kombatantów i osób represjonowanych,
10. współpraca i współdziałanie z innymi specjalistami w celu przeciwdziałania i ograniczania trudności w prawidłowym funkcjonowaniu osób i rodzin, w szczególności łagodzenie skutków ubóstwa,

jobs.title: SERVISER/KA POLJOPRIVREDNE MEHANIZACIJE
jobs.description: Kao serviser u našem timu, bit ćete zaduženi za održavanje vrhunskih poljoprivrednih strojeva i pružanje tehničke podrške našim kupcima na terenu i u radionici. Ključne odgovornosti: • Dijagnostika kvarova: Detekcija mehaničkih, hidrauličkih i električnih kvarova na traktorima i priključnim strojevima pomoću suvremenih dijagnostičkih uređaja. • Popravak i održavanje: Izvođenje redovnih servisa, preventivnog održavanja te interventnih popravaka poljoprivredne mehanizacije. • Priprema strojeva: Sastavljanje, testiranje i priprema novih strojeva za isporuku krajnjim kupcima. • Terenski rad: Povremeni odlasci na teren kod kupaca radi otklanjanja kvarova u sezoni poljoprivrednih radova. • Vođenje dokumentacije: Točno i uredno ispunjavanje servisnih radnih naloga i tehničkih izvještaja. Što tražimo od vas: • Stručna sprema: Srednja stručna sprema (SSS) tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, automehatroničar, poljoprivredni tehničar-mehanizator, strojarski tehničar ili srodno). • Radno iskustvo: Poželjno je minimalno 3 godine radnog iskustva na poslovima servisa strojeva (iskustvo s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom je velika prednost, ali nije uvjet ako imate iskustva s teretnim programom). • Vozačka dozvola: Obavezna B kategorija (poželjna i C kategorija) • Računalna pismenost: Osnovno korištenje računala (zbog rada sa servisnom dijagnostikom). • Osobine: Samostalnost u radu, odgovornost prema alatima i opremi, spremnost na timski rad i želja za stalnim učenjem. Što vam nudimo: • Stabilnost: Siguran posao i ugovor o radu na [neodređeno vrijeme / određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja] s probnim rokom. • Primanja: Redovita i konkurentna primanja u skladu s vašim znanjem i iskustvom • Edukacija: Kontinuirano stručno usavršavanje i specijalizirane obuke kod inozemnih proizvođača mehanizacije. • Radna okolina: Rad s modernim alatima i dijagnostičkom opremom u ugodnoj i poticajnoj radnoj atmosferi. • Oprema za rad: Službeni mobitel, kvalitetan profesionalni alat, radna odjeća i sva potrebna zaštitna oprema. •Terenski rad: Za potrebe terenskog rada osigurano službeno servisno vozilo opremljeno potrebnim alatom i opremom. Nemate iskustva s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom? Ako imate dobro iskustvo u servisiranju automobila, kamiona, građevinskih ili drugih radnih strojeva te želite naučiti raditi s poljoprivrednom mehanizacijom, slobodno se prijavite – osigurat ćemo vam potrebnu stručnu obuku. Kako se prijaviti? 1. Dežurēt dienesta viesnīcā saskaņā ar apstiprināto grafiku, nodrošinot kārtību un drošību. Uzraudzīt telpu, inventāra un materiālo vērtību saglabāšanu, kā arī iekšējās kārtības un ugunsdrošības prasību ievērošanu.

2. Veikt telpu un teritorijas apsekošanu, konstatētos trūkumus fiksējot dežūras žurnālā. Nodrošināt piekļuves kontroli, atslēgu apriti un īrnieku uzskaiti.

3. Sadarboties ar dienesta viesnīcas skolotājiem un iestādes speciālistiem ar izglītojamo uzvedību un drošību saistītos jautājumos.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.

    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
